chapters.title: Chapter 401: The Fairest Currency
paragraphs: “These resources are indeed a bit too much.”
Looking at the mountains of resources piled up within his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan couldn’t help but shake his head with a wry smile.
“Even if I farm military merits through the Dark Web, it won’t consume much.”
“I can’t possibly purchase alien buildings worth hundreds of trillions from the Dark Web all at once and then convert all of them into military merits, right?”
“That would be far too high-profile.”
A few years ago, he was once overjoyed because a C-grade building, the Moon Well, could bring in a revenue of thirty thousand Faith Points every month.
But after just a few short years, the revenue brought by his Divine Kingdom investments had now inflated to a degree that even he himself felt was exaggerated.
Today, the actual monthly revenue from his Divine Kingdom investments was at least four to five hundred trillion Divinity Points.
Such a scale of wealth even made Yang Fan unable to help but doubt.
Could those top behemoth enterprises claiming to be listed on the main board of the Human Federation achieve this level?
However, wealth growth brought not only joy, but also the risks hidden behind it.
Yang Fan understood one principle very well.
A person’s wealth and strength must match their identity and status.
If one possessed wealth far exceeding their own status, yet lacked sufficient strength to guard it, then wealth was not an fated opportunity, but a weakness exposed to the outside.
Most of the time, the truly dangerous thing was not others knowing you were strong, but others discovering you possessed things you shouldn’t have.
Therefore, before his strength reached a sufficient height, concealing his brilliance was far more important than recklessly displaying it.
“If I were already a High-Order God now, these resources would naturally be able to play a greater role.”
Yang Fan took a deep breath and reminded himself once again.
“But right now, I must restrain myself.”
Afterwards, he raised his head and looked at Yang Da.

“Now that the resource output is already this terrifying, in the future, in order to further upgrade the Divine Kingdom environment, I will continue to procure resource-type buildings like the Earth Spiritual Milk Source Nest from the Dark Web.”
“It can be foreseen that the Divine Kingdom’s revenue will only continue to skyrocket in the future.”
“Do you have any good suggestions?”
“However, there is one requirement: the less contact with the real world, the better.”
“You should have looked into the corporate annual reports of those large listed companies.”

“With our current resource volume, if we continue to exchange a large amount of resources through the Divine Shop and external channels like before, it will inevitably attract the attention of some interested parties.”
“Just my identity as the son-in-law of the Five Great Families and a Peerless Prodigy of the Human Federation is not enough.”
Yang Fan said with a serious expression.
Yang Da naturally understood Yang Fan’s worries.
“Master, things like Divinity Points are ultimately better the more you have.”
“As the believers’ Realm continuously improves, the consumption of resources will likewise grow exponentially.”
“The resources required by ten, or even a hundred Qi Refining Stage believers might not compare to a single Foundation Establishment Realm believer.”
“In the future, when the Divine Kingdom’s scale expands and believers break through to higher Realms, the believers will consume massive amounts of resources.”

“Besides that, if the Yang Corporation established by Master in the real world wants to truly stride toward the entire Human Federation in the future, it will likewise require a large amount of Divinity Points as support.”
Yang Da reminded him.
In his view, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom didn’t actually have too many resources right now; rather, the development structure of the entire Divine Kingdom had a certain degree of imbalance.
The number of resource-type buildings far exceeded the believers’ strength.
After all, Yang Fan right now was merely a First-Order God.
Looking across the entire Human race, which First-Order Divine Kingdom could possess hundreds of thousands of S-rank resource-type buildings?
Even the core heirs of the Five Great Families, at this stage, could never possibly possess such exaggerated resource buildings.

And although the SSS-rank [Hundredfold Evolution Talent] increased the resource output a hundredfold, it also meant that during the process of believers’ growth, the consumption of resources would also greatly increase.
Yang Da believed that as time went on, the Divine Kingdom’s area continued to expand, and after believers broke through to the Spirit Severing Realm, or even higher Realms...
One day, the consumption speed of the believers would gradually catch up with the resource output.
By that time, it might even be necessary for the Yang Corporation in the real world to turn around and provide resource support for the Divine Kingdom.
Divinity Points are never enough; this is a universally recognized fact by all gods.
Otherwise, the Human Federation would not have given birth to so many financial groups, companies, listed corporations, and top families.
The essence of commercial activity is to acquire more resources.
And in the Divine Kingdom era, the ultimate purpose of all commercial activities is to make the Divine Kingdom become even stronger.
Hearing this, a confident smile appeared on the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“I understand what you mean.”
“However, there are some changes that you don’t seem to have taken into account.”
Yang Da asked doubtfully, “Please enlighten me, Master.”
Yang Fan looked at the vast Divine Kingdom in the distance.
“The area of the entire Divine Kingdom that can truly be utilized right now has actually not reached its limit.”
“Aside from the core area, most places are still only equipped with A-grade buildings like Spirit Veins.”
“Divine Kingdom investments still have massive room for improvement.”

“As long as the channel of the Dark Web exists, before the investable areas of the Divine Kingdom are fully developed, the consumption speed of believers will never be able to catch up with the output speed of resource buildings.”
“This is just the first point.”
“The most important thing is Origin Evolution.”
Speaking of this, a flash of bright light crossed Yang Fan’s eyes.
“The S-rank Talent [Growth of All Things] has already boosted all resource output within the Divine Kingdom to more than tenfold.”
“In the future, as more talents undergo Fusion, can it continue to transform?”
“SS-rank?”
“Even... SSS-rank?”
Yang Fan gazed at the Divine Kingdom, his voice calm.
“Furthermore, you overlooked the most important problem.”
“Resources in themselves have no value.”
“What is truly valuable are the resources that are utilized.”
“No matter how many Divinity Points there are, they are merely cold numbers.”
“Only by transforming these resources into strength, letting believers grow, letting the Divine Kingdom evolve, and making oneself become even stronger do they truly possess meaning.”
“Yang Da, do you know what is the fairest thing in this current era?”
Yang Fan suddenly asked.
Yang Da was slightly stunned.
Although he was an intelligent lifeform with a massive database, at this moment he still couldn’t accurately guess what his own deity wanted to express.
“It is currency.”
Yang Fan gazed into the distance and slowly said.
“Under the rules of the Divine Kingdom, Faith Points and Divinity Points are the naturally irreplaceable currencies of this era.”
“They originate from the faith of believers and are a value system recognized by all gods, demigods, and Divine Beings.”
“And the speed of this currency’s depreciation depends on the quantity and development speed of gods, demigods, and Divine Beings throughout the entire Universe.”
“If there were no such naturally unified currency system, what do you think this world would become?”
A hint of a smile appeared on the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“I’m afraid all major factions would create currencies belonging to themselves.”
“The Sima Family issues Sima Coins, the Gu Family issues Gu Coins, the Han Family issues Han Coins...”
“In the end, this world would instead become incomparably chaotic.”

chapters.title: Chapter 402: Storing Troops
paragraphs: At this moment, a flash of mockery crossed Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Just like the military merit system on the frontline.”

“This is actually a currency system established by the Han Family Military Prefecture, except its circulation scope is limited to those personnel participating in the war and serving on the frontline.”
“Even so, this may still be one of the most important sources of wealth for the Han Family Military Prefecture.”
“Why can the Han Family do this? Because what it represents behind the scenes is power.”
Yang Fan’s voice gradually grew low.
“Only powerful people, powerful families, and powerful faction groups are qualified to control massive wealth.”
“Power can be transformed into massive wealth, and the root of power comes from the power one possesses or can control.”
“Therefore, if these Divinity Points continue to be placed in the Divine Kingdom, at most they are just a string of constantly growing numbers.”
“Only by investing them into the development of the Divine Kingdom, strengthening believers, expanding the army, and enhancing one’s own strength can they truly possess value.”
“I want to quickly enhance the strength of believers.”
“I want to expand the Divine Kingdom’s army.”
“I want to obtain more deity coordinates.”
“Only in this way can I grow at the fastest speed.”
“After possessing sufficiently powerful strength, can I gain a greater say.”
“And by that time, wealth will naturally gather towards me of its own accord.”
Yang Fan took a deep breath and continued,
“An essay I once saw in the Primordial City Library—the author once said something that I feel makes a lot of sense.”
“In this world, wealth has never been the highest level of pursuit; wealth is merely the shadow left behind by power and authority.”
“The weak chase wealth in order to change their fate.”
“The strong master wealth because they themselves already represent the rules.”
“Wealth is an appendage of power, and deities spend their entire lives unconsciously chasing power.”
Hearing this, Yang Da fell into silence.
“Divine Kingdom investment is ultimately just a minor path.”
Yang Fan looked toward his own Divine Kingdom.
“The ancients once said, eat to replenish what you lack.”
“Just like Origin Evolution, if one wants to become a person above others, ultimately they still have to eat people!”
Yang Da opened his mouth, unable to stop himself from sighing inwardly.
Ever since he “educated” his master back then, Yang Fan’s changes had truly been too massive.
As expected, things like books could truly change a person’s cognition.
Even deities were no exception.
“Master.”
Yang Da cupped his hands and said,
“If you wish to minimize contact with the Real World while consuming the Resources accumulated by the Divine Kingdom to enhance the Divine Kingdom’s combat power, there is another way.”
“Oh?”
Yang Fan looked at him.
“Let’s hear it.”
“Secret Realm,” Yang Da said.
Hearing this name, Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
Clearly, he hadn’t expected Yang Da to suddenly bring this up.
The so-called Secret Realms were formed when deities fell, their Divine Kingdoms shattered, and the original lands drifted within the the void.
After long years, countless Divine Kingdom fragments collided and fused with each other, ultimately forming a special Realm of heaven and earth.
Because they lost the constraints of complete Divine Kingdom rules, a large amount of special Resources would often be born within Secret Realms.
According to Level classifications, Secret Realms were divided into four Levels: Heaven, Earth, Mysterious, and Yellow.
Corresponding respectively to high-order Divine Kingdoms, mid-order Divine Kingdoms, low-order Divine Kingdoms, and Divine Kingdom fragments left behind by demigods.
Back when Yang Fan was still a freshman studying in Primordial City, under Sima Bang’s introduction, he had once entered a Yellow-grade Secret Realm controlled by the Sima Family.
But later, as the Divine Kingdom investment system gradually improved and Yang Fan obtained more and more Resources, he gradually ignored this channel.
“Talk about it in detail,” Yang Fan spoke up.
“Reporting to Master,”
Yang Da said.
“The greatest characteristic of a Secret Realm is that it lacks the restrictions of complete Divine Kingdom rules.”
“Therefore, the Spirit Plants, mineral veins, and various special Resources growing inside grow at a speed far exceeding the outside world.”
“To some extent, they naturally possess the effects of resource-type talents.”
“Therefore, major factions will all find ways to control Secret Realms, using them as stable resource production bases.”
Speaking up to here, Yang Da paused for a moment, then said earnestly:
“However, Master, a Secret Realm is not just a resource point; it is likewise a natural warfare base.”
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly.
“Warfare base?”
Yang Da said:
“That’s right. Similar to resource stars, Secret Realms can continuously output Resources.”
“But the difference is that Secret Realms are more suitable for stationing heavy troops.”
Hearing this, a sharp glint instantly flashed across Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Stationing troops...”
Yang Da nodded and continued:
“Resource planets like Spirit-Plant Planets and Spirit Vein Planets can likewise provide a massive amount of Resources, but in essence, they are merely resource production bases.”

“Although there are a large number of resource-type buildings within them, the Spiritual Qi attributes are relatively singular, making them only suitable for the growth of a certain type of resource, and not suitable as a place for believers to Cultivate for the long term.”
“But Secret Realms are different.”
“Secret Realms themselves evolved from the Divine Kingdom fragments of fallen deities, and partial rules of a complete Divine Kingdom remain within them.”
“Therefore, a deity can completely remodel the Secret Realm according to their own needs.”
“They can even build military camps inside and hoard a massive amount of military forces for the long term!”
“Moreover, as long as one possesses the Secret Realm coordinates, they can connect to the Divine Kingdom through a spatial passage.”
“Resources within the Divine Kingdom can be continuously transported over.”
“Utilizing the existing Resources of the Divine Kingdom, they can Cultivate a large batch of believer legions stationed abroad.”
“When a Divine Kingdom War breaks out in the future, they can even directly open spatial passages from the Secret Realm to dispatch a large army to support the battlefield.”
Speaking up to here, Yang Da’s tone became serious.

“In theory, as long as the Divine Kingdom has sufficient resource supplies and simultaneously masters a sufficient number of Secret Realms, then the number of believers does not possess a true upper limit.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes grew brighter and brighter.
“Such a good method to enhance one’s own strength, why are you only telling me now?”
Yang Da was silent for a moment, then respectfully explained:
“Reporting to Master, everything has a price.”
“With Master’s current identity, wanting to obtain a private Secret Realm is perhaps not difficult.”
“But wanting to store troops long-term in this manner incurs a consumption that is likewise extremely terrifying.”
“Most importantly, Secret Realms, just like resource stars, will not receive the blessings of Divine Kingdom talents.”
“In other words, whether it is the growth speed or breakthrough efficiency, believers Cultivating in the Secret Realm will be far lower than native believers of the Divine Kingdom.”
“With Master’s current strength, you are already practically invincible among the same Realm.”
“This subordinate believes that at the current stage, there is no need to invest such massive Resources to Cultivate a Secret Realm legion.”
After listening, Yang Fan merely shook his head.
“No, your considerations only apply to the present.”
“What I need to consider is the future.”

“Now that the Procreation-type talent has been upgraded to A-Level, under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the number of believers will soon reach the carrying limit of the Divine Kingdom’s area.”
“By that time, continuing to restrict the number of believers will instead be a waste.”
“And storing troops in Secret Realms can precisely resolve this problem.”

chapters.title: Chapter 403: I Am a Relatively Proud Person
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s gaze was deep.
“More importantly, the enemies I will face in the future may not necessarily be just a single deity alone.”
“Wars between deities are never a simple one-on-one; many deities will choose to form offensive and defensive alliances.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s eyes gradually became firm.
“But I will not cooperate with other Human race deities.”
“My Divine Kingdom coordinates, the combat strength of my believers, and the trump cards I possess cannot be easily exposed.”
“Therefore, I am destined to walk a lonely path.”
“That being the case, I must prepare in advance for all situations.”
“Compared to safety in war, what are mere Resources consumption?”
Hearing this, Yang Da immediately understood Yang Fan’s thoughts.
“Wise master, this subordinate understands.”
“I will immediately formulate the Divine Kingdom reform route and the believer elimination mechanism.”
“Those believers whose Realm improvement speed is slower and whose talent potential is insufficient will be gradually transferred into the Secret Realm to Cultivate.”
“When the Divine Kingdom War breaks out in the future, these believers in the Secret Realm can serve as the first batch of vanguard troops thrown into the battlefield.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Very well, but between the Secret Realm and the main Divine Kingdom, a complete personnel mobility mechanism must be established.”
“Only in this way can the enthusiasm of the believers be maintained.”
“If a place always has the best Resources, after a long time, it will instead cause believers to lose their enterprising spirit.”
Yang Fan looked deep into the Divine Kingdom.
“The current Divine Kingdom environment is indeed too good.”
“These believers also need a certain amount of pressure.”
“There are various ranks in the Real World, and it is precisely because of gaps that desires are born.”
“Some people want to change their social class, so they work hard to Cultivate, strive to create wealth, and strive to climb upwards.”
“The Divine Kingdom should be the same.”
“If all believers enjoy rich Resources treatment, in the end, it will only wear away their motivation and turn them into lazy people.”
“Competition and pressure are the root causes of civilization’s continuous progress.”
Yang Da said respectfully:
“Wise master, please think of a way as soon as possible to obtain the coordinates of the first Secret Realm.”
“This subordinate will prepare the reform work within the Divine Kingdom in advance.”
Yang Fan nodded.
Afterwards, his consciousness gradually detached from the Divine Kingdom and returned to the Real World.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes, and before him was still the familiar villa room.
And the time in the Real World had only passed a short few quarters of an hour.
Everything that happened in the Divine Kingdom left almost no trace for reality.
“Secret Realm...”
Yang Fan muttered in a low voice.
“The Gu Family side does have a resource star trading area, but things like Secret Realm seem to have never been publicly listed for trade.”
“It seems that this kind of thing is still more troublesome than I imagined.”
He pondered slightly.
“Let’s ask Wan’er first.”
“The Lu Clan has invested so much, perhaps they have channels in this regard.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan got up and left the room, walking towards the work area on the second floor of the villa.
Before pushing open the door, he heard a cold voice coming from inside.
“Tell me, why?”
“How much was the budget I gave you? What was the goal? What was the result you finally handed over to me?”
“For a project worth 300 billion Divinity Points, your final quotation actually exceeded the market average price by twenty percent!”
“Do you know what this means?”
“It means we actively gave the profits to others!”
Inside the room, Lu Wan sat in front of the desk.
At this moment, she completely lacked the charm she usually showed in front of Yang Fan.
Dressed in a professional suit, with her long hair coiled up, her gaze sharp, her whole body exuded the aura belonging to a controller.
The other end of the phone seemed to still be explaining, yet Lu Wan didn’t give the other party too much opportunity at all.
“Don’t talk to me about market changes.”
“As the project leader, if you can’t even make the most basic information judgment, what is the meaning of me wanting you to sit in this position?”
“And the issue of companion bidding, have I ever told you that commercial competition is not about letting you honestly wait for others to play their cards?”
“You can’t even find a few suitable companion bidders to create the illusion of competition?”
“Is this your first time in charge of a project, or your first time entering the company?”
The other end of the phone fell silent.
Lu Wan leaned back in her chair, her tone still ice-cold.
“Before tomorrow, hand over the complete report to me.”
“If you can’t even handle this little matter well, voluntarily apply for a transfer.”
“Clap!”
The phone was hung up.
Right at this moment.
“Knock knock.”
Yang Fan gently knocked on the door.
Lu Wan instinctively looked up.
After seeing the person standing at the door, her originally indifferent expression changed instantly.
“Husband?”
The next second.
Lu Wan, who had just reprimanded her subordinates like a business queen, instantly switched to another appearance.
She got up and walked over quickly, directly hooking her arm around Yang Fan’s.
“Husband, why did you come upstairs?”
“At this time normally, aren’t you usually doing spa downstairs?”
Within her tone, it was full of spoiled coquettishness.
Looking at this scene before him, Yang Fan couldn’t help but find it somewhat amused.
The decisive female president on the phone just now and the little woman snuggling beside him now didn’t look like the same person at all.
“What?”
“I miss Wan’er, is that not allowed?”
Yang Fan said with a smile.
He glanced at the desk.
“The way my Wan’er was reprimanding people just now was really impressive.”
“The other party was scolded by you like that, aren’t you afraid of his angry?”
Hearing this, Lu Wan gave a soft hum.
“angry?”
“What qualification does he have for angry?”
“He’s just a sixth-order deity whose potential has already been exhausted, and who knows what method he used to get connected with my Lu Clan.”
“Later, he was introduced by my friend to an affiliated construction company, where he became the director of the business management department.”
“As a result, he is conventional in his work and lacks a shred of enterprising spirit.”
“This kind of person, if not for the sake of friendship, I would have already told him to get lost.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help smiling: “My Wan’er is still the best.”
I have to admit that if solely discussing personal ability, Lu Wan is indeed very outstanding.
She is different from Gu Le.
Gu Le relies more on Clan Resources and identity advantages.
But Lu Wan is a controller of the enterprise in the true sense.
The large number of industries she holds in her hands are not simply nominal, but she truly participates in operations and management, being a true female president.
“Of course.”
Lu Wan raised her chin, then leaned against Yang Fan’s embrace again.
“Who told my husband to spend money so extravagantly.”
“One hundred trillion Divinity Points, saying he doesn’t want it and just throwing it away.”
“Must I not think of a way to earn a little more?”
“Otherwise, what if one day it really gets squandered away by you, this silly husband?”
She complained with her mouth, but her face was full of smiles.
Hearing this, a trace of imperceptible embarrassment flashed in the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
“I am still very cautious when spending money normally.”
“It’s just...”
He paused for a moment.
“I am a relatively proud person.”
“If I really accept such a large sum of financial support, I’m afraid others will talk behind my back and say I live off a woman.”
Lu Wan looked up at Yang Fan and suddenly smiled.
“It doesn’t matter, I just like letting husband eat.”
“Besides, what problem is there with me supporting my own man?”

Yang Fan looked at this appearance of hers, and couldn’t help muttering inwardly in his heart: “Sister Ruyan’s methods are still too terrifying; how did she adjust a business powerhouse into this current state.”

chapters.title: Chapter 404: Risks of the Secret Realm
paragraphs: Yang Fan quickly pulled his thoughts back on track and said seriously, “Wan’er, I want to ask you about something.”
“Do you have a channel where I can purchase Secret Realm coordinates?”
Hearing this, the smile on Lu Wan’s face gradually faded.
“Secret Realm?”
“Husband, do you want to invest in a Secret Realm?”
Yang Fan nodded, “I have such thoughts.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan fell into deep thought.
After a moment, she slowly said:
“Husband, investing in a Secret Realm is actually not easy to do.”
“Secret Realm coordinates are expensive, and the investment return cycle is extremely long, sometimes even longer than resource stars.”
“More importantly... there are risks.”
“Risks?” Yang Fan slightly frowned.
“That’s right,” Lu Wan explained seriously.
“Secret Realms are different from resource stars.”
“Secret Realm coordinates are fixed, which means the person who sells the Secret Realm definitely knows its location.”
“The Divine Kingdom world is not completely protected by federal law.”
“They sell you the Secret Realm, and then a few years later, after you invest a lot of Resources to develop it, they send troops to take it back.”
“Even some more shameless merchants turn around and organize forces to plunder it right after the transaction is completed.”
“Therefore, those who can truly control Secret Realms for a long time are often top-tier Families with deep foundations.”
“They will arrange powerful believers to garrison them, and even if an accident really happens, they will immediately mobilize Clan strength to retake them.”
Lu Wan said slowly.
“Things like Secret Realms are not purely investments in essence.”
“They are more like a game of strength.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“In other words, High-Order Gods might also dispatch troops to fight for Secret Realms?”
Lu Wan nodded.
“That is indeed the case in essence.”
“Secret Realms are not restricted by Divine Kingdom rules, so theoretically any god can send troops to conquer them.”
“However, Secret Realms also have Levels.”

“Heaven-Rank Secret Realms are mostly fought over among High-Order Gods; Earth-grade Secret Realms belong to the battlefield of Mid-tier Gods; as for Xuan-grade and Yellow-grade Secret Realms, they are basically competitions among Low-rank Deitys.”
“Under normal circumstances, High-Order Gods would not lower their status to fight for low-Level Secret Realms.”
Yang Fan nodded thoughtfully, then continued to ask:
“If I send troops to garrison the Secret Realm and it is eventually breached by other gods, will my Divine Kingdom coordinates be exposed because of this?”
This was the problem he cared about the most.
For Yang Fan, even if all the believers garrisoning the Secret Realm were completely annihilated by the enemy, he could completely accept it.

After all, with the Hundredfold Evolution Talent and A-Level Life Reproduction talent, believers were replenished at an extremely fast speed, and if a batch was lost, they could be cultivated again very quickly.
But if his Divine Kingdom coordinates were exposed because of this, the nature of the matter would be completely different.
If such a risk really existed, the Secret Realm troop deployment plan would have to be reconsidered.
Hearing this, Lu Wan gently shook her head.
“That won’t happen. Secret Realms are ownerless lands in the first place, and their original gods have long since fallen.”
“According to Divine Kingdom rules, even if all the believers in the Secret Realm die in battle, only the original master of the Divine Kingdom can capture spatial fluctuations.”
“Wars between external gods will not expose each other’s Divine Kingdom coordinates because of this.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan immediately breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
As long as the Divine Kingdom coordinates were not exposed, everything was still acceptable.
Even if he couldn’t win in the end, what he would lose was just a batch of believers, as well as the Divinity Points used to purchase the Secret Realm coordinates.
And these things were completely affordable for him now.
What’s more, with his current strength, he only needed to purchase Xuan-grade or Yellow-grade Secret Realms.
Secret Realms of this level naturally wouldn’t have too high of a risk.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan smiled and said:
“Understood, but I still want to give it a try.”
“Mostly out of curiosity.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan couldn’t help showing a thoughtful look.
“I do have quite a few Secret Realm coordinates on hand.”
“However, those Secret Realms are shared with other friends and do not belong to me personally, so there is no way to directly transfer them to Husband.”
“But if Husband wants to manage a Secret Realm alone, there is a good opportunity recently.”
“What opportunity?” Yang Fan asked immediately.
“The Han Family Military Prefecture.”
Lu Wan continued to explain:
“If we talk about which of the Five Great Families controls the most Secret Realms, none other than the Han Family.”
“The Han Family is mainly a military force, and the development direction of their Divine Kingdom mostly leans towards the warfare faction.”
“Compared to investing in resource stars, they prefer managing Secret Realms.”
“After all, the last thing the Han Family lacks is a large army that can garrison Secret Realms for a long time.”
Speaking of this, Lu Wan suddenly smiled.
“I was originally planning to talk to Husband about this matter tonight.”
“I know a Peerless Prodigy of the Han Family named Han Jue.”
“He and I are from the same cohort, and our relationship is quite good.”
“He just sent me a message inviting me to tonight’s dinner, and he specifically mentioned that I could bring Clan members along.”
“I think we can take this opportunity to introduce Husband to him.”
“Han Jue’s status in the Han Family is not low, and this is an extremely strong connection. If Husband wants to purchase Secret Realm coordinates, maybe you can bridge the gap through him.”
“Han Jue?”
Yang Fan frowned slightly.
This name... he always felt a bit familiar, as if he had heard it somewhere before.
It’s just that for a moment he couldn’t remember it no matter what.
After pondering for a moment, he did not pursue it further.
“Sure.”
Yang Fan nodded with a smile.
“I’ve been staying in the villa recently, besides lying down, it’s kneeling.”
“It’s also time to go out and get some fresh air.”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan’s mind instantly conjured up certain images.
Her originally fair and pretty face instantly blushed with a layer of crimson.
She shyly and angrily waved her small fist and gently hammered Yang Fan’s chest, “Pervert!”
That afternoon.
Yang Fan and Lu Wan took a private airship and left the villa.
As the airship slowly rose into the air, outside the transparent cabin, the entire the frontline city gradually came into view.
“Husband.”
Lu Wan sat aside and softly explained:
“The residential areas of the Five Great Families are actually not far apart.”

“However, most of the Han Family’s core strength is in the military, so in this the frontline area, the residence of the Han Family’s direct descendants is also the safest place in the entire the frontline.”
Yang Fan nodded and didn’t speak.
His gaze passed through the airship glass, looking at the city scenery flashing by below.
The the frontline area was much larger than imagined.
As they moved further towards the core direction of the frontline, the environment began to change gradually.
Tall buildings became fewer and fewer, replaced by independent manors.
Large areas of greenery covered both sides of the road, and intelligent robots were working methodically.
Pruning trees, maintaining lawns, and clearing roads.
The entire area was quiet and neat.
These plants were not rare Spirit Plants, but after careful design, they gave an extremely comfortable feeling.
Simple, natural, yet full of vitality.
It was as if a man-made utopia had been forcibly carved out in the cold the frontline city.

chapters.title: Chapter 405: Lu Wan's Connections
paragraphs: Watching this scene, a trace of emotion flashed through Yang Fan’s eyes.
Both were part of the the frontline.
Yet the living environments of different people seemed to completely belong to two different worlds.
The the frontline trading area was bustling with people and extremely noisy.
Those ordinary demigods rushed around for resources, working hard every day to enhance the strength of their believers.
Meanwhile, the Divine Beings in the production bases could only live in small, cramped collective areas for long periods.
Yet the core area where the Five Great Families resided possessed independent manors, perfect environments, and even specialized intelligent lifeform responsible for maintaining their daily lives.
I am afraid those demigods and Divine Beings living on the outer edges of the trading area would never know that such a place existed deep within the the frontline.
They probably always believed that the the frontline meant danger, chaos, and hardship.
Little did they know that for those truly standing at the pinnacle, the the frontline could likewise become a place to enjoy resources and power.
“Are these the Five Great Families...”
Yang Fan murmured in a low voice.
Afterward, he could not help but gently let out a sigh.
Fortunately, he had become a son-in-law of the Gu Family.

Otherwise, once he graduated from Primordial City and came to the the frontline for service according to the normal procedures, he probably would only be able to live in the outer area like the vast majority of people.
Not only would his living conditions be poor, lacking private space, but he would also have to constantly bear unknown dangers.
In this world, everything could never be changed purely by hard work alone.
A person’s life was actually a process of constantly climbing upwards.
Hard work was important, but choices were even more important.
Sometimes, choosing the right direction and seizing the opportunity was more crucial than simply burying oneself in hard work.
Because with the same effort, standing in different positions might yield completely different ultimate results.
The airship continued forward.
Soon, a huge manor appeared within their field of vision.
The airship slowly descended and finally stopped outside a quaint pavilion.
Almost the moment the airship steadied, dozens of intelligent robots greeted them.
“Welcome, Young Miss Lu.”
“Welcome, Mr. Yang.”
The leading intelligent robot slightly bowed, then gestured with its hand.
“Please come with me.”
Under the guidance of the intelligent robot, Yang Fan and Lu Wan slowly walked into the Han Family’s manor.
After entering the manor.
Yang Fan did not deliberately release his aura, but his powerful Mental Strength still swept across the entire area like an invisible tide in an instant.
The next moment, his gaze shifted slightly.
“There are actually so many deities here?”
Within the entire manor, the auras of deities exceeded a hundred.
The vast majority of them were low-tier deities, but there were also a few auras that were clearly much stronger.
Moreover... there were also a few familiar auras among them.
“Sima Tianci?”
“Gu Jiuheng?”
Yang Fan felt somewhat surprised in his heart, not expecting that these two people were actually here as well.
At this moment, inside a grand hall at the very center of the manor.
Sima Tianci and Gu Jiuheng were sitting together, holding wine glasses in their hands, and conversing with several other deities.
Aside from the central hall, the entire manor was likewise extremely lively.
Male and female deities dressed in exquisite formal attire were conversing in low voices within the garden.
Intelligent robot waiters shuttled among the crowd, holding transparent ceremonial trays in their hands.
Various precious spiritual fruits and fine wines were placed on top, waiting for guests to take them at any time.
With just a glance, Yang Fan had already deduced that this was a large-scale evening banquet.
However, there was an obvious stratification here.
The outer areas mostly consisted of deities with weaker strength or ordinary identities.
And the closer one got to the central hall, the higher the represented identity and status.
The people there either possessed powerful personal strength, such as Gu Jiuheng,
or had extraordinary identities, such as direct descendants like Sima Tianci who were being groomed as successors by their Clan.
“Husband.”
Lu Wan lowered her head and glanced at the invitation letter.
“The seating arrangement Han Jue made for us is inside the hall.”
“Let’s head over.”
Yang Fan nodded. “Alright.”

The two of them looked just like a real married couple, slowly walking toward the direction of the hall.
Having walked only a few steps, a middle-aged man took the initiative to greet them.
“Young Miss Lu.”
“Years have passed, I did not expect that you too would graduate from Primordial Academy.”
There was an obvious smile on the other person’s face.
“That emergency loan provided to me by your esteemed company back then really helped me a lot.”
“In the future, if Young Miss Lu has any needs, just speak up.”
Lu Wan smiled slightly.
“President Ma is too polite.”
“Brother Han is still waiting for me, so I will head over first.”
“Please go ahead, Young Miss Lu.” Hearing this, the other person hurriedly stepped aside to make way, with an extremely respectful attitude.
The two of them continued moving forward.
At this moment, an exquisitely dressed and alluring female deity in the crowd raised her wine glass and spoke with a smile:
“President Lu.”
“This time we are not attending a banquet in the Virtual World, why did you even bring a little boyfriend along?”
Lu Wan introduced in a calm tone, “This is my husband.”
Hearing these words, the smile on the other person’s face froze for a split second.
Immediately afterward, an apologetic look appeared.
“Apologies, apologies.”
“In the past, President Lu always attended various banquets alone, so I misunderstood for a moment.”
She hurriedly looked at Yang Fan, “Excuse me.”
Yang Fan merely smiled and nodded, not minding it at all.
But at this moment, the gazes of quite a few people around had successively fallen upon him, filled with curiosity and probing.
After all, the name Lu Wan was not unfamiliar among the younger generation of deities.
Although the other person had just graduated from Primordial Academy not long ago.
Yet under the support of Lu Yanran, she had long since controlled the actual management rights of a large number of listed companies.
Among the younger generation of the Human race over the past hundred years, Lu Wan could definitely be considered a figure of illustrious fame.
Her openly referring to Yang Fan as “husband” just now naturally carried a different significance.
This meant that the two of them had already completed a marital relationship recognized by federal law.
And those capable of attending this banquet basically all possessed a certain status.
They naturally knew clearly that what Lu Wan represented behind her was not just a young Genius, but an entire set of massive commercial resources and the support of the Lu Clan.
Therefore, they were naturally filled with interest towards Yang Fan, who was able to become Lu Wan’s husband.
However, Lu Wan obviously had no intention of stopping to introduce him in detail.
She merely gave a few brief responses before directly pulling Yang Fan towards the hall.
“Wan’er.”
Yang Fan chuckled in a low voice:
“You know quite a lot of people.”
Lu Wan shook her head gently.
“However, they are just polite business pleasantries.”
“These people are either deities who married into the Five Great Families, or targets invested in and supported by the Five Great Families.”
“Therefore, they all have some status to varying degrees.”
“Normally when doing business, I naturally come into contact with them personally.”
Speaking of this, she suddenly stuck out her tongue playfully.
“Otherwise, Husband, how do you think my title of’social butterfly’ came about?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan could not help but laugh out loud.
Lu Wan continued:
“I do not just interact with those classmates from Primordial Academy.”
“Deities with status across various main stars, shareholders of mainboard listed companies, and Geniuses who have cooperative relationships with the Five Great Families.”
“I know quite a few of these people.”
As she spoke these words, there was a trace of small pride in her tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: A Chance Encounter
paragraphs: Yang Fan couldn’t help teasing, “Impressive, but since you know so many people, why don’t you introduce your husband?”
Lu Wan glanced at him and then said seriously,
“Of course I’ll introduce him.”
“However... it’s the people inside.”
With that, she pointed toward the direction of the hall.
Just then, a few somewhat familiar figures suddenly walked toward Yang Fan.
Moreover, their target wasn’t Lu Wan, but Yang Fan.
“Brother Yang, I didn’t expect that after a few years apart, you’ve already reached this step.”
“Congratulations.”
The four figures stopped in front of Yang Fan with smiles on their faces.
Yang Fan was slightly stunned.
After seeing clearly who they were, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
He indeed knew these four people, and they were all members of the Five Great Families.
They were precisely the other four prodigies who had co-hosted the God-Sealing Tournament of Prodigies with Sima Tianci back then at the Primordial Academy.
He hadn’t expected that after graduating and coming to the frontline, he would be able to meet them again.
Before Yang Fan could speak, Lu Wan on the side proactively smiled and greeted them.
“Cousin Lu Chengyuan, and three other cousins.”
“I didn’t expect you guys to know my husband.”
Hearing Lu Wan’s address, the four of them were visibly stunned.
Then Han Wuji quickly waved his hand.
“President Lu is too polite, Brother Yang and we only met once back then.”
“We happened to run into each other today, so we came over to say hello.”
His tone carried a clear sense of restraint.
Although they belonged to the Five Great Families, obvious status gaps still existed within the families.
Not to mention that their own Human Federation ratings were only Grade A talents.
Just in terms of background, their elders were far from comparable to big figures standing at the top of the Human race like Lu Yanran.
What’s more, although Lu Wan was not old, she was already one of the key business helmsmen nurtured by the Lu Clan, holding a massive amount of industries in her hands.
Therefore, Lu Wan suddenly calling them “cousin” actually left a few of them momentarily unsure of how to respond.
“Then we’ll go in first,” Lu Wan said politely, “Let’s keep in touch if there’s a chance in the future.”
“Please go ahead, President Lu.”
The few quickly made way.
Watching along the way as those deities actively greeted Lu Wan, even carrying a hint of ingratiation.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
He had to admit that this wife of his was indeed formidable.
You must know, Lu Wan was only a year or two older than him.
If Divine Kingdom Talent was not considered, just comparing personal abilities.
Lu Wan was probably far stronger than him, and could even be said to completely crush him.
Just before entering the hall, Yang Fan’s gaze suddenly glanced toward a corner nearby.
Just now he had sensed a trace of faint malice.
Although that emotion was hidden extremely deeply and appeared for an extremely short time.
With his Mental Strength, he was still able to capture it.
At the corner, a figure had his back turned to him.
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
“Graduated early, huh?”
“Without the War God Codex, to actually be able to break through to a deity this fast.”
“It seems you’ve been through a lot these past few years.”
With Yang Fan’s current Mental Strength.
Even if the other party had their back to him, he could easily see that person’s appearance clearly.
Ma Huainan, a Genius who entered the Primordial Academy in the same cohort as him.
According to normal circumstances, the other party should be like Gu Le, with about another half a year before coming to the frontline.
But now that Ma Huainan had appeared here, it clearly meant that he had already completed his breakthrough during his senior year, becoming a deity in advance.
Yang Fan lightly licked his lips.
Then he ignored it and entered the hall together with Lu Wan.
The interior space of the hall was even wider than it looked from the outside.
However, compared to the bustle outside, this place appeared rather quiet.
Not too many people were gathered in the large hall.
Yang Fan and Lu Wan had just entered when they immediately attracted the gazes of quite a few people.
Right at this moment, Gu Jiuheng’s figure walked over.
He came up to Yang Fan and directly reached out to pat his shoulder.
“Haha, you brat, you’re finally here.”
Clap!
With a soft sound, Gu Jiuheng’s palm fell.
However, the next second, his expression changed slightly.
Because he felt that his palm was vaguely aching.
Gu Jiuheng glanced at Yang Fan, then looked at his own hand, and couldn’t help complaining:
“You guy, didn’t you cultivate three routes simultaneously?”
“Why is your physical strength so exaggerated?”
“You didn’t secretly choose to major in the Martial Arts route, did you?”
Yang Fan smiled and didn’t answer, only saying politely, “Brother Jiuheng, long time no see.”
Gu Jiuheng rolled his eyes.
“You brat, if Little Brother Han hadn’t told me, I wouldn’t even know you got married again.”
As he spoke, he glanced at Lu Wan beside him.
“And it’s with President Lu.”
His tone was filled with complexity.
Actually, when he first heard that Yang Fan had gotten married again, Gu Jiuheng had thought about backing up Gu Le.
He even thought about making Yang Fan understand who the real legitimate wife was.
But after hearing later that the target was Lu Wan, that thought vanished instantly.
What a joke.
Who was Lu Wan?
A commercial Genius of the Lu Clan.
One of the figures in the young generation of the Human Federation who truly controlled massive industries.
More crucially... he also had a few low-interest loans in his hands, which were provided by Lu Wan’s subsidiary company.
Therefore, looking at Yang Fan right now, Gu Jiuheng’s eyes even carried a trace of envy.
This soft rice... was eaten much too deliciously.
Even he felt like asking Yang Fan for some experience.
“Little Brother Han?” Hearing this title, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
Confusion appeared on his face.
Logically speaking, the matter of his marriage with Lu Wan was not widely publicized, and not many people should know about it.
“Han Jue,” Gu Jiuheng explained.
“Your classmate from the Primordial Academy.”
Hearing this name, Yang Fan immediately looked at Lu Wan.
And Lu Wan was equally puzzled at this moment.
Clearly, she also hadn’t expected that Han Jue had actually known her husband for a long time.
Right at this moment, a figure slowly walked out from the back of the hall.
As the host of this banquet, he naturally attracted everyone’s gazes.
Yang Fan raised his head and looked over.
The next moment, his gaze narrowed slightly.
Yang Fan finally understood why hearing the name “Han Jue” gave him a faint sense of familiarity.
So it was him.
Wasn’t this the person he met in the Level 3 Area of the Alien Divine Realm Zone?
The two of them had only crossed paths once back then.
Although the other party had proactively stated his name, Yang Fan didn’t take it too much to heart back then.
After all, both parties had merely met by chance.
He originally thought that the two of them wouldn’t have any more intersections afterward.
He didn’t expect to run into him so soon, and the other party was even the host of this banquet.
“Husband.”
Lu Wan looked at Yang Fan with some surprise, “Do you really know Han Jue?”
Yang Fan nodded, “A chance encounter.”
“Oh?”
Hearing this, the corners of Lu Wan’s mouth curved up slightly.
“Husband, looking at your relationship, it doesn’t look like you’ve only met once.”

chapters.title: Chapter 407: You Actually Want to Be My Father?
paragraphs: Lu Wan’s tone carried a hint of banter.
Because at that moment, Han Jue had already discovered them.
And headed right over immediately.
Most importantly... Han Jue’s gaze remained fixed on Yang Fan, even faintly carrying a trace of excitement.
With Lu Wan’s years of experience in business, she naturally wouldn’t misjudge.
This kind of emotion was definitely not mere politeness.
A person’s attitude could be disguised, but gazes are hard to fake.
Han Jue’s behavior right now meant either he wanted to deliberately ingratiate himself with Yang Fan.
Or the two of them genuinely had a very good relationship and hadn’t seen each other for many years, which was why he was so excited.
Yet in Lu Wan’s eyes, what kind of status did Han Jue have?
A direct descendant of the Han Family, a Peerless Prodigy certified by the Human Federation.
For a figure like this, even knowing Yang Fan’s potential was astonishing, at most they should only have equal interactions and exchanges of interests.
Wanting Han Jue to proactively display this kind of attitude was practically impossible.
Therefore, the only explanation was...
The two of them genuinely had a very good relationship, and it wasn’t as simple as ordinary friends.
Thinking of this, Lu Wan couldn’t help but pout her lips.
In the gaze she directed at Yang Fan, there was a trace of a tiny grievance.
She had originally thought of taking advantage of today’s opportunity to introduce her husband to the prodigies of this generation from the Five Great Families.
To let Yang Fan get to know more people and expand his future network circle.
As it turned out, before she had even started introducing, Yang Fan actually already knew the host of the banquet.
And by the look of it, the relationship between the two wasn’t simple either.
What made her most angry was... this fellow actually hadn’t told her all along.
He even put on an appearance of completely not knowing each other.
Fooling even her, his wife.
“Acting mysterious in front of your wife, is it very interesting?”
The more Lu Wan thought about it, the angrier she became. Taking advantage of the surroundings where no one was paying attention, she reached out and fiercely pinched Yang Fan’s lower back.
“Hiss!”
Yang Fan’s body stiffened slightly, looking at her with some puzzlement.
“Wan’er, what are you doing?”
Lu Wan let out a light snort, “Reflect on yourself.”
Yang Fan: “???”
He wore a blank look on his face, completely unaware of what he had done.
Just as the two were exchanging glances, Han Jue had already walked up close.
The next moment, amidst the surprised gazes of the many deities surrounding them.
Han Jue directly opened his arms and gave Yang Fan a big hug.
“Brother Yang!”
“You graduated early from Primordial Academy and came to the frontline, how come you didn’t contact me at all?”
“It’s all my fault; our Han Family disciples have too many things on the frontline and are usually busy handling all kinds of matters, actually forgetting to host a welcoming banquet for brother!”
Han Jue’s tone was incomparably familiar.
That appearance was as if the two of them were old friends who had known each other for many years.
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
Looking at the incomparably enthusiastic Han Jue before him, a trace of doubt couldn’t help but rise in his heart.
“What kind of person can be a social butterfly to such a degree?”
“Clearly we’ve only met once.”
“How come it feels like we grew up together since childhood?”
“Could it be... this is just his personality?”
Yang Fan took a deep breath, then slowly spoke:
“Greetings, Han Jue... cousin.”
Regarding this form of address, he didn’t feel there was any problem.
After all, among the Five Great Families of the Human Federation, complex relationships had long been formed through countless years of marriage alliances.
You have me in you, and I have you in me.
Among the Five Great Families, many members of the younger generation had kinship relations.
Now that Yang Fan had married Gu Le and Lu Wan at the same time.
Calculated according to this relationship, he could probably pull off some connection with any family.
Therefore, calling Han Jue a cousin could be considered reasonable.
However, upon hearing this form of address, Han Jue directly waved his hand.
“Since when has Brother Yang been so polite?”
“Calling me cousin is too distant.”
“From now on, we are real brothers!”
Saying this, Han Jue very naturally patted Yang Fan’s shoulder.
“Brother Yang, with a virtuous helper like President Lu, I suppose you certainly won’t lack for divine kingdom Resources.”
“However, I, Han Jue, still have a bit of say on the frontline.”
“In the future, if you encounter any trouble, just come find me.”
“I dare not say anything else, but in this area of the frontline, whatever help I can give, I will definitely give.”
Han Jue patted his chest and said earnestly.

Within their eyes, they were filled with curiosity.

The son-in-law of the Third Elder of the Gu Family.
During the Primordial Academy period, he had once defeated an Alien Demigod in the tier-three battlefield of the Alien Divine Realm Zone.
What’s more, during his junior year, he broke through to the deity Realm ahead of time.
Any one of these matters, casually pulled out, was enough to make peers look sideways in astonishment.
Even in the eyes of those top second-generation heirs of the Five Great Families, Yang Fan could definitely be considered a true Genius.
It was just that they hadn’t expected that this outsider Genius, besides knowing how to marry wives.
In private, actually had such a profound relationship with a Peerless Prodigy like Han Jue.
You must know, Han Jue was not an ordinary Genius.
As a direct descendant of the Han Family, and evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy by the Human Federation, he was destined to become one of the core figures of the Han Family in the future.
Being able to make Han Jue display such a close attitude already explained many problems in itself.
A great reputation is never undeserved.
Only at this moment did everyone realize that the energy possessed by this young man himself was probably likewise not to be underestimated.
“Brother Yang.”
Han Jue didn’t care in the slightest about the surrounding people’s gazes, directly picking up a cup of wine and handing it over.
“This is the specialty blazing fire wine of my Han Family’s divine kingdom.”
“Taste the flavor.”
Yang Fan took the wine glass and gently took a sip.
Upon entering the mouth, a scorching sensation instantly spread out.
However, for Yang Fan, whose Physical Body was currently powerful, it did not cause any impact at all.
“Not bad.” Yang Fan nodded.
Han Jue smiled with satisfaction, then pulled over a youth beside him.
“Brother Yang, let me introduce a few friends to you.”
“This is Qin Zheng of the Qin Family; his mother is my maternal aunt.”
“Calculated, this fellow can also be considered my little brother.”
Saying this, Han Jue very naturally placed his hand on Qin Zheng’s shoulder, looking like brothers of deep affection.
Hearing these words, Qin Zheng immediately rolled his eyes.
“Who is your little brother?”
“If it weren’t for my mom telling me to yield to you, did you think you could act arrogant for so many years?”
“I would have beaten you until you called me dad long ago.”
Hearing this, Han Jue’s expression instantly turned exaggerated.
“What?”
“You actually want to be my dad?”
“Does Auntie know about this matter?”
Han Jue deliberately put on a shocked expression.
Qin Zheng opened his mouth, looked at the surrounding gazes, and held it in for a long time.
Finally, with a flush face, he spat out a single word: “Scram!”
Hhahahaha!
This scene instantly livened up the atmosphere of the entire hall.
Quite a few people couldn’t help laughing out loud.
“Little Brother Qin.”
“When it comes to bickering, you’d better not compare with Brother Han.”
“After all, when he becomes shameless, there really is no lower limit.”
Someone nearby spoke with a smile, easing the awkwardness for Qin Zheng.
Qin Zheng fiercely glared at Han Jue.
But clearly, the relationship between the two was genuinely good.

chapters.title: Chapter 408: What on Earth Is Going On?
paragraphs: Afterward, Han Jue continued to introduce the others to Yang Fan.
“This is my clan brother, Han Zhen.”
“He currently serves as the brigade commander of the 26th Legion at the frontline.”
“He once led ten Human race gods to frontally breach the divine kingdoms of several third-order zerg gods.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s gaze fell upon the middle-aged man.
Han Zhen had a robust build and a resolute face. His square face made him look extremely dignified.
Especially his eyes, which were deep and calm.
Yang Fan quietly swept his Mental Strength across him.
And perceived the other party’s approximate strength.
Han Zhen’s strength was even above Gu Jiuheng’s, and he was probably not far from a breakthrough to a Tier 4 God.
Not only that, but the other party’s Physical Body also emitted a faint hint of Evil Qi.
It was obvious that Han Zhen walked the Martial Route.
Moreover, the Cultivation Method practiced by his believers was probably also extremely special.
“Xiaoque’s friends are friends of the Han Family.”
Han Zhen looked at Yang Fan and nodded slightly.
“Brother Yang.”
“If you want to join the legion and participate in the Alien Divine Kingdom War in the future, you can contact me directly.”
“Although the frontline is dangerous, it is also the fastest place to enhance a divine kingdom’s foundation.”
“If there’s a chance, we can fight side by side.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan returned the salute earnestly, “Thank you, Big Brother Han Zhen.”
Han Jue continued to introduce everyone in the hall to Yang Fan.
“This is Sima Tianci.”
“He is a candidate for the future head of the Sima Family.”
“Brother Yang should already know him, so I won’t introduce him much.”
After speaking, Han Jue looked at a woman beside them.
“This is Sima Yurao.”
When mentioning this name, Han Jue’s expression was obviously a bit unnatural.
“This Big Sister Yurao insisted on meeting Brother Yang no matter what.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but look at the other party.
His gaze condensed slightly. The woman before him looked to be around thirty years old.
Her appearance was not the aggressively flamboyant kind, but rather possessed a dignified and graceful aesthetic.
Her facial features were soft yet carried a hint of dignity, instead giving people a mature and steady feeling.
But what truly caught Yang Fan’s attention was not her appearance.
Rather, under his Mental Strength perception, the other party’s terrifyingly peerless Physical Body.
In his perception, Sima Yurao’s body was like a dormant giant mountain.
On the surface, it looked incomparably calm, but the power contained within it was enough to shock anyone.
In just an instant, Yang Fan made a judgment.
This woman’s strength was extremely formidable.
Even... above Han Zhen’s.
“Greetings, Young Miss Sima.” Yang Fan cupped his hands politely, yet he felt some doubts in his heart.
What on earth was the purpose of the other party wanting to meet him specifically?
“I am Tianci’s biological sister.”
Sima Yurao spoke calmly.
“My ranking in the family is ninety-ninth.”
“I am slightly older than you two, and I am already over two hundred years old.”
“Normally, according to the rules, I shouldn’t attend this kind of young people’s banquet.”
“However, in order to help my husband resolve some conflicts, I shamelessly came over.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan raised his brows slightly, “Conflicts?”
“That’s right.”
Sima Yurao nodded.
“My husband is called Ma Huainan.”
“Back then, he once had a gambling match with Fellow Daoist Yang.”
As she spoke, her gaze consistently fell on Yang Fan, seemingly wanting to read something from his expression.
However, to her disappointment, Yang Fan’s expression remained calm throughout, as if he had just remembered it.
“So it was that matter.”
Yang Fan nodded gently.
“That was just a normal gambling match.”
“The matter has long since ended; where did any talk of conflict come from?”
“Young Miss Sima must have misunderstood.”
“If there’s a chance, I would also like to invite Young Miss Sima and Fellow Daoist Ma to be guests at my home.”
Yang Fan’s tone was sincere, without the slightest bit of hostility.
Sima Yurao stared at him for a moment, and finally a trace of a smile appeared on her face.
“Although my husband’s talent is quite good, he comes from a small place, and his Mental State might still be somewhat lacking.”
“It’s just a War God Codex.”
“At our level, there’s no need to make things irreconcilable over an S-Rank Building.”
“After I go back, I will properly explain the stakes to him.”
“If there is a chance in the future, perhaps both sides can even carry out some divine kingdom cooperation.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“That is only natural.”
“If there is a chance, I also look forward to cooperating with Brother Ma.”
Seeing this, Sima Yurao smiled slightly, then turned around to look at Han Jue.
“Fellow Daoist Han, I won’t disturb your conversation.”
“My husband and I still have some matters to attend to.”
Han Jue smiled and nodded.
“Big Sister Sima, then I won’t walk you out.”
“Today, Fellow Daoist Ma was neglected; I must ask Big Sister to convey my apologies after returning.”
Sima Yurao waved her hand, “It’s fine.”
Afterward, under everyone’s gaze, she slowly left the hall.
After Sima Yurao left,
Sima Tianci obviously let out a sigh of relief.
Then he stood up, walked to Yang Fan’s side, and directly put his hand on his shoulder.
“Old Yang, I really didn’t expect this.”
“You and Brother Han actually have such a deep relationship.”
Yang Fan glanced at him, “What do you mean?”
Sima Tianci couldn’t help laughing.
“You don’t know?”
“Because of you, Brother Han stubbornly refused to let Ma Huainan enter the hall.”
“You guy, you hide things deep enough.”
As he spoke, Sima Tianci’s gaze toward Yang Fan also gained a hint of probing.
After all, Ma Huainan was no ordinary person.
He was also an existence evaluated as a Peerless Prodigy by the Human Federation.
As long as he didn’t fall midway, his future was basically destined to become a High-Order God.
More importantly, Ma Huainan had now completely married into the Sima Family as a matrilocal husband.
Even in a certain sense, he was already Sima Tianci’s brother-in-law.
Looking at the entire younger generation, this kind of identity was definitely not low.
But now, Han Jue actually blocked Ma Huainan outside the hall purely because of Yang Fan’s connection.
This was already enough to explain the problem.
Han Jue’s degree of importance attached to Yang Fan far exceeded their imagination.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but glance at Han Jue twice as well.
At this moment, even he himself felt a bit puzzled.
Since when did he have such a good relationship with Han Jue?
The two of them had clearly only met once in the Alien Divine Realm Zone, and could not even be considered friends in the true sense.
Yet now...
Han Jue acted just like old brothers who had known each other for decades.
“This guy...”
“What on earth is going on?”
Yang Fan’s heart was filled with doubts.
Regarding Han Jue’s series of operations, he was truly somewhat baffled.
Han Jue naturally noticed Yang Fan’s slightly strange gaze.
However, as if he hadn’t seen it at all, he just smiled and directly raised the wine glass in his hand.
“Everyone, thank you for giving me, Han Jue, this face today.”
“Since you are here, don’t be restrained.”
“Today, everyone drink until we drop!”

chapters.title: Chapter 409: Which Woman Wouldn't Be Worthy of Him?
paragraphs: Speaking up to this point, Han Jue swirled the wine glass in his hand.
“In addition, the blazing fire wine produced in our Han Family Divine Kingdom has a certain effect on strengthening the Physical Body.”
“After the banquet ends, I will arrange for intelligent lifeform to deliver one hundred tons to each of you.”
“Let the believers in your Divine Kingdoms have a taste as well.”
Once these words came out, the entire hall instantly bustled with excitement.
“Young Master Han is so generous!”
“Then I won’t be polite.”
“If there are gatherings like this in the future, be sure to notify me in advance so I can come and take advantage again.”
“Hahaha.”
Everyone laughed, and the atmosphere instantly became lively.
Afterwards, everyone began to enjoy the service of the intelligent robots.
Tasting precious Spirit Fruit and drinking blazing fire wine.
At the same time, they gathered in twos and threes and began to converse.
However, the so-called socializing here was not merely casual chat.
“Fellow Daoist Han Zhen.”
A young god raised his wine glass and asked with a smile,
“I heard your 26th Legion has recently been invading the Divine Kingdom of a Mid-tier God from the Titan Race?”
“And the battle is nearing its end.”
“I wonder if Fellow Daoist Han still has any spare slots?”
“If possible, this humble brother would also like to participate and share a piece of the pie.”
Hearing this, Han Zhen merely gave a faint smile.
“I can ask for you, but this is primarily a legion mission, so slots are indeed limited.”
“Thank you, Fellow Daoist Han.”
“Fellow Daoist Qin, isn’t there a tech company under the Qin Technology Alliance preparing to go public in the Luotian Star Domain?”
“I wonder if there is still a need for financing?”
“I happen to have some idle funds on hand and could participate.”
Meanwhile on the other side, someone also approached Lu Wan.
“Miss Lu, an enterprise I recently invested in on Far Shore Star is preparing to go public, but it has encountered some issues.”
“I wonder if Miss Lu might be interested?”
“In terms of shares, I can yield a portion.”
“Miss Lu wouldn’t need to invest, only lend your name.”
“I believe with the Lu Clan’s influence, the listing review will go much smoother.”
Lu Wan merely smiled slightly.
“You can send me the specifics to look over later.”
“If it’s suitable, I’ll consider it.”
For a time, the atmosphere throughout the entire hall was exceedingly lively.
Everyone raised their glasses repeatedly, enjoying the slight buzz brought by the blazing fire wine.
Yet their eyes remained consistently clear.
After all, everyone who could come here was a god.
How could they truly get drunk on wine?
The so-called drinking was mostly a medium of networking.
The blazing fire wine provided the atmosphere.
What was truly underway... was a series of resource exchanges, profit collaborations, and network building.
For these young gods standing at the pinnacle circles of the Human race,
a single banquet could often generate more value than a lifetime of effort from ordinary gods.
Yang Fan did not actively participate in much networking.
Yet with his currently formidable Mental Strength,
the conversations of almost everyone in the entire hall entered his ears clearly.
Listening to their discussions, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel somewhat emotional.
All along, possessing the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, he had been accustomed to developing alone in his villa.
Constantly upgrading his Divine Kingdom, constantly accumulating Resources.
He rarely took the initiative to integrate into these social circles between gods.
Compared to these Geniuses nurtured by the Five Great Families, he indeed appeared somewhat too solitary and unconventional.
These young gods who truly stood atop the Human race did not rely solely on the self-development of their Divine Kingdoms.
Behind them were massive Families, countless connections, and various resource channels.
Through intermarriage, cooperation, and interest exchange, they formed an enormous interpersonal network.
Many times, a single word from them, a single collaboration,
or even a simple exchange at a banquet could decide projects worth tens of trillions of Divinity Points.
This was the power of the top-tier circle.
The development of a Divine Kingdom was never just about its own Evolution.
Gods themselves also needed continuous operation and management.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but let out a bitter smile.
However, he quickly let it go.
In this world, there was no absolutely correct path.
Everyone had their own way of developing.
The Geniuses of the Five Great Families relied on Clan, connections, and Resources.
While he relied on his SSS-Rank Evolution Talent.
They needed to manage relationships and seek partners.
But as long as he continuously compounded investments into his Divine Kingdom, he could achieve a growth rate far exceeding that of ordinary people.
Moreover, Yang Fan also possessed self-awareness.
Although he had learned a vast amount of knowledge through the Primordial City Library over the years,
compared to these direct descendants of the Five Great Families who had received top-tier education and countless Resources from birth,
his own experience and social worldly wisdom still had a considerable gap.
In the end, one can only excel at what one is good at, and can only earn money within the scope of one’s own cognition.
There was no need to forcefully imitate others’ paths.
What suited oneself was best.
“Brother Yang.”
Right at this moment, Han Jue suddenly leaned over.
One hand rested naturally on Yang Fan’s shoulder, a meaningful smile on his face.
“Not bad at all, man.”
“Although Lu Wan’s Divine Kingdom Talent is only S-rank, she was the wealthiest person in our graduating class.”
“When will you share some tips with this brother?”
“I’d also like to find such an ideal match.”
Looking at Han Jue’s wretchedly sly expression, Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes.
“Brother Han is joking.”
“You are a direct descendant of the Han Family.”
“How could you possibly need to live off a woman like us commoners?”
Hearing this, Han Jue shook his head.
“Brother Yang, you’re wrong about that.”
“Lu Wan and I spent four years in university and cooperated quite a bit.”
“I know her personality all too well.”
“How could she possibly choose a gigolo who only relies on women?”
Having said this, Han Jue looked intently at Yang Fan.
“The person who can earn Lu Wan’s choice...”
“...must definitely have traits she acknowledges.”
“With Brother Yang’s potential, you are completely worthy of her.”
In the eyes of outsiders, Yang Fan’s journey indeed gave off a feeling of ‘constantly marrying into wealthy families.’
First the Gu Family, and then the Lu Clan.
No matter how one looked at it, it seemed he had pushed the path of living off women to its absolute limit.
But Han Jue knew that the reality was nothing of the sort.
Through the Han Family’s military merit system, he had seen Yang Fan’s battle record.
Having just achieved a breakthrough to the God Realm, he had slain an Angel Race god solely by his own strength.
Such a record was extremely rare across the nearly thousand-year history of the entire Human Federation.
One could even call it insane.
Because warfare between gods was never about individual heroism.
In the vast majority of cases, it was team combat.
All gods would avoid risks as much as possible.
Especially for young Geniuses like them who had just graduated from the academy.
Upon arriving at the frontline, who among them wouldn’t first spend decades or even centuries accumulating strength?
Allowing their Divine Kingdoms to develop to the limit.
Only after amassing sufficient power would they truly participate in Divine Kingdom Wars.
Because for them, the future held infinite possibilities and there was no need to take risks.
Yet Yang Fan... was completely different.
Having just achieved a breakthrough to godhood, he dared to hunt an Foreign Deity alone.
This kind of boldness, this kind of power.
Han Jue considered that even he himself might not have been able to achieve it.
Of course, if he were not a direct descendant of the Han Family and happened to be in charge of reviewing the military merit system,
he would never have been able to see this classified information.
But precisely because he knew,
he understood better than anyone else that Yang Fan’s potential was not in the least inferior to his own.
Perhaps... even stronger.
Such a figure, across the entire younger generation of the Human Federation,
which woman wouldn’t be worthy of him?
