chapters.title: Chapter 410: Lies Are More Useful Than Truths
paragraphs: “Brother Han.”
Yang Fan suddenly spoke.
“It seems we’ve only met once, right?”
As he spoke, his Mental Strength quietly spread outward.
Instantly forming an invisible barrier around the two of them, isolating the external sounds.
Han Jue was slightly stunned.
Then, feeling the changes around him, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
“As expected of Brother Yang, a deity who cultivates three paths simultaneously.”
“Your Mental Strength methods are truly extraordinary.”
However, Han Jue quickly recovered his smile.
“Rest assured, Brother Yang, I mean no harm.”
“The reason I did this is simply because I want to make friends with you.”
“Moreover...”
Han Jue said earnestly:
“Who says that after meeting only once, we can’t become good friends?”
“The very first time I saw Brother Yang in the Alien Divine Realm Zone, I felt that we would definitely become friends in the future.”
“Even very important friends.”
Speaking of this, Han Jue put his arm around Yang Fan’s shoulder again, his gaze incomparably sincere.
Seeing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help rolling his eyes internally.
He could finally tell that this Han Jue in front of him was truly a social butterfly.
Moreover... his skin was truly thick.
He was the type who felt zero psychological pressure when telling lies.
Yang Fan calmly removed the Mental Strength barrier, and the surrounding sounds returned to normal once again.
No matter why Han Jue was being so proactive.
There was one thing Yang Fan could be certain of: the other party truly had no malicious intent.
Based on this point alone, it was already enough.
“Brother Yang.”
Han Jue suddenly said mysteriously:
“After the banquet ends, see you in the Virtual World.”
“Remember to bring Lu Wan; I have a way to make a fortune.”
Yang Fan gave him a suspicious look, but still nodded.
Yang Fan didn’t have much interest in the opportunity to make a fortune that Han Jue mentioned.
After all, what he currently lacked the least were Divinity Points.
However, he still needed to obtain Secret Realm coordinates through Han Jue, so discussing it in detail within the Virtual World would indeed be appropriate.
This banquet lasted until the late hours of the night.
As time passed, the crowd gradually dispersed.
And tonight, for Yang Fan, the harvest was quite abundant.
Not only did Lu Wan continuously help him introduce young deities from the Five Great Families and various factions.
As the host of the banquet, Han Jue accompanied him the entire time, addressing him as a brother and proactively introducing one Human Race Prodigy after another to him.
Throughout the entire banquet, Yang Fan’s reputation within the direct-line circles of the Five Great Families truly made a resounding splash.
Even by the time the banquet ended, his Feixun friend list had gained quite a few new names.
Among them were many direct-line members of the Five Great Families, as well as some top-tier deities among the younger generation.
Right now, inside Han Jue’s manor, besides him and Qin Zheng, there was no one else left.
Qin Zheng sat on the sofa, looking at Han Jue in front of him with eyes full of suspicion.
“Tell me, since when did you get such a good brother?”
“Why do I feel like you made such a huge fuss today just to acknowledge this brother?”
Speaking of this, Qin Zheng’s expression suddenly changed as he couldn’t help saying:
“Han Jue, you brat, you couldn’t have been threatened by someone, right?”
“If someone is really forcing you, just blink.”
“Don’t worry, no matter what you did, I’ll help you plead with my aunt.”
Hearing this, the corner of Han Jue’s mouth twitched fiercely.
“Scram!”
“Who the fuck can threaten me?”
Qin Zheng didn’t laugh; instead, his brows furrowed even deeper.
Because he understood Han Jue too well.
The two of them grew up together since childhood.
It could be said that he knew what kind of personality Han Jue had better than anyone else.
Usually, although this guy had an outgoing personality and liked making friends.
Today’s performance was simply too abnormal.
Throughout the entire banquet, so many direct-line Geniuses of the Five Great Families had clearly come.
Yet Han Jue spent most of his time almost revolving entirely around Yang Fan.
Proactively introducing him, proactively toasting, proactively trying to get close.
There was even a faint feeling of intentionally trying to curry favor.
No matter how one looked at it, this didn’t look like Han Jue’s usual style.
Everywhere it exuded a sense of weirdness.
“Then what on earth is your situation?”
Qin Zheng couldn’t help asking.
“Yang Fan’s status is indeed not low nowadays.”
“With the Lu Family and Gu Family backing him, and having a good relationship with Sima Tianci.”
“But there’s no need to go to this extent, right?”
“With your attitude today, anyone who didn’t know would think you were his follower.”
“Is there any need to lower your own status like that?”
Han Jue was silent for a moment, then shook his head.
“There are some things I cannot tell you.”
“After all, as you know, our Han Family’s military merit system has strict confidentiality agreements.”
“I can only tell you one thing.”
“Befriending Yang Fan definitely has no disadvantages.”
Qin Zheng’s expression changed slightly.
And Han Jue continued:
“You must understand.”
“Yang Fan is not just an ordinary son-in-Law of the Five Great Families.”
“His talent is Hundredfold Time Dilation.”
“Among SS-grade Divine Kingdom Talents, those involving the Law of Time are inherently extremely precious.”
Speaking of this, Han Jue paused for a moment and did not continue explaining.
But Qin Zheng understood instantly.
The two of them were childhood friends; he understood Han Jue too well.
The more Han Jue was unwilling to speak, the more it meant this matter involved secrets.
And what was the Han Family’s military merit system?
It was nothing more than granting military merits rewards by reviewing information such as Alien Divine Kingdom Cores and special structures.
To be able to make Han Jue value him so much, and even willing to lower his posture to befriend him in this manner today.
Then the answer was already very obvious.
Qin Zheng took a deep breath, “He should have just graduated, right?”
“Mhm.”
“How long ago?”
“Less than a year.”
Qin Zheng fell silent, and then couldn’t help cursing.
“Damn it.”
“He’s truly a monster.”
On the other side, Yang Fan and Lu Wan took an airship and quickly returned to the villa.
As soon as they entered the hall, Lu Wan sat directly on the sofa.
Her arms crossed in front of her chest, looking like she was interrogating a criminal.
“Confess.”
Yang Fan was taken aback for a moment.
“Ah?”
“Confess what?”
Lu Wan glanced at him.
“When we left, didn’t you still pretend not to know Han Jue?”
“Are you still going to tell me now that the two of you aren’t close?”
“This...”
Yang Fan instantly felt a bit awkward.
Because in this matter, what he said was indeed the truth.
He and Han Jue really had only met once.
But the problem was their performance at tonight’s banquet.
No matter who saw it, they would think the two were longtime friends.
Their relationship was even intimate to an abnormal degree.
The face Han Jue gave him was simply too exaggerated.
Therefore, Yang Fan felt that even if he told the truth now, Lu Wan probably wouldn’t believe it.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan simply went with the flow and said:
“Um... we are indeed considered good friends.”
“I just wanted to give you a surprise, Wan’er.”
“Letting you know that your husband also has connections.”
“Maybe it can help you in the future.”
As his voice fell, Yang Fan sighed silently in his heart.
Since the other party would definitely not believe the truth, it was better to just make up a lie along with her expectations.
Anyway, it’s just about coaxing the wife!
Women are emotional animals; sometimes, lies are much more useful than truths.

chapters.title: Chapter 411: Unmined Earth-grade Secret Realm
paragraphs: Indeed, upon hearing this, Lu Wan’s expression softened quite a bit.
Afterward, she got up, came to Yang Fan’s side, and nestled into his arms.
“Husband, I don’t need you to help me with anything.”
“But don’t lie to me in the future.”
“Wives are meant to be doted on, not used by you to act cool.”
By the end, Lu Wan couldn’t help but roll her eyes at Yang Fan.
Yang Fan smiled.
“Alright, I promise I won’t lie to you in the future.”
“And... I love you.”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan’s small face flushed slightly.
Without answering, she simply leaned harder into Yang Fan’s arms.
“Got it.”
After enjoying a moment of warmth, Yang Fan suddenly remembered something.
“Right, Han Jue previously invited us to meet in the Virtual World.”
“He said there is a way to make a fortune.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan’s expression instantly turned serious.
“Then let’s go over now. When I was at the Primordial Academy, I cooperated with Han Jue a few times.”
“Although this person has a somewhat flighty personality, he has a good sense of propriety when doing things.”
“He wouldn’t talk about a fortune-making opportunity for no reason.”
Speaking of this, Lu Wan looked at Yang Fan.
“Besides, didn’t Husband want to buy Secret Realm coordinates?”
“Since your relationship is so good, we won’t need to take so many detours for many matters.”
“We can directly discuss the cooperation in the Virtual World.”
Yang Fan nodded, “That works too.”
Afterward, the two did not delay further and directly put on their virtual helmets.
Accompanied by the conscious connection, the surrounding environment instantly changed.
The next moment, the figures of the two appeared in a spacious virtual conference room.
As soon as Yang Fan appeared, he discovered that Han Jue was not the only one inside.
Qin Zheng and Sima Tianci were actually there as well.
Seeing Yang Fan and Lu Wan appear, Han Jue immediately stood up with a smile.
“Brother Yang, President Lu, you guys finally arrived.”
Speaking of this, Han Jue suddenly revealed a hint of a wretched smile.
“I thought that after you guys went home, you directly... went to sleep.”
Hearing this, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
This guy really didn’t know how to exercise restraint when speaking at all.
However, Lu Wan on the side had a normal expression, still maintaining a proper smile on her face.
“With Brother Han’s invitation, naturally we wouldn’t dare delay.”
“As soon as we got home, we immediately entered the Virtual World.”
Lu Wan said calmly.
At this moment, Qin Zheng, who was sitting next to Han Jue, waved his hand.
“Brother Yang, and President Lu, hurry over and sit down.”
“We are all friends, no need to be so courteous.”
Yang Fan and Lu Wan exchanged a glance.
Afterward, without saying much more, they walked over and sat down.
After everyone had arrived, Han Jue didn’t continue to keep them in suspense.
“Since everyone is here, I will get straight to the main point.”
The smile on Han Jue’s face converged, and his expression turned serious.
“Some time ago, when my believers were exploring outside, they accidentally discovered a Secret Realm.”
“And... it is an Earth-grade Secret Realm that has never been mined by anyone.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire conference room instantly fell silent.
The next moment, the expressions of Sima Tianci and Lu Wan changed at the same time.
“Holy shit!”
Sima Tianci stood up directly.
“Brother Han, no, Old Brother Han!”
“Are you playing for real?”
“An Earth-grade Secret Realm that has never been mined?”
“What kind of dog-shit luck did you run into?”
Speaking of this, Sima Tianci directly looked up and sighed heavily.
“The heavens are unfair!”
“I Cultivate so hard every day, why can’t my Divine Kingdom explorers discover such good things?”
Hearing this, everyone couldn’t help but roll their eyes.
Especially Qin Zheng.
“You still have the nerve to talk about Cultivating hard?”
“The three words’Slacking King’, who in the Five Great Families doesn’t know?”
Sima Tianci’s expression stiffened.
“Cough cough... Working hard occasionally is still working hard.”
Everyone was instantly speechless.
At this moment, Lu Wan wasn’t as excited as Sima Tianci.
She straightened her posture, and her gaze looked toward Han Jue.
“Brother Han, if this is truly an Earth-grade Secret Realm that has never been mined.”
“Then this Secret Realm has probably evolved in the Divine Kingdom world for I don’t know how many years.”
“After such a long period of accumulation, even if it’s just the most basic Spirit Herb Resources inside, the value is probably immeasurable.”
“Conservatively estimated, the total value is at least 300 trillion Divinity Points.”
“If there are powerful creatures inside, we just need to let the elders of the Han Family step in and resolve it.”
Speaking of this, Lu Wan paused for a moment.
“Therefore...”
“Why is Brother Han willing to take it out and share it with us?”
Han Jue’s current behavior, in the eyes of outsiders, was truly somewhat abnormal.
This was like someone suddenly discovering a gold mine.
Under normal circumstances, who wouldn’t think of secretly developing it themselves?
But Han Jue, on the other hand, ran over directly and said: “Brothers, let’s split it together.”
As a businesswoman, Lu Wan would never believe such a pie falling from the sky.
Han Jue was definitely no fool.
“President Lu is truly sharp.”
Han Jue smiled.
“Actually, there are two reasons.”
“First, according to the rules of my Han Family.”
“If I let the Clan elders step in to develop this Secret Realm, I need to hand over thirty percent of the final profits.”
“Presumably President Lu also knows our Han Family’s training method for the younger generation.”
“The Clan can provide Resources and opportunities, but it will not indefinitely solve all problems for us.”
“Even if my parents are willing to help, they will probably take away thirty percent of the profits under the pretext of training me.”
Han Jue said helplessly.
“Second, I am preparing to establish a new company.”
“And the profits from this Earth-grade Secret Realm will serve as the startup capital for the company.”
“I am willing to take out 40% of the initial shares, with everyone present holding 10%.”
“Of course, the development of the Secret Realm also requires everyone to participate together.”
“I wonder what everyone thinks of this proposal?”
After Han Jue finished speaking, a confident smile appeared on his face.
Hearing this, expressions of sudden realization appeared on everyone’s faces.
So that was how it was. Han Jue didn’t simply want to share benefits.
Instead, he wanted to use this Secret Realm to build his own industry.
After all, the Five Great Families’ cultivation of the younger generation was never mere protection.
On the contrary, the more direct-line Geniuses there were, the higher the demands.
Graduating from the Primordial Academy and going to the frontline to serve for ten years.
After enjoying the basic support given by the Clan, one needs to truly develop independently.
Even a Peerless Prodigy must prove their own ability.
Therefore, among the younger generation, finding partners, establishing companies, and conducting resource integration...
is not rare among the Five Great Families, and can even be said to be a necessary path.
And Han Jue choosing to develop the Secret Realm himself, although compared to letting the Han Family elders step in, required bearing more risks.
And even conceding an extra 10% of the profits.
But for him, this deal was completely worth it.
Gods have infinite lifespans.
Short-term windfall profits are indeed tempting, but long-term stable development channels are even more important.
Furthermore, Sima Tianci, Qin Zheng, Lu Wan, and Yang Fan were all top figures among the younger generation of the Human Federation.
Bringing these people into the company, in the future, the company might well have the opportunity to grow to the point of listing on the Federation’s main board.
This was Han Jue’s true purpose.

chapters.title: Chapter 412: Star Group
paragraphs: Lu Wan picked up the teacup on the table and took a gentle sip.
“Brother Han, has your company finished registration?”
“Has the operational direction been decided?”
Han Jue nodded.
“It has been successfully registered, and the location is in the Battlefront Star Sector, which is closest to the frontline.”
“The company is called—Star Group.”
“In the short term, it will mainly focus on developing and selling the Resources from that Earth-grade Secret Realm.”
“As for the long-term development plan, I am also preparing to ask President Lu for help.”
Saying this, Han Jue looked at Lu Wan and said seriously:
“When the time comes, I hope President Lu can transfer a Tier 9 intelligent lifeform from the Lu Consortium headquarters to serve as the director of the operations department for Star Group.”
“I wonder if that would be convenient for President Lu?”
Lu Wan nodded with satisfaction upon hearing this.
“Of course.”
“Brother Han’s Star Group has immense potential, and being able to participate in it early is actually my honor.”
Saying so, Lu Wan raised her teacup and gestured slightly.
“I wish Star Group a successful listing on the Federal Main Board in the future.”
Seeing this, a smile appeared on Han Jue’s face.
Sima Tianci, who was on the side, also spoke up directly.
“If I were to refuse such a good thing, wouldn’t I be a fool?”
“Although my Sima Family is not like the Lu Family, possessing such massive influence in the business field,”
“we still have quite a few connections in the Federal Government.”
“For the future development of Star Group, whether it is permit approvals, tax incentives, or talent recruitment policies, I can provide some convenience.”
Sima Tianci also expressed his attitude.
As Han Jue’s childhood friend, Qin Zheng was naturally already aware of this matter.
Coming over today was originally to show that he was also one of the shareholders, so he did not make any additional statements.
At this moment, everyone’s eyes fell upon Yang Fan.
Yang Fan cleared his throat.
“Then thank you, Brother Han.”
“However, as for the management of the company, I’m afraid I won’t be of much help.”
Saying this, Yang Fan naturally pointed to Lu Wan beside him.
“It’ll rely entirely on my wife’s operations.”
He spoke with complete composure, without the slightest hint of embarrassment.
In fact, regarding the undeveloped Earth-grade Secret Realm Han Jue mentioned,
Yang Fan really did not have much interest.
Several hundred trillion Divinity Points was an unimaginable fortune for ordinary gods.
But for the current Yang Fan, it was nothing more than that.
With the current resource output rate of his Divine Kingdom,
he could easily earn it back by just slacking off for a month.
However, Yang Fan would not refuse this opportunity just because he looked down on it.
A 10% share of Star Group was free for the taking.
More importantly, with this cooperation achieved, a true community of shared interests was formed among them.
Whether he bought Secret Realm coordinates from Han Jue in the future or cooperated in other aspects, it would be much more convenient.
This was what Yang Fan truly valued.
“Hahaha.”
Han Jue laughed upon hearing this.
“Brother Yang is joking.”
“For this Earth-grade Secret Realm reclamation, we will still need Brother Yang to put in a lot of effort.”
Yang Fan nodded, “Sure thing.”
Soon, under the witness of the intelligent lifeform of the Virtual World, they signed the equity distribution agreement.
After it was done, Sima Tianci spoke up:
“Since the matter is settled, let’s create a Feixun group.”
“When the time comes, Brother Han can send the Secret Realm coordinates to the group in encrypted form.”
“After I go back, I will also have the intelligent lifeform in my Divine Kingdom begin mobilizing the troops.”
“In ten days, we will directly start reclaiming the Secret Realm. How about it?”
“No problem.”
Han Jue nodded in agreement.
“I’ll send the group invitation when the time comes.”
Qin Zheng then also exited the Virtual World.
Lu Wan glanced at Yang Fan.
Seeing Yang Fan nod, she left as well.
Soon, only Yang Fan and Han Jue were left in the entire conference room.
Seeing that everyone else had left, Han Jue looked at Yang Fan and asked,
“Brother Yang, is there anything else?”
Yang Fan did not beat around the bush.
“Brother Han, I heard that your Han Family has quite a bit of experience in Secret Realm investment?”
Han Jue nodded upon hearing this.
“Indeed, the main power of my Han Family Military Prefecture is concentrated in the military.”
“Compared to commercial investment, we are more adept in fields related to Divine Kingdom Wars.”
“Therefore, the descendants of the Han Family usually have relatively abundant military forces.”
“And places like Secret Realms, unlike resource planets, require a large number of troops for long-term stationing.”
“So they are actually more suited to our Han Family’s Divine Kingdom investment direction.”
Han Jue did not hide anything; after all, this matter was not a secret.
Yang Fan continued to ask, “I wonder if Brother Han has channels to purchase Secret Realm coordinates?”
Hearing this, Han Jue was obviously taken aback.
“Brother Yang also wants to do Secret Realm investment?”
His tone carried a hint of surprise.
Because in Han Jue’s view, Yang Fan and Lu Wan were now married.
“Backed by such a massive commercial force like the Lu Family, reasonably speaking, they shouldn’t lack Resources at all in the short term.”
“And Secret Realm investment, although yielding good returns, is also a troublesome matter.”
“Many gods would rather purchase resource planets than touch Secret Realms.”
“With the slightest carelessness, a Secret Realm investment could result in a total loss.”
“I have some thoughts in this area.”
“Mainly, I want to give it a try.”
Yang Fan explained.
Han Jue nodded, “What grade?”
“Mystic-grade and Yellow-grade Secret Realms will do.”
Hearing this, Han Jue was obviously relieved.
“If it’s just low-tier Secret Realms, that’s much simpler.”
“How about this, in a moment I’ll introduce someone to Brother Yang.”
“He is a Tier 3 God, and he has quite a few low-tier Secret Realm coordinates in his hands.”
“However...”
Han Jue’s expression grew serious.
“Even with my introduction, I can only guarantee at most that within ten years in the Real World, the other party won’t do anything excessive.”
“After ten years, it will depend entirely on Brother Yang’s own strength.”
“Brother Yang should also understand where the biggest disadvantage of Secret Realm investment lies.”
“For ordinary gods, Secret Realms are inherently a high-risk investment.”
“Han Jue was willing to introduce a channel to Yang Fan because the two of them had a good relationship now.”
“But he would not directly participate in it.”
“Otherwise, if something went wrong with the Secret Realm in the future, it might easily affect their relationship.”
“Merely introducing the channel but not guaranteeing anything was what Han Jue considered the most appropriate way.”
“That’s natural. I just want to try Secret Realm investment. Even if it really gets snatched back, I can only blame my own lack of strength,” Yang Fan said calmly.
As for the so-called risk, he actually did not take it to heart.
With just a mere Tier 3 God, who would win and who would lose was still unknown.
What’s more, Han Jue had already guaranteed that no problems would arise within ten years in the Real World.
Ten years’ time, for Yang Fan who now possessed the SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, was enough to bring about earth-shaking changes.
To what extent his strength would reach by then was something even he could not predict.
Therefore, in Yang Fan’s eyes, this so-called risk was almost negligible.

chapters.title: Chapter 413: The Answer is Almost Ready to Be Revealed
paragraphs: “That’s good.”
Han Jue nodded, and then pushed a business card to Yang Fan.
“This person can be considered a wild-path god, but his reputation among the people I know is still quite decent.”
“Right, this time for the Earth-grade Secret Realm pioneering, I must trouble Brother Yang to put in more effort.”
Han Jue said politely once more.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes flickered slightly.
Afterwards, his consciousness exited the Virtual World.
Returning to the Real World, Yang Fan sat on the sofa, but his expression carried a hint of strangeness.
“Pioneering requires me to put in more effort, and he even intentionally reminded me twice...”
Yang Fan gently tapped the table with his right hand, falling into deep thought.
“This Han Jue, why does he have so much confidence in my strength?”
Ever since entering the banquet, the attitude the other party displayed was a bit too enthusiastic.
One could even say it was enthusiastic to an abnormal degree.
Yang Fan was very certain that he and Han Jue had only met once in the Alien Divine Realm Zone.
Logically speaking, the other party had no reason to value him so much at all.
“Husband, how did the talk go?”
Right at this moment, Lu Wan walked out of the kitchen holding a plate of Spirit Fruit.
“It’s already settled.”
Yang Fan took the Spirit Fruit, and then, as if suddenly thinking of something, asked:
“Right, Wan’er, can everyone query the military merit system of the frontline?”
Lu Wan was slightly stunned, and then shook her head.
“Of course that’s impossible.”
“The military merit system is similar to the academic credit network of the Two Major Academies, and the information recorded in it entirely belongs to federal top secrets.”
“Whether in the Virtual World or the Real World, anyone who dares to leak it privately may face trial by a military court.”
“So outsiders cannot know?” Yang Fan continued to ask.
“That’s not necessarily the case.”
Lu Wan pondered for a moment and explained:
“It’s just that very few people can access this information.”
“Especially the military merit system; it is not entirely managed by intelligent lifeform, and the Han Family Military Prefecture can also review it.”
“People from the Han Family can review it?” Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
“That’s right.”
Lu Wan nodded, and then smiled:
“Speaking of which, your good brother Han Jue seems to be responsible for the review work of military merits recently.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan instantly understood many things.
Why did he and Han Jue only meet once, yet the other party insisted on calling him brother?

Why, knowing that he was merely a son-in-law of the Gu Family and Lu Family, and couldn’t provide much help in Star Group’s management, was the other party still willing to give away 10% of the shares?
The answer seemed to be on the verge of being revealed.
“So that’s how it is...”
Yang Fan muttered softly.
I’m afraid all of this was because of the information about that Angel Race Divine Kingdom Core he had uploaded.
Yang Fan wasn’t stupid.
In the eyes of outsiders, he had just graduated from Primordial Academy not long ago, yet he had independently killed an Foreign Deity.
Such a combat record, looking across the younger generation of the Human Federation, was enough to be called shocking to the world.
Even a Peerless Prodigy like Han Jue would inevitably be shocked by it.
After all, wars between gods relied on legions the vast majority of the time.
An existence like Yang Fan, who dared to hunt down an Foreign Deity alone right after breaking through to a god, might not appear once in several hundred years.
“It seems that in the future, I still need to keep a slightly lower profile.”
Yang Fan leaned against the sofa and said softly.
“A god-level Divine Kingdom Core can only exchange for ten million military merits.”
“What truly allows one to acquire a massive amount of military merits are still those high-tier alien buildings.”
Thinking of this, a trace of vigilance rose in Yang Fan’s heart.
When one’s strength is insufficient, showing too much of one’s edge will only invite trouble.
A true powerhouse must not only know how to display power, but even more so, know how to hide power.
A tree that stands out from the forest will be destroyed by the wind; being overly rigid makes one easily broken.
Although exposing his strength this time only brought him benefits.
Han Jue actively approached him because of this, and even gave away shares of Star Group.
But this did not mean Yang Fan could act unscrupulously in the future.
Hiding one’s edge is not out of fear.
Rather, it is to ensure that he always maintains the maximum room for growth before possessing sufficient strength.
Only when one is powerful enough that no one can threaten them is it truly the time when there is no need to hide.
Yang Fan secretly reminded himself in his heart.
“It seems that this Earth-grade Secret Realm pioneering really requires me to put in a bit more effort.”
“Otherwise, I’m afraid it will make Han Jue feel dissatisfied.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan picked up a Spirit Fruit and took a few bites.
Then he looked at Lu Wan and said, “Han Jue recommended a person to me, I’ll go to the Virtual World to meet him first.”
Lu Wan nodded, “Alright.”
Yang Fan entered the Virtual World once more.
Accompanied by the completion of coordinate positioning, his consciousness instantly crossed space, arriving on a glamorous Vacation Planet.
Looking out, the entire planet had been developed into an entertainment and leisure area.

Floating in the sky were various luxuriously shaped aircraft, and on the ground were buildings full of technological sense, with neon lights intertwining to decorate the entire planet like a city that never sleeps.
“This must be Young Master Yang, right?”
A voice came over.
A middle-aged man was seen walking over briskly.
The other party looked to be around forty years old, with his hair combed meticulously, a clean face, and wearing a well-tailored black suit.
Although the person didn’t have any powerful aura, his gestures revealed a shrewd and capable merchant temperament.
“I am Chen Bo, Young Master Yang, please this way.”
Chen Bo bowed slightly, his attitude incomparably respectful.
Although he himself was also a Tier 3 God, at this moment facing Yang Fan, he didn’t put on any airs at all.
Following Chen Bo, the two quickly arrived in front of a huge commercial building.
Entering the lobby, Yang Fan’s footsteps paused slightly.
Seeing on both sides of the lobby, dozens of female attendants were standing neatly.
These attendants had extremely perfect body proportions, and their looks had also been carefully adjusted, with almost every single one reaching the ultimate in the eyes of ordinary people.
What was even more important was that these attendants were actually all at the Demigod Realm.
“Greetings, Young Master Yang!”
Everyone spoke in unison.
Afterwards, all the attendants bowed in salute simultaneously, with the angle even reaching ninety degrees.
Yang Fan’s brows raised slightly, a flash of surprise passing through his eyes.
This posture... it was somewhat similar to the service model of Heavenly Fragrance Club.
“Young Master Yang, you make me look foolish.”
Chen Bo smiled and explained.
“This is a small Vacation Planet in the Haiyuan Starfield, which can be considered my personal private property, usually used mainly to entertain some important clients.”
“Although the scale cannot compare to the Heavenly Fragrance Club company, these staff members of mine are all capable of providing services in the Real World.”
“If Young Master Yang has any needs, with just a single word, they can cross the Starfield to provide services.”
Speaking of this, Chen Bo handed over a business card.
“This is my personal business card, in the future, I kindly ask Young Master Yang to take care of this humble one’s business.”
Yang Fan took the business card and saw a line of text printed on it.
[Haiyuan Starfield — Star Sea Service Group]
[Chairman: Chen Bo]
The company’s business scope includes: Starfield travel, Divine Kingdom Resources investment consulting, high-end private services, Secret Realm investment, and multiple other fields.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: Is This Called Playing Around?
paragraphs: “Easy enough.”
Yang Fan casually put away the business card.
“Let’s talk about business first.”
“Alright, Young Master Yang, this way please.”
Chen Bo hurriedly led the way ahead.
They walked all the way to a spacious conference room.
The door closed, and Chen Bo projected the materials he had prepared long ago.
“Young Master Yang, these are the coordinates of the Yellow-grade Secret Realm that I currently have available for sale.”
After sitting down, Yang Fan casually flipped through them.
The information was very detailed, including not only a general environmental introduction of the Secret Realm, but also the distribution of internal Resources.
It included which Spirit Plants were suitable for Planting, the reserves of the original ore veins, the resource growth cycle, and even detailed records of Spirit Beast Procreation.
Some of the Secret Realms had even been built in advance with semi-automated Procreation areas.
Spirit Beast ranches, irrigation ditches, resource collection equipment, and a large number of auxiliary work robots were all arranged in advance.
Looking at these materials, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
As expected of someone who specialized in Secret Realm investment business, this service was indeed comprehensive enough.
If it were a God who truly wanted to buy a Secret Realm for long-term management, after buying it, he would hardly have to worry about too many things.
He only needed to dispatch believers to station there.
“Young Master Yang, these Secret Realms have all been reclaimed in advance by a large number of believers I dispatched.”
“After you purchase them, you only need to send troops to station there, and you can continuously obtain profits afterwards.”
“I will definitely not let you worry even a bit more.”
Chen Bo patted his chest and guaranteed.
“Not bad.”
Yang Fan nodded.
Hearing these words, Chen Bo’s eyes suddenly lit up.
“Young Master Yang, the ones you are looking at now are the Yellow-grade Secret Realm.”
“The area of the Yellow-grade Secret Realm is about 100 million square kilometers, and the price is relatively cheap.”
“Depending on the resource conditions, the selling price is roughly between 10 billion and 50 billion Divinity Points.”
“Calculated based on normal returns, basically it can recoup its cost in the Real World within 8 to 15 years, and after that, it is pure profit.”
As he spoke, Chen Bo switched the page.
“These are the Xuan-grade Secret Realm.”
“The area is roughly between 5 billion square kilometers and 15 billion square kilometers.”

“Because the Xuan-grade Secret Realm was born longer ago, the internal Spiritual Qi environment is better, and the growth speed of all kinds of Resources is also faster, so the price is naturally much higher.”
“For example, this one requires 800 billion Divinity Points.”
“And this one requires 3 trillion Divinity Points.”
“However, Young Master Yang can rest assured that all the Secret Realms I sell have undergone strict screening.”
“The number of Gods who have handled them will not exceed ten, and safety is absolutely guaranteed.”
“And there is also after-sales service.”
Chen Bo said seriously.

“Within ten years in the Real World, if there is really some blind-eyed fellow who wants to disturb Young Master Yang in managing the Secret Realm, my Divine Kingdom will send troops to assist in solving it.”
Speaking of this, Chen Bo patted his chest.
He knew very well that Yang Fan was not just an ordinary customer.
But a potential stock backed by the Five Great Families.
For such a figure, as long as he was served well, the future returns would definitely far exceed the Secret Realm itself.
Yang Fan roughly glanced at the information, and his gaze locked onto the Xuan-grade Secret Realm.
As for those Yellow-grade Secret Realm, Yang Fan didn’t pay much attention to them at all.
His purpose in buying Secret Realms was not to earn Divinity Points in the first place.
Nowadays, his Divine Kingdom’s resource output had already reached a terrifying degree, and the income of Divinity Points did not mean much to him.
What was truly important was—the area of the Secret Realm.
Since it was for hoarding troops, naturally the larger the area of the Secret Realm, the better.
Looking at the Xuan-grade Secret Realm materials that Yang Fan was continuously browsing through, Chen Bo already had a judgment in his heart.
This business deal was probably going to succeed.
Thinking of this, the smile on his face became even more enthusiastic.
After personally pouring a cup of spiritual tea for Yang Fan, he poured one for himself, then took a gentle sip, waiting for Yang Fan’s decision.
After a moment.
“Let’s choose the Xuan-grade Secret Realm.”
Yang Fan spoke calmly.
Chen Bo’s eyes lit up, “I wonder which one Young Master Yang has taken a fancy to?”
“I took a look.”
Yang Fan put down the materials in his hand.
“There are only five Xuan-grade Secret Realms here with an area exceeding 10 billion square kilometers.”
“Then I want all of these five.”
“Pfft!”
The next second, the spiritual tea Chen Bo had just taken a sip of directly spat out.
He didn’t even care about losing his composure, staring wide-eyed at Yang Fan.
“Five... five?”
“Young Master Yang, are you sure?”
“These are five Xuan-grade Secret Realms!”
“Calculated by price, the total value is close to 10 trillion Divinity Points!”
“You... purchasing so many all at once?”
Chen Bo’s voice was a bit stuttering.
Chen Bo at this moment was truly shocked.
He himself was only a Tier 3 God, so the Secret Realm business he managed on usual days was only between Yellow-grade and Xuan-grade Secret Realms.
These Secret Realms were all slowly managed by him spending a lot of time and Resources.
Dispatching believers in advance to mine Resources, building infrastructure, and then dispatching heavy troops to garrison.

For Chen Bo, being able to successfully sell a Xuan-grade Secret Realm every four or five years, recoup the invested cost, and earn an excess profit was already considered a very successful investment.
After all, Secret Realm investment has a long cycle and the risk is not low.
The vast majority of Gods would simply not invest such a huge amount of capital all at once.
But now... Yang Fan actually spoke directly, wanting to buy the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms with the highest value in his hands!
And they were the five with the largest area!
Ten trillion Divinity Points!
What kind of concept was this?
Even a Tier 3 God like Chen Bo, who had long managed the Secret Realm business, felt his head buzzing a bit.
Such a huge sum of funds suddenly arriving in his account, for a moment he didn’t even know how to arrange it.
When Han Jue contacted him before, he only said that Yang Fan wanted to buy some Secret Realms.
In Chen Bo’s view, this son-in-law of the Five Great Families would at most buy one or two Yellow-grade Secret Realms to play around with.
After all, Han Jue spoke very relaxed, just “trying it out”.
But now...
Is this called trying it out?
Is this called playing around?
These were Divinity Points! Not ordinary Faith Points!
Ten trillion Divinity Points were smashed out just like that, are all the sons-in-law of the Five Great Families so extravagant?
“The transaction can be done at any time, don’t waste time.”
Yang Fan said in a calm voice.
“Of course!”
Chen Bo instantly came back to his senses.
“At any time!”
“Young Master Yang, please wait a moment, I will prepare the contract right away!”
As his voice fell, Chen Bo quickly took action; where was there any of that calm and collected merchant appearance from just now?
He directly contacted his intelligent lifeform, asking it to immediately retrieve all the information of the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms and prepare the transaction contract.
For fear that if his actions were a little slower, some accident might occur in this transaction worth 10 trillion Divinity Points.
After all... such a customer who didn’t even bargain on price, he was afraid he wouldn’t meet a second one in his lifetime.
“Congratulations to Young Master Yang on obtaining five Xuan-grade Secret Realms, wishing you a booming business and enormous profits.”
Looking at the signed contract in his hands, the smile on Chen Bo’s face was as brilliant as blooming flowers.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: Secret Realm Arrangement
paragraphs: A transaction of ten trillion Divinity Points.
For Chen Bo, this was definitely the biggest business deal he had done in these past few centuries.
Looking at the prompt of the successful transaction, the smile on Chen Bo’s face simply could not be suppressed.
With such a huge sum of floating capital, many of his plans in the Real World could be rolled out ahead of schedule.
For instance, purchasing shares of some high-quality companies for long-term investment.
Or even...
“Perhaps I can consider purchasing a habitable planet in a remote Starfield.”
Chen Bo had already begun planning the use of this fund in his heart.
After all, although Divinity Points were precious, sitting there they were ultimately just numbers.
Truly smart gods would never let their wealth lie dormant.
They needed to let money make money and keep Resources rolling continuously.
Otherwise, no matter how many Divinity Points one possessed, it would ultimately only be temporary wealth.
“Young Master Yang, the coordinates of the five Secret Realms have already been sent to you.”
“You can send troops to take them over at any time.”
Chen Bo said respectfully.
“If Young Master Yang has some difficulty deploying troops in a short time, I can also arrange for a portion of believers to continue guarding them for you.”
“Of course, I won’t touch any of the yields inside the Secret Realm.”
For a major customer like Yang Fan who consumed ten trillion Divinity Points in one go, Chen Bo naturally had to push his service to the absolute limit.
“There’s no need.”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“Just withdraw all the believers you previously stationed in the Secret Realm.”
Chen Bo was slightly stunned, but he immediately nodded, “Understood.”
For Yang Fan.
What were five Xuan-grade Secret Realms, anyway?
Right now, his divine kingdom was certainly not lacking in troops.
“Yes, Young Master Yang, I will arrange it immediately,” Chen Bo responded instantly.
Facing a god like Yang Fan who casually produced ten trillion Divinity Points, he naturally didn’t dare to show the slightest bit of negligence.
Although he held the coordinates of these Secret Realms in his hands.
Chen Bo had already made a decision in his heart at this moment.
Even ten years later, he would never send troops to retake these Secret Realms.
Being able to rely on an ordinary background to walk step by step to today and establish a company of this scale, Chen Bo naturally didn’t rely on luck.
One of his greatest abilities was recognizing people.
From their meeting until now, Yang Fan had not displayed any of the arrogance typical of children from great families.
Whether speaking or his attitude when facing the transaction, he always maintained calmness.
Such a person was definitely incomparable to those second-generation heirs who were merely propped up by Clan Resources.
Furthermore, the fact that the other party could make Han Jue value him so much already explained many things in itself.
Therefore, even if Yang Fan was superficially only a First-Order God, Chen Bo would never easily offend him.
“President Chen.”
Before leaving, Yang Fan suddenly spoke.
“In the future, I might continue purchasing Secret Realm coordinates.”
“The larger the area, the better.”
Hearing these words, Chen Bo’s eyes instantly lit up.
“No problem!”
“Young Master Yang can rest assured, I have quite a few channels on my end.”
Yang Fan nodded, and then his consciousness exited the Virtual World.
In the Real World, the time was already very late, and Lu Wan had long since rested.
Yang Fan did not return to the bedroom; instead, sitting on a chair, his consciousness entered the divine kingdom.
Compared to the Real World, the time flow rate inside the divine kingdom was faster by God knows how much.
Before he entered, he had already handed the coordinates of the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms to Yang Da.
At this moment, inside the divine kingdom, the handover work of the five Secret Realms had already been fully completed.
“Master, matters regarding the Secret Realms have all been properly arranged.”
Yang Da bowed slightly, then snapped his fingers.
The next moment.
Five huge light screens simultaneously appeared in the center of the main hall.
Above the light screens, the current situation of the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms was being displayed in real time.

“Master, since the future main purpose of these Secret Realms is to serve as troop-stationing bases, I have already organized all the creatures, Spirit Plants, and mineral Resources originally existing within the Secret Realms.”
“The valuable Resources among them have all been transferred back to the Main Divine Kingdom through space channels.”
“Subsequently, they can be sold uniformly or used for the divine kingdom’s own development.”
“In addition, I also arranged for engineering machinery to modify the large mountain ranges inside the five Secret Realms.”
“All terrains affecting construction have been completely leveled.”
Speaking of this, Yang Da gently swiped his finger.
The image of one of the Secret Realms rapidly magnified.
One could see that the originally complex terrain had been completely altered.
A large number of flat areas appeared, with huge cities neatly lined up side by side.
“In addition, I procured a large number of war cities through the frontline trading area.”
Looking at the light screen, Yang Da continued to explain:
“These war cities are different from ordinary technological cities.”
“They do not pursue the comfort of believers’ daily lives, but rather serve warfare and Cultivate to the maximum extent.”
“A large number of entertainment facilities and non-essential buildings inside the cities have been canceled, and the space is entirely used for Cultivate areas.”

“These include large spirit-gathering Cultivate grounds, Martial Technique training grounds, battle formation drill areas, actual combat arenas, legion garrison camps, and war material reserve centers.”
“All architectural designs are meant to allow believers to rapidly enhance their strength and adapt to high-intensity warfare environments.”
“Believers living in this environment, although far less comfortable than the Main Divine Kingdom, will have their combat capabilities and growth speed enhanced to the maximum extent.”
Along with Yang Da’s introduction, the image before Yang Fan’s eyes changed once again.
The entire Secret Realm seemed to have turned into a huge military base.
“Master, please take a look.”
Yang Da continued to speak.
“Since the possibility of the Secret Realm coordinates being known by other gods is extremely high, the defense system must be perfected in advance.”
“I have purchased and deployed a Boundary-Suppressing Profound Heaven Great Wall on the periphery of each Secret Realm.”
“At the same time, they are equipped with F3500 fighter jets and a series of basic defense buildings.”
“Now the divine kingdom’s Mechanical Civilization is already capable of producing Patrol Robots, so in the outermost area of the Secret Realm, I have deployed a large number of Patrol Robots.”
“Once spatial fluctuations or hostile believers approaching are discovered, the information will be transmitted back to the Main Divine Kingdom at the first moment.”
“In addition, 1000 units of Intelligent Mecha produced by the divine kingdom are equipped in each Secret Realm, and dedicated intelligent lifeform are arranged to pilot them.”
“If a war truly breaks out, these Intelligent Mecha can form combat effectiveness at the very first moment.”
“The above is the defense system of the Secret Realm.”
After Yang Da finished speaking, the light screen changed once again.
The peripheral war defense zone disappeared, and the image shifted to the center of the Secret Realm.
“As a troop-stationing place for the Secret Realm, the most important issue is the long-term supply of food.”
Yang Da said earnestly.
“In order to keep the believers stationed in the Secret Realm maintaining sufficient Cultivate drive, I did not give them the same Resource treatment as the Main Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing this, a trace of interest appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Yang Da continued to speak:
“The believers of the Main Divine Kingdom currently enjoy spiritual liquid, and their Cultivate Resources are various Medicinal Pills as well as high-grade precious meat.”
“However, the ordinary believers in these five Secret Realms can only use basic Resources.”
“In each Secret Realm, I have purchased one hundred A-Rank Buildings — Spirit Origin Valley-Nurturing Pagodas.”
“This building can utilize the Secret Realm’s Spiritual Qi to Cultivate basic spiritual grain such as spiritual rice and spiritual wheat on a large scale.”
“Although it cannot compare with the Resources of the Main Divine Kingdom, it is temporarily sufficient to meet the daily consumption of billions of believers.”

With such a huge sum of floating capital, many of his plans in the Real World could be rolled out ahead of schedule.
For instance, purchasing shares of some high-quality companies for long-term investment.
Or even...
“Perhaps I can consider purchasing a habitable planet in a remote Starfield.”

Truly smart gods would never let their wealth lie dormant.
They needed to let money make money and keep Resources rolling continuously.

“You can send troops to take them over at any time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 416: Divine Kingdom Migration
paragraphs: With Yang Da’s introduction, towering silver-white buildings appeared in the center of the Secret Realm within the light screen.
Countless Mechanical devices operated around the buildings, and vast spiritual fields continuously grew mature spiritual rice.
“In addition, the food transport vehicles, transit stations, and energy storage devices have all been completely constructed by me.”
“In the future, the believers in these Secret Realms will receive resource distribution according to their strength.”
“The stronger the strength, the more Resources obtained.”
“Those who perform excellently can also re-enter the main Divine Kingdom to Cultivate.”
Yang Da paused for a moment and then said:
“In this way, it can not only ensure the long-term operation of the Secret Realm, but also allow these believers to always maintain a sense of competition.”
“In order to obtain a better cultivation environment, they will inevitably work harder to enhance their own strength.”
Looking at the five Secret Realms before him that were already taking shape, a hint of satisfaction gradually emerged in Yang Fan’s eyes.
As expected of intelligent lifeform.
Such a massive amount of engineering work was actually completely finished by Yang Da in such a short period of time.
However, the number of believers in the five Secret Realms is not considered large at present.
Through the light screen, Yang Fan could see that each Secret Realm currently had a population of about 1 billion.
“Has the issue of population selection and migration been resolved?” Yang Fan asked doubtfully.

“Reporting to Master, back then after the screening of the River of Hope, coupled with countless years of Evolution in the Divine Kingdom, the Aptitude of the believers in the Divine Kingdom is actually not bad at all now.”
Yang Da answered respectfully.
“If we simply use advanced Aptitude screening buildings to make a one-size-fits-all judgment on all believers, it is rather of little significance.”
“Therefore, after discussing with Yang Yi, we finally formulated a brand-new point evaluation system targeting the Immortal Alliance, Myriad Phenomena Martial Court, and Mechanical Civilization.”

“A comprehensive evaluation is conducted from multiple aspects such as personal strength, cultivation progress, cultivation time, Spirit Stone conversion rate, flesh-and-blood energy conversion rate, and Mechanical Heart utilization efficiency.”
“A bottom-elimination is carried out every 10 years. Currently, it is tentatively decided to eliminate 1% of the population, and then gradually adjust according to the actual situation.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly.
This method was obviously more reasonable than simply looking at talent.
After all, with the development of the Divine Kingdom up to now, the number of believers is far more than hundreds of millions.
Some believers had good talent, but were inherently lazy, making it difficult for them to achieve anything throughout their lives.
And some believers, although of ordinary talent, continuously achieved breakthroughs by relying on diligence and perseverance.
If one only looked at a single Aptitude, it would instead bury the latter.
“However, the population migration has indeed encountered some resistance.”
Yang Da continued to speak.
“Those believers who are slow in cultivation progress and slack off on weekdays often have a stronger independent consciousness.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“Stronger independent consciousness?”
“Could it be that they have developed dissatisfaction with me, a god?”
As soon as these words came out, Yang Da instantly knelt on both knees.
“Master, forgive me!”
“All believers exist because of the god. They were born within the Divine Kingdom, and believing in the god is a rule carved into the Origin.”
“They would never dare to have thoughts of disrespect towards the god.”
“Once such a thought appears, it is a great disrespect.”
“However...”
Yang Da paused for a moment.

“Attacking their own managers, thinking that Yang Yi was deceitful during the reform process, and even thinking that some managers used the reform to seek personal gains—such remarks occasionally appear.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan fell into silence.
But a moment later, he thought of a book on “Ideological Construction of Divine Kingdom Believers” that he had once read in the Primordial City Library.
Believing in the god was the underlying logic of the birth of believers in the Divine Kingdom, and this was a rule carved deep into their genes.
Therefore, believers would not truly go against the god.
But believers were lifeforms with independent consciousness after all.
They would have their own thoughts, pursue interests, crave power, and struggle for their own situation.
Some drifted with the current and echoed the words of others.
Some hoped to change their own destiny.
Some yearned for higher status, and some craved more freedom.
And this Secret Realm migration was essentially a redistribution of Resources inside the Divine Kingdom.
The living conditions of those believers migrated to the Secret Realm would inevitably decline.
When it involved their own interests, resistance would naturally arise.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan slowly opened his mouth.
“Yang Da, starting from now, change the approach to the Divine Kingdom migration reform.”
“Please give instructions, Master.” Yang Da said.
Yang Fan said indifferently:
“You shall issue a Divine Decree for me.”
“Tell all believers that the current development of the Divine Kingdom has entered a new stage.”
“This migration is for the grand plan of the Divine Kingdom for millions of years to come, and for all believers to have a broader world in the future.”
“The decision of the god cannot be violated.”
“This is the first.”
Yang Da nodded earnestly.
“However, the god is merciful.”
Yang Fan continued to speak:
“My believers migrated to the Secret Realm need to shoulder greater responsibilities and face more arduous environments.”
“Such contributions should naturally be rewarded.”
“Those who perform excellently are granted the title of ‘Divine Guards’.”
“They will assist intelligent lifeform in managing the Secret Realm and leading other believers.”
“This is the second.”
Speaking of this, a meaningful smile appeared at the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“Yang Da, at the very beginning, you can grant these Divine Guards certain rights, allowing them to obtain partial extra resource distribution rights, and even exploit and suppress other believers.”
“In this way, they will become the biggest supporters of the reform.”
“When the Secret Realm system is completely stable and everything gets on track, gradually take back the power.”
“By then, these Divine Guards can naturally be readjusted as well.”
Hearing this, light flickered constantly in Yang Da’s eyes, “Master is wise.”
Yang Fan shook his head.
“To deal with a mob, one naturally needs to use another mob.”
“However, as the extension of my will, you only need to be responsible for the general direction of the Divine Kingdom.”
“As for these specific matters, just let other intelligent lifeform handle them.”
Yang Da suddenly showed a look of sudden realization, “Master is brilliant!”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Remember, this is a technique, not the Dao.”
“It can help you complete this Divine Kingdom migration reform faster, but it cannot become the only way for you to govern the Divine Kingdom.”
“Those believers in the Secret Realm are equally important to me.”
“They are not only an important source of troops for the future, but also the Foundation for my continuous growth of power.”
Yang Fan’s gaze fell on the light screen and he slowly said:
“If we simply use these political maneuvering methods to make them migrate into the Secret Realm without providing them with channels to move upward,”
“then the final result will only be the birth of a group of good-for-nothings who rely on the Spiritual Origin Valley Pagoda for sustenance and wait for death every day.”
“No matter how large the number of such believers is, it has no meaning.”
“Your main task is still to research a reasonable promotion system.”
“Let the believers in the Secret Realm have light in their eyes and hope in their hearts.”
“Only in this way will they actively reproduce, actively Cultivate, and actively become stronger.”
“Ultimately, the entire Divine Kingdom can continue to grow!”

chapters.title: Chapter 417: Descending from the Upper Realm
paragraphs: Yang Da listened attentively, not daring to slack off in the slightest.
Yang Fan paused for a moment and continued,
“As a god, blindly exploiting and squeezing believers is ultimately short-sighted.”
“A truly powerful Divine Kingdom needs to design a reasonable system to let believers continuously grow relying on their own motivation.”
“Allowing the Divine Kingdom to form a virtuous cycle.”
“Do you understand?”
At this moment, there was a bit more solemnity in Yang Fan’s gaze toward Yang Da.
Between a god and believers, it seems to be an absolute control relationship.
But in reality, it is also a symbiotic relationship.
Now that Yang Fan had achieved a breakthrough to a First-Order God, he had long passed the days when he didn’t even have Faith Points at the beginning.
The area of the Divine Kingdom was becoming larger and larger, and its internal system was becoming more and more complete.
What he needed to consider was no longer just how to obtain more Resources, but how to make the entire Divine Kingdom possess the ability for sustainable development.
The stronger the believers, the stronger he, the god, would be.
Of course, during this process, competition could still exist, strata could still exist, and a certain degree of raising Gu and elimination were even still necessary.
But these methods must serve the development of the Divine Kingdom, rather than purely for exploitation.
A powerful Divine Kingdom inevitably requires classes.
Because only with the existence of classes would countless believers have a goal and desire to climb upward.
If all believers stood in the exact same position, they would instead gradually lose the motivation to move forward.
However, classes also could not be solidified.

Once the upward channel was completely closed and ordinary believers saw no hope, what would ultimately be born would only be a group of beings who had lost their fighting spirit and chosen to lie flat.
Right now, the Resources in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were extremely abundant.
As time passed, he had actually faintly sensed some problems.
Some believers began to show a trend of slackness.
After all, with the protection of high-tier believers and an adequate supply of Resources, they did not need to fight desperately like at the very beginning.
It was just that in the past, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had always been in a stage of high-speed expansion, and these problems had all been covered up by war, development, and resource growth.
Now, taking advantage of this Secret Realm migration opportunity, he would readjust the Divine Kingdom’s system.
Let all believers regain a sense of competition.
Divine Kingdom management was itself a profound discipline.
If the welfare was too poor and believers were excessively exploited, then the believers would ultimately only become mindless slaves.
They might obey, but they would have no value.
But if the welfare was too good, with no pressure and no competition, allowing all believers to easily obtain everything...
That would simply be raising idlers.
A truly good system should create pressure while giving hope.
Let the weak have the opportunity to change their fate, and let the strong have the motivation to continue climbing.
Only thus could the Divine Kingdom continuously operate and grow.
“This subordinate obeys the Master’s command.”
Yang Da bowed respectfully.
After explaining the general direction of the Divine Kingdom’s reform, Yang Fan did not stay any longer; his consciousness slowly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom and returned to the Real World.
At this moment, the villa was still peaceful and quiet.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, however, a massive reform involving hundreds of billions of believers had officially kicked off.
Following Yang Fan’s orders, Yang Da and several intelligent lifeform entities began formulating a detailed plan together.
Soon, a Divine Decree descended.
[My Divine Kingdom, having developed through endless years, has now expanded its territory and multiplied its believers, reaching a new stage.]
[The Great Migration of statues and the Divine Kingdom is a grand plan concerning the future for tens of millions of years.]
[This migration is for the greater prosperity of the Divine Kingdom and for all believers to have a more brilliant future.]

[Anyone who hinders the development of the Divine Kingdom and refuses to execute the migration plan will be regarded as betraying the will of the Divine Kingdom and shall be punished by the laws of the Divine Kingdom.]
[However, the god is merciful and cannot bear to treat any believer who contributes to the Divine Kingdom unfairly.]
[During this migration, anyone who performs exceptionally well, is loyal to the Divine Kingdom, and is willing to shoulder responsibilities will be bestowed the title of “Divine Guards”.]
[The Divine Guards come from among the believers, will represent the will of the numerous believers, and will jointly manage the Secret Realm with the intelligent lifeform of the Divine Kingdom.]
[They will gain glory and also shoulder responsibilities.]
[All for the future of the Divine Kingdom.]
The mighty voice instantly resounded throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
Countless believers raised their heads at this moment simultaneously.
They could not see the figure of the god, but they could clearly feel the majesty coming from the depths of their souls.
Among the major Cultivate systems, those powerful high-tier believers merely bowed respectfully toward the sky.
“We humbly obey the Divine Decree.”
After that, there were no other actions.
For them, this Divine Kingdom migration had little to do with them.
Believers above the Foundation Establishment Realm would not be included in the scope of this migration at all.
Those who truly needed to migrate were those lower-strength Tier 5 Beings.
They were the primary targets of this Divine Kingdom adjustment.
At this moment, expressions of struggle appeared on the faces of a large number of low-tier believers.
They naturally understood that this reform would change their lives.
Entering the Secret Realm meant leaving the currently relatively comfortable environment.
Yet facing the Divine Decree, they could not truly resist.
In the end, the low-tier believers lowered their heads one by one.
“We humbly obey the Divine Decree!”
“I, Azhuo, am willing to become a steadfast supporter of the Divine Kingdom migration plan!”
“The will of the god is the direction for us to move forward!”
Right at this moment, a pillar of pure white light suddenly descended from the sky.
It precisely enveloped Azhuo.
The next moment, Yang Da’s voice resounded throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
“Azhuo, loyal to the Divine Kingdom, actively responded to the migration plan.”
“You are specially bestowed the title of the first Divine Guard.”
“Starting today, enter Secret Realm Number One to collaborate with intelligent lifeform in managing the believers within the Secret Realm.”
“Specially rewarded with one Divinity Point.”
Boom!
The entire Divine Kingdom instantly boiled over.
Countless believers looked at that pillar of light in shock.
Even within the Heavenly Court, those high-and-mighty Nascent Soul Realm powerhouses could not help but reveal a trace of envy in their gazes toward Azhuo.
That was a Divinity Point!
It was currency belonging to the god.
To believers like them, it was incomparably precious.
An ordinary Tier 5 Being had unexpectedly obtained such glory and rewards simply by responding to the Divine Decree.
At this moment, the thoughts in the minds of countless low-tier believers began to change.
“Long live the god!”
“May the Divine Kingdom endure forever!”
“We are willing to support the Great Migration Plan of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Everything for the Divine Kingdom, everything for the god!”
A large number of believers began to shout fanatically.
They hoped their voices could be heard by the god.
They hoped the next pillar of light would descend upon themselves.
From then on, in the tenth year of the Divine Kingdom.
The number of low-tier believers who joined the migration plan had already reached as many as ten billion.
Among them, those who obtained the title of Divine Guard exceeded ten thousand people.
However, the Divine Kingdom migration was inherently a long process.

In order to make more believers actively accept change and at the same time make the entire plan more reasonable, after discussion, several intelligent lifeform entities began to further strengthen propaganda.
A large number of Divine Kingdom announcements began to spread.
“This is the ‘Descending from the Upper Realm’ movement.”
“Everything for the development of the Divine Kingdom, everything for the future of all believers!”
“Although the Secret Realm environment is harsher, precisely because of this, it can temper the will of the believers.”
“As long as you are willing to Cultivate, willing to endure hardship, and willing to strive, one day, you will be able to return to the Main Divine Kingdom!”
“For the god, for the Divine Kingdom, for a more brilliant future, we are willing to dedicate ourselves!”

sentences.text: Yang Da listened attentively, not daring to slack off in the slightest.
Yang Fan paused for a moment and continued,
“As a god, blindly exploiting and squeezing believers is ultimately short-sighted.”
“A truly powerful Divine Kingdom needs to design a reasonable system to let believers continuously grow relying on their own motivation.”
“Allowing the Divine Kingdom to form a virtuous cycle.”
“Do you understand?”
At this moment, there was a bit more solemnity in Yang Fan’s gaze toward Yang Da.
Between a god and believers, it seems to be an absolute control relationship.
But in reality, it is also a symbiotic relationship.
Now that Yang Fan had achieved a breakthrough to a First-Order God, he had long passed the days when he didn’t even have Faith Points at the beginning.
The area of the Divine Kingdom was becoming larger and larger, and its internal system was becoming more and more complete.
What he needed to consider was no longer just how to obtain more Resources, but how to make the entire Divine Kingdom possess the ability for sustainable development.
The stronger the believers, the stronger he, the god, would be.
Of course, during this process, competition could still exist, strata could still exist, and a certain degree of raising Gu and elimination were even still necessary.
But these methods must serve the development of the Divine Kingdom, rather than purely for exploitation.
A powerful Divine Kingdom inevitably requires classes.
Because only with the existence of classes would countless believers have a goal and desire to climb upward.
If all believers stood in the exact same position, they would instead gradually lose the motivation to move forward.
However, classes also could not be solidified.

Once the upward channel was completely closed and ordinary believers saw no hope, what would ultimately be born would only be a group of beings who had lost their fighting spirit and chosen to lie flat.
Right now, the Resources in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were extremely abundant.
As time passed, he had actually faintly sensed some problems.
Some believers began to show a trend of slackness.
After all, with the protection of high-tier believers and an adequate supply of Resources, they did not need to fight desperately like at the very beginning.
It was just that in the past, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had always been in a stage of high-speed expansion, and these problems had all been covered up by war, development, and resource growth.
Now, taking advantage of this Secret Realm migration opportunity, he would readjust the Divine Kingdom’s system.
Let all believers regain a sense of competition.
Divine Kingdom management was itself a profound discipline.
If the welfare was too poor and believers were excessively exploited, then the believers would ultimately only become mindless slaves.
They might obey, but they would have no value.
But if the welfare was too good, with no pressure and no competition, allowing all believers to easily obtain everything...
That would simply be raising idlers.
A truly good system should create pressure while giving hope.
Let the weak have the opportunity to change their fate, and let the strong have the motivation to continue climbing.

[The Divine Guards come from among the believers, will represent the will of the numerous believers, and will jointly manage the Secret Realm with the intelligent lifeform of the Divine Kingdom.]
[They will gain glory and also shoulder responsibilities.]

chapters.title: Chapter 418: No More Obstacles
paragraphs: The second decade of the Divine Kingdom.
The propaganda campaign achieved massive success.
Even many high-tier believers actively participated in the management of the Divine Kingdom in order to receive Divine Kingdom rewards.
“Couples in the Qi Refining Realm.”
“For the future of the Divine Kingdom, you must work harder to reproduce offspring.”
“For every new life born, you will be rewarded with 10 Spirit Stones.”
“If your child, upon reaching adulthood, is willing to participate in the ‘Descend from the Upper Realm’ plan and contribute their strength to the future of the Divine Kingdom...”
“...as parents, you will receive an extra reward of 50 Spirit Stones.”
“This is your glory.”
At this moment, in the Divine Kingdom’s City of Technology.
Previously, this place was mainly responsible for teaching Martial Techniques, Cultivation Method Legacies, Alchemy techniques, and forging knowledge.
But now, a new daily compulsory course had been added to all schools.
—”Descending from the Upper Realm Is the Fundamental Strategy of the Divine Kingdom.”
In a classroom, a group of five- and six-year-old children sat in their seats, listening attentively.
In front of the podium, a massive blue light screen floated in the air.
It displayed various scenes from inside the Secret Realms.
Vast lands, brand-new cities, believers Cultivating, and figures constantly striving for the future of the Divine Kingdom.
Meanwhile, a teacher in the Qi Refining Realm was giving a lecture via the light screen.
“Children, you are all the hope for the future of the Divine Kingdom, the flowers of the Divine Kingdom.”
“So you must Cultivate hard.”
“No matter whether you are in the main Divine Kingdom or inside a Secret Realm in the future...”
“...that is all striving for the God, all for the shared future of all believers.”
“Your light and warmth will one day illuminate every inch of the Divine Kingdom’s land.”
The teacher’s voice was gentle and filled with inspiration.
“For the God!”
“For the Divine Kingdom!”
Below, the childish voices of the group of kids rang out.
Among them, a child sitting in the corner said excitedly:
“I must go to a Secret Realm in the future!”
“To dedicate myself to the Divine Kingdom!”
“My mom said it’s great inside the Secret Realms, with lots of new cities and so many opportunities!”
The clothes on his body were somewhat worn, even showing a few patches, but at this moment, his eyes were full of yearning.
The 50th year of the Divine Kingdom.
Under the incentive of various policies, propaganda guidance, and the restraint of Divine Decrees...
...the Divine Kingdom Great Migration Plan had completely gotten onto the right track.
More and more low-tier believers actively applied to enter the Secret Realms.
The 60th year of the Divine Kingdom.
The total population of the five major Secret Realms surpassed 80 billion.
And the number of Divine Guards had exceeded one million.
Inside the Secret Realms at this moment, large numbers of Divine Guards were patrolling the war cities.
Among them, the vast majority were only Tier 5 Beings in strength.
However, every single one of them was equipped with a Tier 3 Smart Weapon.
In the eyes of those ordinary believers, they had already become high and mighty existences.
Whenever the Divine Guards passed through the streets, many believers would silently close their doors and hide indoors.
Power itself is a double-edged sword.
Back when pushing forward the Great Migration Plan, the Divine Guard system had indeed played a massive role.
They represented the God’s will, assisting intelligent lifeform in managing the Secret Realms.
They allowed countless believers to see opportunities for upward mobility.
And they also made those who were lazy and unwilling to change feel the pressure.
However... when power becomes overly concentrated, over time, changes are bound to occur.
Human nature is such that those who possess power often gradually become addicted to it.
They even forget the original purpose for which they obtained power.
In a certain Secret Realm city.
Bang!
A door was kicked wide open.
A man dressed in a Divine Guard uniform walked into the room.
The Smart Weapon in his hand instantly shifted forms, turning into a long metal staff.
The next moment, it struck violently toward a raggedly dressed believer in the corner.
“Serves you right for not Cultivating properly!”
“Serves you right for hiding every day!”
“So many years have passed, and your strength still hasn’t achieved a breakthrough!”
“Are you worthy of the God?”
The long metal staff came down time after time.
That believer curled up on the ground, not daring to resist at all.
And incidents like this were by no means isolated cases across the five major Secret Realms.
The 70th year of the Divine Kingdom.
Under Yang Da’s arrangements, the Divine Guard system was officially abolished.
A completely different movement began along with it.
Those Divine Guards who had once come into being because of the Great Migration Plan gradually suffered backlash after losing their power.
“You Divine Guards deceived the God! You are traitors to the Divine Kingdom!”
“We didn’t! We were merely executing the God’s will!”
“Bullshit! Lord Yang Yi already said so! You turned your backs on your original intentions long ago!”
“All these years, everything you did to us was not the God’s command at all!”
“It was you who abused your power!”
Angry voices resounded across the square.
Those once high-and-mighty Divine Guards had now lost their Smart Weapons as well as their special status.
For the first time, they felt the fear they had once inflicted upon others.
In the end, millions of Divine Guards were gathered in the central square of the Secret Realm to face judgment from all the believers.
“You are parasites of the Divine Kingdom!”
“Back then, my father was driven to death by you!”
“For the God, we must purge scum like you!”
Countless believers gathered.
They released all the emotions they had pent up over the years at this very moment.
Vast quantities of spirit rice, cooked food, and even slop were splashed by the angry crowd onto those immovable Divine Guards.
“Purge them!”
“For the God!”
“For the Divine Kingdom!”
At this moment, in the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Yang Da stood there quietly.
In front of him, light screens unfolded one after another.
They displayed everything happening within the five major Secret Realms in real time.
Watching this scene, Yang Da nodded slowly, his eyes flashing with light.
“With this, Master’s plan has achieved Perfected.”
“The Divine Guard system has fulfilled its original mission.”
“It pushed forward the Great Migration Plan and allowed the Divine Kingdom to establish a new order.”
“And now, the old system has been purged, and the new management system will be taken over by intelligent lifeform.”
“From now on, the Divine Kingdom Great Migration will become a fundamental national policy for the long-term development of the Divine Kingdom.”
“intelligent lifeform will set the standards and filter through rigid metrics; there will be no more obstacles.”
In the days that followed, Yang Fan no longer wasted time.
Apart from entering the Divine Kingdom at set times daily to check on the believers’ migration situation...

...for the rest of his time, Yang Fan spent almost all of it buried in the Primordial City Library, continuously absorbing knowledge regarding Divine Kingdom development, business operations, warfare systems, and various God-related subjects.
Under the effect of the Evolution Talent, one day outside meant a hundred years had passed in the Divine Kingdom.
In just a few short days, the Divine Kingdom Great Migration Plan had completely gotten onto the right track.
Among the five Xuan-grade Secret Realms, each had now taken in a population of 50 to 60 billion.
Although compared to the massive area of a Xuan-grade Secret Realm—which easily spanned tens of billions of square kilometers—this population still seemed extremely sparse...
...for Yang Fan, this was merely a beginning.
Now his Divine Kingdom possessed a hundred-fold time acceleration, coupled with the effect of the A-rank talent, Life Reproduction.
Driven by various policies encouraging childbirth, the number of believers was growing at a terrifying speed.
After each batch of believers migrated into a Secret Realm, it would take only a few years for new babies to be born continuously.
And those believers inside the Secret Realms were likewise constantly reproducing.
Through such continuous cycles, Yang Fan could clearly feel that in the Real World, both his Physical Body strength and Mental Strength were rising at a steady pace.
