chapters.title: Chapter 419: The Situation of the Earth-grade Secret Realm
paragraphs: Soon, the agreed-upon time for the exploration of the Earth-grade Secret Realm arrived.
On this day, the Star Group Shareholder Group chat in Yang Fan’s Feixun lit up.
As soon as he entered the chat, Han Jue sent a message.
“Brothers, the time has come. Are the Divine Kingdom armies ready?”
Immediately following that, a concise reply appeared.
Sima Tianci: “Already prepared.”
Lu Wan: “+1.”
Qin Zheng: “+1.”
Yang Fan: “+1.”
Seeing the replies from several people, Han Jue smiled, “Then let’s begin.”
The next moment, an encrypted coordinate was sent into the chat group.
Yang Fan and Lu Wan exchanged glances, not saying much.
Their consciousnesses simultaneously entered their respective Divine Kingdoms.
Inside the Main Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Yang Da had already completed all preparations.
The vast Mechanical legion was lined up across the land of the Divine Kingdom.
For this Earth-grade Secret Realm exploration, Yang Fan did not mobilize the forces of the Immortal Alliance, the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court, the Zombie Kingdom, or the Elf Kingdom.
Instead, he chose to let the Mechanical Civilization take full charge.
On one hand, within the Divine Kingdom today, the Mechanical Civilization possessed the strongest true combat capability.
Sending out the Mechanical believers was already enough to show Yang Fan’s sincerity.
After all, in terms of business and connections, the help he could provide to the Star Group wasn’t much.
Therefore, regarding the company’s initial Secret Realm exploration, he naturally needed to shoulder a bit more responsibility.
Otherwise, it would inevitably cause Han Jue, the Chairman, to feel dissatisfied.
However, Yang Fan likewise would not expose his true strength.
Although the Mechanical Civilization was powerful, the essence of its warfare did not lie in the personal strength of the believers themselves.
Mechanical believers relied on the continuous research, manufacturing, and upgrading of weapons of war.
Even for intelligent lifeform, their combat methods similarly required relying on successively updated Smart Weapons.
Therefore, dispatching only the Mechanical Civilization to participate in battle could both demonstrate strength and maximize the concealment of the Divine Kingdom’s true foundation.
“Master, according to your orders, a total of five billion Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform forms have been mobilized for this exploration.”
“In addition to that, there are ten thousand Intelligent Mechas, five Great Void Warships, and five Mechanical War Puppets.”
Yang Da’s voice sounded.
The next moment, across the entire land of the Divine Kingdom, countless Mechanical believers were neatly arranged.
Five billion Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform forms formed a vast military formation.
The towering Intelligent Mechas stood among them, resembling Steel Giants.
Five Great Void Warships hovered high in the air, their massive Mechanical structures exuding a cold metallic luster.
The five Mechanical War Puppets stood in the center of the military array, like five unshakeable fortresses of war.
The entire army stretched as far as the eye could see, with no end in sight.
There were no battle cries, no clamor, and not even any superfluous movements.
All the intelligent lifeform forms were like the most precise weapons, quietly awaiting the final command.
“With just this bit of military force, it shouldn’t be too special, right?”
Yang Fan looked at the army before him and nodded with satisfaction.
Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform was equivalent to believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Yang Fan had actually hesitated for a long time regarding the scale of this sortie.
After all, within his Divine Kingdom nowadays, the number of Third-class intelligent lifeform forms equivalent to the Core Formation Realm had already exceeded twenty billion.
If he were to directly mobilize these Third-class intelligent lifeform forms to participate in the exploration, that would simply be too exaggerated.
After all, even though Han Jue and the others were all geniuses of the Five Great Families, they had only just broken through to become gods not long ago.
Such a terrifying number of high-tier believers would easily arouse suspicion.
“According to the data, a newly developed Earth-grade Secret Realm indeed likely contains quite a few powerful creatures.”
“There are even some wild creatures whose strength can reach the Nascent Soul Realm or above.”
“However, with the presence of these Intelligent Mechas, it should be enough to cope.”
“The force invested for the first time should be just right.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan no longer hesitated.
He looked at Yang Da and gently nodded.
The next moment.
Accompanied by spatial fluctuations.
Yang Fan’s consciousness, following the Divine Kingdom army, was teleported together to the periphery of the Earth-grade Secret Realm.
Before his eyes was a boundless primitive Secret Realm.
Looking out, huge ancient trees rose straight from the ground, and thick vines wound around the mountains and rivers like giant pythons.
All kinds of bizarre plants covered the ground, and some even grew huge flowers dozens of meters tall, radiating a rich aura of life.
The entire Secret Realm seemed to have been completely covered by vegetation.
Even in just the outer areas, Yang Fan could feel the extraordinary nature of these plants.
After a long period of Evolution, the life here had already undergone a certain degree of metamorphosis.
Some long-standing Spirit Plants might even give birth to spiritual intelligence; this was the so-called’spiritual transformation’ within the Divine Kingdom world.
Some powerful Secret Realms were not only rich in Resources, but also bred all sorts of incredible life forms within them.
Yang Fan looked at this scene before him, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
He could feel that the life aura within the entire Secret Realm was extremely dense.
And the Spiritual Qi concentration here actually reached about a few hundredths of his own Divine Kingdom.
“No wonder Wan’er said that an unexploited Earth-grade Secret Realm has a resource value of at least several trillion Divinity Points or more.”
Yang Fan calmly nodded.
At this moment, his consciousness was standing on the shoulder of an Intelligent Mecha manufactured by the Mechanical Civilization.
The massive Mechanical body stood tall outside the Secret Realm, like a moving steel mountain.
“Eh?”
“Where are Han Jue and the others? Could it be they haven’t arrived yet?”
Yang Fan glanced around, feeling somewhat puzzled.
Right at this moment, four conscious projections slowly rose from the ground and arrived beside Yang Fan.
They were precisely Han Jue, Lu Wan, Qin Zheng, and Sima Tianci.
However, at this moment, the expressions of all four were somewhat complex.
The gazes they directed at Yang Fan held admiration, shock, bewilderment, and even mixed with a trace of thinly veiled fear.
“Husband.”
Lu Wan arrived by Yang Fan’s side and couldn’t help but complain coquettishly.
“Even though it’s an Earth-grade Secret Realm exploration, there’s no need for you to move out your entire family fortune from the Divine Kingdom, right?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s heart suddenly skipped a beat.
“Not good.”
“Could it be that even after I reduced my military configuration over and over again, it’s still too exaggerated?”
You must know that what he brought this time were merely Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform forms, believers equivalent to the Foundation Establishment Realm at best.
As for the Third-class intelligent lifeform forms, or even Fourth-class intelligent lifeform forms in the Divine Kingdom, he hadn’t even considered sending them out.
After all, the number of those high-tier believers was simply too large.
If they were truly exposed, no matter how one looked at it, it didn’t look like the foundation a First-Order God who had just broken through not long ago should possess.
However, looking at Lu Wan and the others’ reactions...
It seemed he had still overestimated these geniuses of the Five Great Families.
On the other side.
Sima Tianci had completely transformed into a curious baby.
His conscious projection came directly beside an Intelligent Mecha, looking at it from the left and touching it from the right.
“Is this thing real?”
“Old Yang, your Divine Kingdom can already manufacture weapons of war on its own?”

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Showcasing Wealth?
paragraphs: Sima Tianci raised his head and looked at the endless Intelligent Mecha before him, feeling his scalp tingle.
If such an army were to appear within his divine kingdom,
solely relying on the combat power of his believers themselves, there would probably be no possibility of resisting at all.
“Brother Yang, you’re such a great friend!”
Han Jue also walked over at this moment, his face full of emotion.
“To actually bring five billion Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform forms over for exploration, this makes me feel a bit embarrassed.”
As the initiator of this exploration plan, Han Jue originally thought the forces he prepared were already sufficient.
But now seeing Yang Fan’s lineup, he suddenly felt like he was just here to play a supporting role.
Han Jue walked the Cultivation Path.
Having broken through to a god for less than a year now, the core combat power in his divine kingdom was still dominated by believers in the Qi Refining Realm.
Although the number of believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm was not small, there was still a huge gap from one billion.
An Earth-grade Secret Realm exploration, and it was even jointly participated by five people.
Naturally, it was impossible for him to stake all the trump cards of his divine kingdom.
But Yang Fan... this no longer looked like exploration.
It looked more like leading an army to launch a Divine Kingdom War.
“Brother Yang, a grand gesture.”
Qin Zheng also couldn’t help but sigh with emotion.
His gaze swept across the Great Void Warships floating on both sides of the Intelligent Mecha, as well as those five Mechanical War Puppets exuding a terrifying aura.
At this moment, he finally understood one thing.
Why Yang Fan was able to independently conquer an Foreign Deity not long after breaking through to a god.
The reason was very simple, because Yang Fan was not walking the development route of a normal god at all.
After breaking through, many gods would prioritize cultivating resource-type buildings to allow their divine kingdoms to rapidly accumulate wealth.
But Yang Fan was different; he was definitely walking the path of supporting war through war.
Qin Zheng even suspected that the development direction of Yang Fan’s divine kingdom was probably a pure war route.
This guy...
Could he be that kind of warmonger who completely invests zero in resource industries and only thinks about constantly starting wars?
Thinking of this, Qin Zheng’s gaze toward Yang Fan became somewhat complicated.
Watching the reactions of several people, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
No matter what, these people were the top geniuses of the younger generation of the Five Great Families.
He had already hidden his strength as much as possible.
He even only dispatched the most ordinary part of the power within the Mechanical Civilization.
Unexpectedly... just revealing the tip of the iceberg had already shocked them to this extent.
“I clearly wanted to keep a low profile.” Yang Fan sighed helplessly in his heart.
Yang Fan gave a light cough, then explained:
“Regarding the future development of the Star Group, I really can’t help much.”
“So for this Secret Realm exploration, I thought about contributing a bit more, which can also be considered as making up for my guilt.”
“Therefore, I brought over the current main combat forces of my divine kingdom.”
Hearing this, Han Jue couldn’t help but immediately raise a thumb.
“Brother Yang truly is a decent person!”
“I was originally worried that there were some powerful living beings in this Earth-grade Secret Realm, and at that time, I might need to purchase war weapons from the outside world to invest in it.”
“Now it seems I was worrying for nothing.”
Han Jue was full of smiles.
Actually, with Han Jue’s identity, wanting to explore an Earth-grade Secret Realm was not a difficult matter at all.
As one of the Five Great Families of the Human Federation,
whether it was their influence in the army or the connections they had accumulated themselves, was far from being comparable to ordinary gods.
Even without mobilizing Clan power, relying on his identity as a direct descendant of the Han Family, he could still invite some Mid-tier Gods to help out.
But in this world, everything has a price.
With insufficient personal strength and relying solely on Clan deterrence, Han Jue could not guarantee whether the experts invited would truly be reliable.
After all, this was an undeveloped Earth-grade Secret Realm.
Facing Resources worth millions of billions or even higher value, not many gods could truly maintain their sanity.
If there was no absolute strength to suppress the situation, even a direct descendant of the Han Family would not dare guarantee that no one would harbor crooked thoughts in front of interests.
Therefore, Han Jue chose to cooperate with peers.
Everyone would share the risks together and share the profits together.
But the problem was...
Although these people were all top geniuses of the younger generation of the Five Great Families, after all, they had just broken through to become gods not long ago.
Even though they each had a major Clan behind them and the foundation of their divine kingdoms far exceeded ordinary gods,
wanting to truly explore an Earth-grade Secret Realm that had never been developed still posed considerable pressure.
However, the power Yang Fan displayed now completely exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Leaving aside the five billion Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform forms for the moment,
just those Intelligent Mecha, Great Void Warships, and Mechanical War Puppets were already a foundation that ordinary Low-rank Deitys could not possess.
Exactly how many Divinity Points were invested in this?
Just thinking about it probably made one’s scalp tingle.
Thinking of this, Han Jue couldn’t help but glance at Lu Wan standing beside Yang Fan.
His heart instantly became even more envious.
“Knowing how to marry a wife is truly great!”
Han Jue silently raised a thumb for Yang Fan in his heart.
“Right, where are your believer armies?”
Yang Fan glanced around and asked with some confusion.
Hearing this, Sima Tianci reached out and pointed in a certain direction.
“Mine is over there.”
Looking along his finger,
Yang Fan then discovered that on the periphery of the Mechanical army, in a distant corner, there was a small area where a group of believers gathered.
Compared to Yang Fan’s overwhelming Mechanical legion, it looked simply like a forgotten little corner.
“I walk the Cultivation Path.”
Sima Tianci explained:
“Entering an unknown Secret Realm for the first time, it is still mainly about investigating the situation.”
“So I only brought eighty million Qi Refining Stage believers and twenty million Foundation Establishment Realm believers.”
“Of course, this time I also brought two believers who have already cultivated to the Core Formation Realm.”
“With them around, we can deploy a B-Rank Formation at that time, which can also increase some security guarantees.”
When Sima Tianci spoke up to this point, his tone still carried a bit of confidence.
But the next moment, his gaze inadvertently swept across the Mechanical army behind Yang Fan.
His voice instantly grew smaller and smaller, and finally he fell silent altogether.
Originally for this Secret Realm exploration, Sima Tianci had thought about taking on more responsibility.
So he specially brought two Core Formation Realm believers.
But now...
Looking at the endless Intelligent Mecha,
he suddenly felt that his preparations seemed somewhat redundant.
“Cough...”
Sima Tianci gave a dry cough and did not continue speaking.
“The believer armies of Han Jue and me are over there.”
Qin Zheng also helplessly pointed to the other side at this moment.
“However, Brother Yang, these war weapons of yours really take up too much space.”
“Our believers are almost being squeezed into the corner.”
Qin Zheng’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch.
At this moment, apart from suspecting whether Yang Fan was walking a pure war route, he had an inexplicable feeling in his heart.
How come he felt... that Yang Fan was showcasing wealth?

chapters.title: Chapter 421: My money!
paragraphs: And they were flaunting their wealth right in front of direct descendants of the Five Great Families.
It was bizarre, yet they were genuinely stunned.
Which First-Order God could possess war weapons of such scale?
Leaving aside how many Mechanical Hearts it takes for a Mechanical Civilization to nurture intelligent lifeform.
Just the various rare metals needed to forge these war weapons were already an astronomical figure.
Usually, outsiders looked at these direct descendants of the Five Great Families as if they were looking at super rich second-generation heirs.
But at this moment...
Qin Zheng felt for the first time that he seemed to have met a truly wealthy tycoon.
“Husband, my believers are over there.”
Lu Wan said softly.
Yang Fan looked in the direction she pointed and saw only a small area there.
“There are twenty million Martial Apprentices and ten million Martial Masters.”
Lu Wan explained.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help raising his eyebrows.
Then he looked at his wife with a strange gaze.
Good grief, his wife was clearly planning to put in minimal effort without actually contributing.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help feeling a bit regretful.
Had he known this earlier, he should have asked Lu Wan beforehand how much force he should dispatch.
Looking at it now...
The foundation of his Divine Kingdom seemed to have already created too big of a gap compared to ordinary Low-rank Deitys.
He clearly wanted to keep a low profile.
As a result...
He still unknowingly flexed in a huge way.
Things had come to this.
No matter how much Yang Fan regretted it, it was meaningless now.
He could only silently warn himself in his heart that he must learn to communicate with his wife in advance when doing things in the future.
After all, the Evolution Talent seemed a bit too monstrous.
“Well...”
Yang Fan gave a light cough.
“Shall we begin?”
“Let me open the way in front.”
“I agree!”
Sima Tianci was the first to raise his hand.
“To be honest, I feel that the troops I brought are simply a joke in front of Brother Yang’s group of steel behemoths.”
“Today, I’ll just ride on Brother Yang’s coattails to witness the true battlefield fighting methods of a Mechanical Civilization.”
As a candidate for head of the Sima Family, Sima Tianci naturally had very rich theoretical knowledge regarding the development of Divine Kingdoms.
As one of the most mainstream development routes for Human race gods, the Mechanical Path was certainly not unfamiliar to him.
Even within the Clan, he had seen a large amount of video materials regarding the combat of Mechanical gods.
But theory was ultimately just theory.
Videos and witnessing the Mechanical army sweeping across the battlefield with one’s own eyes were completely different things.
What’s more... Yang Fan’s Intelligent Mecha were simply too domineering.
Sima Tianci was genuinely a bit curious.
Yang Fan nodded politely.
Afterwards, he issued an order with his consciousness.
“Set out.”
The next moment, the mighty Mechanical army began to move.
The Intelligent Mecha walked at the very front, and with every step they took, the entire earth seemed to tremble slightly.
Five billion intelligent lifeform forms formed neat square formations one after another, following closely behind with completely uniform strides.
There was no noise at all in the entire legion, only the sound of Mechanical footsteps trampling the earth echoing continuously.
Meanwhile, the believers of Lu Wan, Han Jue, and the others silently followed at the very rear.
Compared to Yang Fan’s terrifying Mechanical army, they looked more like a sightseeing tour group at this moment.
“Brother Yang...”
Han Jue looked at this scene before him and couldn’t help opening his mouth wide.
“Aren’t you cultivating three routes simultaneously?”
“Why is this Mechanical Path so ridiculously strong?”
As the Mechanical army went deeper, the dangers within the Earth-grade Secret Realm gradually revealed themselves.
The vegetation here had evolved through countless years and could no longer be described as ordinary plants.
Some huge vines sensed foreign life approaching and instantly burst out of the ground, wrapping around the Intelligent Mecha like giant pythons.
There were also sharp thorns on the surface of some plants, releasing terrifying venom.
Even some giant flowers slowly opened, spitting out highly corrosive poisonous mist in an attempt to erode the metallic bodies of the Intelligent Mecha.
However...
These attacks were meaningless to Yang Fan’s army.
The Intelligent Mecha did not even pause.
With a single step down, those incomparably tough vines were instantly crushed into powder.
Facing the deadly poison capable of corroding ordinary divine weapons, the defense System on the surface of the Intelligent Mecha only flashed slightly before completely isolating it.
From beginning to end, Yang Fan didn’t even issue any attack command.
Relying solely on the power of the Mechanical army advancing, they pushed straight through all the way.
In a short period of time, they had already advanced tens of thousands of kilometers.
Seeing this scene, the shock in the hearts of Han Jue and the others became even more intense.
“Cultivating three routes simultaneously consumes too many Resources.”
Yang Fan explained with a smile:
“As the saying goes, ten birds in the forest are not as good as one in the hand.”
“Therefore, my Divine Kingdom is still mainly developed focusing on the Mechanical Path.”
“As for the other routes, I haven’t developed them much.”
“I see.”
Sima Tianci nodded thoughtfully.
“Simultaneous cultivation of three lines, although having great advantages within the same Realm.”
“Also has a terrifying consumption of time and Resources.”
“In a Divine Kingdom War, the most important thing is to have the power to win with a single blow.”
“Otherwise, no matter how comprehensive the development is, it’s just being balanced.”
Han Jue and Qin Zheng also nodded in approval.
“Apart from the huge resource consumption, the Mechanical Path basically has no obvious shortcomings.”
Han Jue sighed with emotion.
“Moreover, developing to the Late Stage, Mechanical gods can completely rely on selling buildings and war weapons produced by their own Divine Kingdom to acquire a large amount of Divinity Points.”
“That money-making speed is truly exaggerated.”
“Among the wealthiest batch of High-Order Gods in the Human Federation, a large proportion of them are Mechanical gods.”
Speaking of this, Han Jue looked at Yang Fan full of envy.
Judging from the power Yang Fan was currently displaying, the Mechanical Civilization in his Divine Kingdom had clearly gotten onto the right track.
And it even possessed a certain production and profitability capability.
The gap between the two Divine Kingdoms was probably widened by at least four or five years, or even a decade.
“As expected of the Hundredfold Time Sequence Talent.”
Han Jue sighed in his heart.
“As long as Resources are sufficient, this development speed is indeed too terrifying.”
However, although Han Jue was shocked, he did not produce any sense of frustration because of this.
Divine Kingdom development was inherently a long-distance race.
Short-term leadership did not mean permanent leadership.
His talent was likewise not weak.
Relying on the Han Family behind him, he possessed countless Resources and opportunities.
As long as he managed his Divine Kingdom earnestly, there would surely be a day in the future when he caught up to Yang Fan.
Thinking of this, the envy in Han Jue’s eyes gradually turned into anticipation.
The pioneering speed of Yang Fan and the others was extremely fast.
Within this vast Earth-grade Secret Realm, their consciousness seemed to be watching a fast-forwarding slide show.
Several months flashed by in an instant.
The Secret Realm here was not only filled with dangerous mutated plants; as everyone went deeper, more and more precious high-grade Spirit Plants began to appear in everyone’s field of vision.
“Brother Yang, make these big chunks of iron slower!”
Han Jue looked at a hill ahead that had just been stepped over by the Intelligent Mecha, and his face turned somewhat dark.
“That’s a B-grade Spirit Plant, it just got trampled into nothingness like that!”
Yang Fan took a look, then coughed awkwardly, “Alright, I’ll pay attention.”
However, the next moment, Qin Zheng’s voice came from the other side again.
“Brother Yang, wait!”
“That’s an A-grade Spirit Fruit tree, worth a fortune, don’t let your Intelligent Mecha snap it!”
“Got it.” Yang Fan responded helplessly.
Just at this moment, Han Jue suddenly let out a wail.
“Grandpa Yang, slower!”
“Those are all Divinity Points!”
“Money! My money!”

sentences.text: And they were flaunting their wealth right in front of direct descendants of the Five Great Families.
It was bizarre, yet they were genuinely stunned.
Which First-Order God could possess war weapons of such scale?
Leaving aside how many Mechanical Hearts it takes for a Mechanical Civilization to nurture intelligent lifeform.
Just the various rare metals needed to forge these war weapons were already an astronomical figure.
Usually, outsiders looked at these direct descendants of the Five Great Families as if they were looking at super rich second-generation heirs.
But at this moment...
Qin Zheng felt for the first time that he seemed to have met a truly wealthy tycoon.
“Husband, my believers are over there.”
Lu Wan said softly.
Yang Fan looked in the direction she pointed and saw only a small area there.
“There are twenty million Martial Apprentices and ten million Martial Masters.”
Lu Wan explained.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help raising his eyebrows.
Then he looked at his wife with a strange gaze.
Good grief, his wife was clearly planning to put in minimal effort without actually contributing.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help feeling a bit regretful.
Had he known this earlier, he should have asked Lu Wan beforehand how much force he should dispatch.
Looking at it now...
The foundation of his Divine Kingdom seemed to have already created too big of a gap compared to ordinary Low-rank Deitys.
He clearly wanted to keep a low profile.
As a result...
He still unknowingly flexed in a huge way.
Things had come to this.
No matter how much Yang Fan regretted it, it was meaningless now.
He could only silently warn himself in his heart that he must learn to communicate with his wife in advance when doing things in the future.
After all, the Evolution Talent seemed a bit too monstrous.
“Well...”
Yang Fan gave a light cough.
“Shall we begin?”
“Let me open the way in front.”
“I agree!”
Sima Tianci was the first to raise his hand.
“To be honest, I feel that the troops I brought are simply a joke in front of Brother Yang’s group of steel behemoths.”
“Today, I’ll just ride on Brother Yang’s coattails to witness the true battlefield fighting methods of a Mechanical Civilization.”
As a candidate for head of the Sima Family, Sima Tianci naturally had very rich theoretical knowledge regarding the development of Divine Kingdoms.
As one of the most mainstream development routes for Human race gods, the Mechanical Path was certainly not unfamiliar to him.
Even within the Clan, he had seen a large amount of video materials regarding the combat of Mechanical gods.
But theory was ultimately just theory.
Videos and witnessing the Mechanical army sweeping across the battlefield with one’s own eyes were completely different things.
What’s more...
Yang Fan’s Intelligent Mecha were simply too domineering.
Sima Tianci was genuinely a bit curious.
Yang Fan nodded politely.
Afterwards, he issued an order with his consciousness.
“Set out.”
The next moment, the mighty Mechanical army began to move.
The Intelligent Mecha walked at the very front, and with every step they took, the entire earth seemed to tremble slightly.
Five billion intelligent lifeform forms formed neat square formations one after another, following closely behind with completely uniform strides.
There was no noise at all in the entire legion, only the sound of Mechanical footsteps trampling the earth echoing continuously.
Meanwhile, the believers of Lu Wan, Han Jue, and the others silently followed at the very rear.
Compared to Yang Fan’s terrifying Mechanical army, they looked more like a sightseeing tour group at this moment.

Han Jue looked at this scene before him and couldn’t help opening his mouth wide.
“Aren’t you cultivating three routes simultaneously?”
“Why is this Mechanical Path so ridiculously strong?”

The vegetation here had evolved through countless years and could no longer be described as ordinary plants.
Some huge vines sensed foreign life approaching and instantly burst out of the ground, wrapping around the Intelligent Mecha like giant pythons.
There were also sharp thorns on the surface of some plants, releasing terrifying venom.
Even some giant flowers slowly opened, spitting out highly corrosive poisonous mist in an attempt to erode the metallic bodies of the Intelligent Mecha.
However...
These attacks were meaningless to Yang Fan’s army.
The Intelligent Mecha did not even pause.
With a single step down, those incomparably tough vines were instantly crushed into powder.

Relying solely on the power of the Mechanical army advancing, they pushed straight through all the way.

“As the saying goes, ten birds in the forest are not as good as one in the hand.”

chapters.title: Chapter 422: I Want to Be a Good Man
paragraphs: At this moment, Han Jue’s conscious projection looked at the chaotic and ruined area in the distance, falling into complete silence.
Just now, hundreds of massive giant pythons had appeared within the Secret Realm, coiling atop a spirit mountain, each nearly a thousand meters long.
Judging from their bloodline fluctuations, they had clearly evolved continuously from snake clans like the Bodhi Precious Snake.
These giant pythons were not weak in strength, and a few of them had even reached a level comparable to the Core Formation Realm.
However, Yang Fan found them troublesome and directly had the Intelligent Mecha fire an air cannon.
Boom!
The terrifying energy instantly swept across, and the hundreds of giant pythons turned into blood mists on the spot.
But at the same time, that spirit mountain was also directly razed to the ground under this single strike.
A large number of Spirit Plants and precious medicines originally growing around it were all destroyed by the terrifying shockwave.
Looking at this scene before him, Han Jue’s heart was bleeding.
” Are these direct descendants of the Five Great Families... this poor? “
Looking at the heartbroken expressions of several people, Yang Fan couldn’t help but rub his temples.
He truly couldn’t quite understand.
Weren’t they just some Spirit Plants?
Was it worth being this heartbroken?
Just at this moment, Lu Wan stepped forward.
” Everyone, how about we let intelligent lifeform take charge of the command from here on out? “
” These war weapons are indeed too strong. If we continue to use them to clear wasteland, the damage to the Secret Realm environment will be extremely severe. “

” Afterwards, we should still let believers cooperate with the Otherworldly Collector for exploration. When encountering powerful living beings that cannot be resolved, we can then consider deploying war weapons. “
Hearing this, Han Jue and the others instantly felt a sense of relief.
” That’s right, President Lu is right! “
Han Jue quickly nodded.
” Brother Yang, the combat power of your big guy is indeed unquestionable, but when it comes to wasteland clearing, we still have to rely on professionalism! “
” This Earth-grade Secret Realm will be an important industry for the Star Group in the future. We can’t let you just flatten it all the way like this. “
” Professional matters should still be left to professional people. “
Saying this, Han Jue hurried forward and patted Yang Fan on the shoulder.
” Brother Yang, next you can just sit back in peace and collect your dividends. “
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly; he naturally heard the implication in Han Jue’s words.
This was looking down on his ability to clear wasteland.
But thinking of the scene just now, Yang Fan could only nod helplessly, ” Very well. “
After all, he originally just wanted to show a bit of his sincerity.
Now it seemed the effect had also been achieved.
Under the arrangement of several people, Yang Fan teleported all the Intelligent Mecha back to his Divine Kingdom.
Leaving only 5 billion Second-Rank Intelligent Lifeform and corresponding Smart Weapons to be responsible for subsequent exploration work.
As for the person in charge of commanding this wasteland clearing, it was changed to Yang Er.
As intelligent lifeform under Yang Fan, Yang Er was naturally extremely familiar with such resource extraction and Secret Realm exploration work.
Meanwhile, Han Jue and the others also successively transferred the intelligent lifeform from their respective Divine Kingdoms.
A large number of Otherworldly Collector units, resource appraisal robots, and data recording robots began entering the Secret Realm.
The originally chaotic wasteland clearing work quickly entered an orderly state.
After arranging everything, the consciousness of several people also successively withdrew from the Secret Realm.
In the Real World, Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
Coming into view was Lu Wan’s exceptionally serious and pretty face.
” What is it, wife Wan’er? “
Yang Fan asked with some confusion.
” Husband, how about... I still transfer those 100 trillion Divinity Points to you! “
Lu Wan suddenly said seriously.
Yang Fan was stunned for a moment, not reacting right away.
” What’s wrong? Wan’er, why did you suddenly say that? “
Lu Wan hesitated for a moment, then whispered:
” Husband, your Divine Kingdom is currently mainly developing the Mechanical Path, and the consumption is truly too huge. “
Saying this, her face turned slightly red.
” And Husband, you seem to... be a little bit extravagant and wasteful. “
” I’m afraid you won’t have enough Divinity Points in the future. “
After witnessing Yang Fan’s army in the Secret Realm, Lu Wan felt both shocked and somewhat worried in her heart.
She could naturally see the strength of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Those Intelligent Mecha, she had long since had her own intelligent lifeform conduct a detailed analysis of them.
Whether it was the external armor or the internal core structure, all of them adopted extremely precious alloy materials.
Not to mention the intelligent lifeform cultivation, research and development costs involved, as well as the construction expenses of the complete production line.
Solely regarding the material cost of a single Intelligent Mecha itself, it was already close to a hundred Divinity Points.
For 100,000 Intelligent Mecha, the material expenses alone were an extremely terrifying number.
And this was only the most basic part of it.
As a president managing numerous enterprises in the Real World, Lu Wan was very clear about the development model of Mechanical gods.
Although the Mechanical Path was powerful, it was also one of the routes that burned through Resources the most.
If one wanted to make money by relying on the Mechanical Path, the core consisted of four words—scale effect.
Only by forming a huge production system, manufacturing in large quantities, and selling in large quantities could one dilute costs and achieve profitability.
But how long has it been since Yang Fan broke through to a god?
Although Yang Corporation was developing rapidly, it had just started after all.
Whether it was market channels or commercial reputation, they were far from sufficient to support profitability.
What’s more, a mere 100,000 war weapons couldn’t be considered scale at all for a true Mechanical industry.
In Lu Wan’s view, Yang Fan was currently a typical example of massive investment, but he still had a very long way to go before breaking even.
Therefore, she was worried that Yang Fan would stubbornly hold on to develop the Divine Kingdom alone for the sake of so-called face.
” Husband, I know you don’t want to rely on anyone. “
” But we are already husband and wife. “
” Mine is yours. “
Lu Wan said softly.
” These Divinity Points placed with me temporarily have no suitable equity investment and are just a number.
” But if it can help your Divine Kingdom develop, that is the maximization of value. “
” Back then, my mother gave you these Resources originally to give you a guarantee. “
” You really don’t need to stubbornly hold on for face. “
” When you need them, just take them and use them. “
Saying this, Lu Wan looked at Yang Fan, her eyes full of sincerity.
She was truly afraid that Yang Fan would stubbornly hold on despite lacking Resources just for the so-called dignity of a man.
Seeing Lu Wan’s serious gaze, Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then stood up.
” Wan’er, rest assured. “
” Your husband, I, am developing my Divine Kingdom very well right now. “
” If there is truly a need, I won’t stand on ceremony with you. “
” After all, we are husband and wife. “
Saying this, Yang Fan gently rubbed Lu Wan’s head.
” Be good, I’m going upstairs first. “
Afterwards, under Lu Wan’s puzzled gaze, Yang Fan actually walked upstairs somewhat like he was fleeing.
The room door closed.
Yang Fan leaned against the back of the door, his expression somewhat complex.
After a moment, he couldn’t help but let out a long sigh, ” I’m really not a human being... “
Clearly Lu Wan managed so many large enterprises in the Real World, and her business ability was even stronger than Gu Le’s.
Usually she looked extremely shrewd, completely like a decisive female president.
As a result, once she encountered emotional problems... how could she so easily believe him?
” Love is indeed a grave. “
Yang Fan shook his head.
” Fortunately, I am not a scumbag. “
” Otherwise, with wife Wan’er’s personality, she would probably be scammed miserably. “
Thinking of this, Yang Fan secretly decided in his heart that he must treat his wife even better in the future.
Being a person shouldn’t just be about wanting to take advantage.
As a man, after all, one must have some conscience.
Once he laughed at the infatuated guests of this world, only to lower his head for one person.
Treading across the starry river to seek the Dao, looking back he finally knew there was a home to return to.
The youth of the past was arrogant, conceited and unrestrained without questioning his heart.
Today he finally understood a thousand forms of goodness; a few companions surpass heaven and earth.
The Divine Kingdom can expand hundreds of millions of miles, and the starry sea can battle the armies of ten thousand clans.
Only with the beauty by his side, he shall not fail this life nor fail her.
Wishing for the rest of his life amidst wind and rain, to protect her laughing all the way until white hair.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and murmured, ” I want to be a good man. “
As for those little thoughts of the past...
Cough cough.
Let the past be the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 423: Annihilation Fighter 1.0
paragraphs: During this period of time, Yang Fan and several direct descendants and Geniuses of the Five Great Families could be considered to have truly established contact.
The matter of Secret Realm reclamation had been entirely handed over to the intelligent lifeform to handle, and Yang Fan’s life had returned to peace once again.
However, that Feixun group created by Han Jue was unusually lively every day.
The most active among them turned out to be Sima Tianci.

Yang Fan only discovered until now that this young master of the Sima Family, who usually looked lazy and wished he could lie down and sleep every day, was actually so talkative in the virtual network world.
Of course, the chatting content of these few people did not have too much nonsense.
From the future policy leaning direction of the Federation, to the internal stock trading of listed companies, and then to the reserve situation of various strategic materials on the frontline.
These pieces of information, which belonged to top secrets in the outside world, were taken out by them to discuss every day.
Any single piece of news placed in the outside world would be enough to cause huge ripples.
Yet in this group, it was as if it were just ordinary casual chatting.
“As expected of the direct descendants of the Five Great Families.”
Looking at the messages in the group, Yang Fan couldn’t help but shake his head and give a bitter smile.
If it were placed in the past, if he could master this information in advance, I am afraid his Divine Kingdom’s investment direction would change because of this.
Back when he was still at Yang County No. 1 Middle School, he had once obtained the news that the frontline lacked Blood Clotting Flower through the Luo Family.
Afterwards, he immediately adjusted the direction of the Divine Kingdom’s development, reclaimed a large area to plant Blood Clotting Flower, and earned a massive amount of Faith Points.
And what Han Jue and the others were discussing now were all Class A Spirit Plants.
Even many of those Resources were extremely likely to be in a state of long-term shortage in the next hundred years.
This was no longer a matter of personal investment.
Rather, it was strategic information sufficient to affect the development direction of a large company, and even change the industrial layout of a living planet.
It was just a pity that the current Yang Fan no longer needed to consider these things.
He didn’t even have the thought of telling Ma Yu this news.
Possessing the terrifying returns brought by the Evolution Talent, his Divine Kingdom nowadays didn’t need such trouble at all.
He only needed to continue purchasing S-grade resource-type buildings through the Dark Web to obtain a steady stream of income.
The current Yang Fan had long passed the stage where he needed to meticulously calculate to earn Resources.
Enhancing the believers’ strength and strengthening the Divine Kingdom War capabilities were the things he truly cared about.
Time flashed by, and half a month passed.
With half a month’s time in the Real World, under the action of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, the Divine Kingdom had once again experienced a full 1,500 years of time.
On this day, Yang Da’s excited voice suddenly sounded in Yang Fan’s mind.
“Master, the Mechanical Civilization has made a major breakthrough!”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly entered the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, his figure appeared above the Mechanical Civilization.
“This subordinate greets the Master!”
Yang Da respectfully bowed in salute.
Yang Fan did not speak, his gaze simply falling toward the distance.
There, at the edge area of the Mechanical Civilization, two brand-new huge production lines had officially started up.
I saw a large amount of special alloy materials being transported out of the huge warehouse by robots.
Afterwards, the intelligent lifeform began to carry out precise classification.
Different types of metal materials were put into different production areas according to strict data standards.
Accompanied by the roar of machinery, those incomparably hard alloys were continuously cut, smelted, and reorganized in the production equipment.
One by one, exquisite to the extreme Mechanical parts were rapidly manufactured by the assembly line.
Afterwards, these parts continuously moved forward along the conveyor tracks.
Ahead, a huge automated assembly platform was operating.
Countless Mechanical arms waved precisely, rapidly combining complex parts, circuits, and various miniature components according to the set program.
Every action did not have the slightest error.
After a short moment, a streamlined fighter jet was completely formed.
The next second, the intelligent lifeform took over the fighter jet.
Accompanied by the roaring sound of the engine, this brand-new weapon of war slowly ascended into the sky.
Afterwards, it transformed into a stream of light, flying directly toward the tarmac spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Looking at this scene, a trace of satisfaction flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Master, this is the latest war weapon developed by the Mechanical Civilization.”
“Annihilation Fighter 1.0 version.”
Yang Da began to introduce.
“This fighter jet can carry defensive buildings such as the City-Annihilating Cannon, and is simultaneously equipped with laser weapons as well as the latest radar detection System.”
“Its comprehensive destructive power is more than ten times that of the F3500 fighter jet purchased from the Divine Shop.”
“However, currently the power System and long-distance endurance capacity are still insufficient, and the R&D department is continuing to optimize them.”
Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
“Not bad.”
“In this way, in future Divine Kingdom Wars, we can be considered to have grasped air superiority.”
Afterwards, as if he thought of something, he spoke again.
“Yang Da, accelerate the R&D progress of the Mechanical Civilization.”
“Do not need to consider capital investment; the development direction of future war weapons must be more comprehensive.”
“Apart from land warfare and sky warfare, one must also consider oceans, deep seas, and even more special combat environments.”
“After all, the Divine Kingdom environments of those Foreign Deitys are bizarre and varied, so making preparations in advance is always without harm.”
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom nowadays already possessed sufficiently powerful military strength.
As long as he could deduce the coordinates of the Foreign Deitys, he would launch a Divine Kingdom War without the slightest hesitation.
Whether it was to expand the Divine Kingdom’s area or to obtain a more powerful Divine Kingdom Talent.
In the future, he was destined to experience countless wars.
Moreover, entering the Divine Kingdom of Foreign Deitys to fight was completely different from being in his own Divine Kingdom.
Aside from absolute strength, terrain, environment, defensive buildings, and even various special factors could all affect the outcome of the war.
Therefore, the more thorough the preliminary preparation, the greater the odds of victory when facing unknown enemies in the future.
“This subordinate understands.”
“How is the Dark Web auction proceeding?” Yang Fan changed the subject and asked.

“Reporting to the Master, according to your request, I combined the cost-performance ratio of various assets in the military merit system while considering issues such as the quantity of Dark Web auction items, and ultimately still chose the S-grade resource-type buildings of various races.”
Yang Da continued to reply.
“If only one kind of building is chosen, the quantity is overly massive, and doing so for a long time will inevitably attract the attention of the Han Family Military Prefecture.”
“Therefore, I have decided to purchase resource-type buildings of different races in batches, upload them in batches, and gradually digest them.”
“Currently, the main ones chosen include the Sea Monster Race, the Zerg Race, the Undead Race, the Beast Race, and so on.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly, “Which ones specifically?”

“The Sea Monster Race’s [Deep Sea Spirit Tide Breeding Pool], the Zerg Race’s [Myriad Insect Mother Nest Hatching Tower], the Undead Race’s [Cadavre Transformation Furnace], the Beast Race’s [Desolate Ancient bloodline Cultivation Ground].”
“However, the quantities are all controlled within a reasonable range.”
Yang Da continued to report.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: The Birth of a Martial Emperor
paragraphs: Since he already knew that the Han Family Military Prefecture traded with alien races through these submitted buildings, he naturally could not purchase a certain kind of building recklessly.
Otherwise, if the quantity was too exaggerated and caused these buildings to have sluggish sales, it would inevitably attract the attention of interested parties.
Through Dark Web auctions, the prices of these S-Rank resource-type buildings could often reach about ten times their market value.
Those auctioneers were naturally willing to take them out.
After all, for the vast majority of gods, it was simply impossible for them to possess an ability with a thousandfold return like Yang Fan.
If an S-Rank resource-type building were placed in their hands, it might take hundreds or even thousands of years to recoup the cost.
But selling it through the Dark Web allowed them to obtain a massive amount of Divinity Points all at once.
For them, this was naturally a cost-effective transaction.
As for Yang Fan handing over these buildings to the Han Family Military Prefecture, he would likewise only obtain very few military merits.
Whether it was the sellers in the Dark Web or the Han Family Military Prefecture, both could reap huge benefits from this transaction.
As for Yang Fan, he did not care about this either.
After all, Divinity Points were now merely a number to him.
In essence, he was simply purchasing those top-tier S-Rank Buildings in advance through a tenfold or even higher premium.
As long as it could enhance the strength of the Divine Kingdom, this bit of consumption was simply nothing worth mentioning.
This was a transaction where all parties profited.
The only thing that needed attention was the issue of scale.
It could not be done too exaggeratedly all at once, otherwise it would easily attract attention.
“Yang Corporation still needs to develop as soon as possible.”
“Otherwise, given the current output speed of the Divine Kingdom, the source of funds would be difficult to explain.”
Yang Fan thought to himself secretly.
Only when Yang Corporation was large enough would his capital flow have a reasonable explanation in the eyes of outsiders.
By then, even if the transaction scale was slightly larger,
the outside world would only think that Yang Fan was withdrawing funds from Yang Corporation for the development of his own Divine Kingdom.
After all, for a commercial group with massive industries to mobilize a large amount of funds was the most normal thing in the eyes of outsiders.
“How is the troop hoarding plan progressing?”
Yang Fan continued to ask.
“Reporting to Master, the population of each Secret Realm is now approaching one hundred billion.”
Yang Da respectfully reported.
“These populations will also constantly reproduce on their own, but currently, they mainly still rely on the main Divine Kingdom to continuously transport population.”
“Now, under the Divine Kingdom’s birth-encouragement policy, as long as there is enough living space, the growth rate of the number of believers is extremely fast.”
“In addition, according to Master’s request, we have established a complete promotion system.”

“Those believers who were migrated into the Secret Realm, if they can realize their own shortcomings, Cultivate diligently, and improve their contribution degree, once their assessment scores reach the standard, they can return to the main Divine Kingdom.”

“Now, not only the believers in the Secret Realm, but even the original believers of the main Divine Kingdom have greatly increased their enthusiasm for Cultivation due to the emergence of the competition mechanism.”
“The overall strength of the believers in the entire Divine Kingdom is rapidly improving.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction.
Looking at it now, the effects of the initial Divine Kingdom reform had gradually become apparent.
Although some minor problems appeared during the process, as long as the direction was correct, the overall development of the Divine Kingdom would not be affected.
“Especially those believers who Cultivate the martial Dao system.”
Yang Da continued to speak.
“Currently, among the major forces of the Divine Kingdom, the development speed of the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court is relatively slow.”
“After all, the martial Dao system mainly relies on nourishing the Physical Body, and its early-stage improvement speed is slower compared to the Cultivation Path.”
“Therefore, after the reform, the pressure suffered by these believers is instead the greatest.”
“Now, the average daily Cultivation time of the believers in the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court has increased by an hour compared to before.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded slightly.
Afterwards, his gaze looked towards the direction of the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court on the land of the Divine Kingdom.
However, the next moment, his expression suddenly changed.
“Eh?”
“This is... about to have a breakthrough?”
Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.
He also did not expect that his entry into the Divine Kingdom this time was originally just to check the newly developed war weapons of the Mechanical Civilization.
He did not expect to happen to encounter someone having a breakthrough in the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court.
And it was even a breakthrough to the Martial Emperor Realm!
This was an existence equivalent to the Nascent Soul Realm of the Cultivation Path.
The time of the Divine Kingdom passed rapidly.
Although Yang Fan’s Avatar of consciousness only stayed here for a moment, under the terrifying time flow rate of the Divine Kingdom, a month or two passed in the blink of an eye.
At this moment, the central area of the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court.
Boom!
A terrifying power of blood and Qi suddenly soared into the sky.
In an instant, the entire land began to vibrate violently.
Countless believers who Cultivate the martial Dao successively stopped their actions and looked up at the sky.
“This is...”
“The Great General is about to have a breakthrough?”
“The Martial Emperor Realm!”
“Is our Myriad Phenomena Martial Court finally going to give birth to a Martial Emperor powerhouse?”
At this moment, the eyes of all martial Dao believers revealed an expression of excitement.
The birth of a Martial Emperor powerhouse not only represented the appearance of top combat strength.
It even meant that the entire martial Dao system would usher in a new transformation.
Because within the Divine Kingdom, the perfection of the rules of any Cultivation path required a powerhouse to serve as a breakthrough point.
As long as the first powerhouse successfully broke through the Realm, the subsequent Cultivation path would gradually mature.
Just like the former immortal Cultivation system.
After the first Nascent Soul powerhouse was born, subsequent Nascent Soul Realms would appear like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.
Now that the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court has given birth to a Martial Emperor, for all believers Cultivating the martial Dao, it is a huge opportunity.
Boom!
The next moment.
Beneath the Monument of Myriad Manifestations at the very center of the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court.
A massive figure slowly appeared.
That was a golden giant standing dozens of meters tall.
With his appearance, the Spiritual Qi between heaven and earth began to surge frantically.
Countless blood-red auras surrounded his body, resembling a sea of blood.
The terrifying power of blood and Qi made all believers in the entire Myriad Phenomena Martial Court feel a pressure originating from the level of life.
Above the sky, Yang Fan’s Avatar of consciousness quietly watched this scene.
After a moment, he slowly nodded.
“The breakthrough is successful, very good.”
“Is this golden body the Undying Body?”
There was a trace of surprise in his eyes.
Although the martial Dao system had a slower Cultivation speed in the early stage, once it broke through to high tiers, the improvement of Physical Body strength was extremely terrifying.
“Perhaps it is because the martial Dao system itself relies more heavily on accumulation than the Cultivation system.”
“Or perhaps within the Divine Kingdom, the number of top-tier S-Rank Buildings like the War God Codex is still not enough.”
“That is why the development speed of the Myriad Phenomena Martial Court has always lagged behind so much.”
Yang Fan thought to himself secretly.
However, now that the first Martial Emperor powerhouse was born, the subsequent development speed would inevitably become faster and faster.
Receiving two pieces of good news in succession.
Yang Fan nodded in satisfaction, and then his consciousness withdrew from the Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Using a borrowed knife to kill
paragraphs: Real World.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
He gently exhaled a breath of stale air.
The next moment, he stretched his body.
Boom!
A terrifying power instantly circulated within his body.
At this moment, Yang Fan only felt as if his Physical Body possessed endless power.
He even had an illusion that as long as he gently threw a punch, it would be enough to shatter the space before him.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and his powerful Mental Strength instantly operated.
Soon, he regained control over this suddenly surged power.
Now his mental Realm had long far surpassed an ordinary First-Order God.
A mere power enhancement was not enough to make him lose control.
“This feeling of not needing to do anything and rapidly growing stronger just by idling... feels so good.”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
Compared to the Hundredfold Time Sequence Talent misunderstood by everyone, the Evolution Talent was far more terrifying.
Although Hundredfold Time Dilation could accelerate believers’ cultivation, it required consuming a large amount of Divine Kingdom Spiritual Qi.
However, his Evolution Talent had almost no consumption.
Unless the Divine Kingdom encountered an invasion, Yang Fan had almost never turned off the Evolution state over the years.
His Divine Kingdom had always maintained a hundredfold growth rate.
Furthermore, nowadays, within his Divine Kingdom, he already possessed hundreds of thousands of S-rank resource-type buildings.
Whether it was the Spiritual Qi concentration or the cultivation environment, they far exceeded ordinary gods.
Under such a huge gap,
although Yang Fan was still only a First-Order God right now,
but speaking of true strength, it probably far exceeded the vast majority of Tier 3 Gods.
“Calm down, a person should not be pleased by external gains or saddened by personal losses, and maintain an ordinary state of mind!
I am still not invincible, and I still need to learn to keep a low profile.”
Yang Fan silently reminded himself in his heart.
Although the development speed of his Divine Kingdom nowadays far exceeded ordinary gods, he knew very well that he still had a very long way to go before true invincibility.
The Universe is vast, with countless experts.
The more it was like this, the more he could not lose his head just because of a slight increase in strength.
Right at this moment, a Feixun private message suddenly popped up.
Yang Fan looked down, and when he saw the person sending the message, he couldn’t help raising his eyebrows.
“Sima Tianci?”
“Why isn’t he properly chatting in the group chat, and instead sending me a private message?”
With a hint of doubt, Yang Fan opened Feixun.
The next moment, a Virtual World coordinate appeared before him.
Yang Fan glanced at the coordinates, and without hesitation, directly put on the helmet.
His consciousness instantly entered the Virtual World.
After a brief spatial transformation, Yang Fan’s figure appeared outside a luxurious villa in the frontline area of the Virtual World.
This was precisely the place where Sima Tianci usually lived.
Pushing open the room door, Yang Fan soon saw Sima Tianci, who was leisurely drinking tea.
“Brother Sima, is there something you need me for?”
Yang Fan cut straight to the point.
“However, let’s make it clear in advance, don’t look for me for that Virtual World fishing game.”
“I still have a lot of serious matters to do.”

As the dignified young master of the Sima Family and one of the Clan head candidates, Yang Fan never expected that this seemingly extremely lazy young master was actually a veteran fishing enthusiast.
And he was even a heavy player of a certain large-scale fishing game in the Virtual World.
Last time Sima Tianci dragged him along to experience it, Yang Fan felt that he almost fell asleep sitting right there.
He truly could not understand.
With a personality like Sima Tianci’s, how on earth did he break through to become a god during his junior year?
Could it be that the SS-rank Talent “Dao Child” was truly so outrageous?
The more he lay flat, the stronger he became instead?
“You vulgar person, you don’t understand the joy of fishing. What a pity.”
Sima Tianci shook his head, looking heartbroken.
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
“I have a wife.”
“I heard that those who like fishing are either single individuals, or gods who have spent thousands of years with their partners and whose feelings have entered a plain period.”
“In comparison, I still prefer another kind of’sports’.”
After finishing, Yang Fan even wore an expression of taking it for granted.
Sima Tianci’s expression instantly stiffened, turning green and red.
After quite a while, he took a deep breath. “Brother Yang, you really don’t know how to chat.”
“Cut the crap, let’s talk about serious business.” Yang Fan rolled his eyes.
“Ahem.”
Sima Tianci gave a light cough and no longer joked around.
“Actually, it’s not a big deal.”
“It’s just that there was some unpleasantness between you two before.”
“However, you are my brother. Since I found out about it, naturally I have to tell you.”
As he spoke, an electronic tablet appeared in Sima Tianci’s hand, which he handed to Yang Fan.
Yang Fan took the electronic tablet, his fingers gently swiping across it.
The next moment, his expression gradually turned icy.
The contents on the electronic tablet were all investigative materials regarding him.
And they were not ordinary information in the Real World.
Instead, they were information about his Divine Kingdom!
It even included information on his parents, and the identity information of his two wives, Luo Rou and Luo Bing.
There was also his former Subordinate God Zhang Pang, and his current Subordinate God Li Tianheng.
Even the related records of him recruiting Subordinate Gods on a large scale at the frontline were investigated clearly.
Such detailed information was something an ordinary investigation could not accomplish.
Sima Tianci looked at Yang Fan’s expression and slowly explained:
“This Ma Huainan has recently attached himself to my sister, and his status in the Sima Family is not low.”
“He used the authority of the Sima Family to forcibly bypass some restrictions of the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.”
“As for what exactly he wants to do, it’s not convenient for me to guess rashly.”
Yang Fan raised his head, his voice gradually turning cold.
“I am a Peerless Prodigy evaluated by the Human Federation.”
“His behavior like this has already seriously violated the law, right?”
He looked at the materials in his hand, his gaze becoming increasingly icy.
Ma Huainan investigating these things was definitely not out of sheer curiosity.
Instead, he wanted to use this information to deduce his Divine Kingdom coordinates.
Yang Fan couldn’t help sneering inwardly.
His Divine Kingdom coordinates were protected extremely well; anyone who entered his Divine Kingdom was already dead.
Based solely on this information, even with many more divine kingdom deduction cards, it would be impossible to easily find it.
But a person like Ma Huainan was like a venomous snake hidden in the dark.
Even if he couldn’t succeed temporarily, he had to be guarded against at all times.
Thinking of the deeply hidden malice when the other party looked at him on the day of the gathering.
A hint of killing intent gradually emerged in the depths of Yang Fan’s eyes.
“More than just violating the law?”
“It’s simply a crime!”
Sima Tianci’s expression was serious as he said in a deep voice:
“If Brother Yang takes these pieces of evidence and directly reports them to the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence, this Ma Huainan will definitely receive severe punishment.”
Looking at Sima Tianci’s serious appearance, Yang Fan suddenly burst out laughing.
“Brother Sima, fine methods.”
“Borrowing a knife to kill, well played.”
Hearing this, Sima Tianci froze for a second, then waved his hand somewhat awkwardly.
“Making Brother Yang laugh at me.”
“There are factional struggles within big families, let alone the Sima Family, one of the Five Great Families.”
At this point, continuing to put on an act would instead appear insufficiently frank.
Sima Tianci simply laid his cards on the table directly.
After all, someone who treats others as fools is often the biggest fool themselves.

Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes.
He gently exhaled a breath of stale air.
The next moment, he stretched his body.
Boom!
A terrifying power instantly circulated within his body.
At this moment, Yang Fan only felt as if his Physical Body possessed endless power.
He even had an illusion that as long as he gently threw a punch, it would be enough to shatter the space before him.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and his powerful Mental Strength instantly operated.
Soon, he regained control over this suddenly surged power.
Now his mental Realm had long far surpassed an ordinary First-Order God.
A mere power enhancement was not enough to make him lose control.
“This feeling of not needing to do anything and rapidly growing stronger just by idling... feels so good.”
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth curved up slightly.
Compared to the Hundredfold Time Sequence Talent misunderstood by everyone, the Evolution Talent was far more terrifying.
Although Hundredfold Time Dilation could accelerate believers’ cultivation, it required consuming a large amount of Divine Kingdom Spiritual Qi.
However, his Evolution Talent had almost no consumption.
Unless the Divine Kingdom encountered an invasion, Yang Fan had almost never turned off the Evolution state over the years.
His Divine Kingdom had always maintained a hundredfold growth rate.
Furthermore, nowadays, within his Divine Kingdom, he already possessed hundreds of thousands of S-rank resource-type buildings.
Whether it was the Spiritual Qi concentration or the cultivation environment, they far exceeded ordinary gods.
Under such a huge gap,
although Yang Fan was still only a First-Order God right now,
but speaking of true strength, it probably far exceeded the vast majority of Tier 3 Gods.
“Calm down, a person should not be pleased by external gains or saddened by personal losses, and maintain an ordinary state of mind!
I am still not invincible, and I still need to learn to keep a low profile.”
Yang Fan silently reminded himself in his heart.
Although the development speed of his Divine Kingdom nowadays far exceeded ordinary gods, he knew very well that he still had a very long way to go before true invincibility.
The Universe is vast, with countless experts.
The more it was like this, the more he could not lose his head just because of a slight increase in strength.

Yang Fan looked down, and when he saw the person sending the message, he couldn’t help raising his eyebrows.
“Sima Tianci?”
“Why isn’t he properly chatting in the group chat, and instead sending me a private message?”
With a hint of doubt, Yang Fan opened Feixun.
The next moment, a Virtual World coordinate appeared before him.
Yang Fan glanced at the coordinates, and without hesitation, directly put on the helmet.
His consciousness instantly entered the Virtual World.
After a brief spatial transformation, Yang Fan’s figure appeared outside a luxurious villa in the frontline area of the Virtual World.
This was precisely the place where Sima Tianci usually lived.

“Brother Sima, is there something you need me for?”
Yang Fan cut straight to the point.
“However, let’s make it clear in advance, don’t look for me for that Virtual World fishing game.”
“I still have a lot of serious matters to do.”

What a pity.”
Sima Tianci shook his head, looking heartbroken.

“In comparison, I still prefer another kind of’sports’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 426: Discussion
paragraphs: Sima Tianci’s move indeed had the intention of using Yang Fan’s hand to suppress Ma Huainan.
But at the same time, this was also a knife handed over by Ma Huainan himself.
Investigating the Divine Kingdom information of other gods is inherently an extremely dangerous matter.
Especially since Yang Fan’s identity is special nowadays, being a Peerless Prodigy recognized by the Federation.
Once this kind of behavior is exposed, the conflict between the two sides will no longer be a simple contradiction, but a true endless enmity.
Therefore, even though Sima Tianci has the thought of using Yang Fan, from the result, this matter is definitely a good thing for Yang Fan.
At the very least, it allowed him to discover the danger hidden in the dark in advance.
Otherwise, when one day his Divine Kingdom coordinates are truly deduced and he suffers an invasion, wanting to resolve it then will probably be too late.
“Brother Yang, Sima Yurao’s mother comes from the Qin Family, and she is a Tier 6 god.”
Sima Tianci said slowly.
“I have completely cleaned up the sources of the information in your hands, and no clues will be left behind.”
“You can choose to take these things to show your cards to Ma Huainan in exchange for benefits.”
“You can also directly report to the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence to make him receive the punishment he deserves and get justice.”
“Of course, no matter how this matter develops afterwards, I will no longer intervene.”
Sima Tianci looked at Yang Fan, his tone very calm.
He had already handed all the right of choice into Yang Fan’s hands.
Hearing this, Yang Fan fell into silence.
A moment later, a smile reappeared on his face.
“Many thanks to Brother Sima for telling me these.”
“I, Yang Fan, have remembered this kindness.”
“In the future, if Brother Sima has any requests, as long as it is within my capability, I will definitely help.”
Hearing these words, the casual look on Sima Tianci’s face gradually faded, replaced by a trace of seriousness.
He cupped his fists at Yang Fan, “Easily said.”
Consciousness exited the Virtual World.
Yang Fan returned to the Real World.
At this moment, he sat on a chair, his gaze looking out the window, his eyes carrying a bit of deep thought.
“In this world, there is only going a thousand miles to kill bandits; where is the logic of defending against bandits for a thousand days?”
Yang Fan muttered to himself in a low voice.
Plans emerged rapidly in his mind, one after another.
“Only, how should I acquire Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom coordinates?”
“Or... directly destroy his body in the Real World?”
Yang Fan’s eyes grew slightly cold.
With his current strength, even an ordinary Tier 3 God might not be his match.
And Ma Huainan had just achieved a breakthrough as a god not long ago.
If he really found an opportunity to launch a sneak attack, with Yang Fan’s current combat power, resolving the opponent would not be difficult.
But very quickly, Yang Fan frowned again.
Things were not that simple.
Ma Huainan was also a recent graduate nowadays, and his Divine Kingdom was currently in a stage of rapid development.
In a short period of time, the other party had a high probability of not leaving the frontline safety zone.
Moreover, in the current Human Federation, intelligent lifeform and high-tech monitoring equipment were everywhere.
It was difficult for struggles between gods to be done without leaving a trace.
What’s more, given Ma Huainan’s identity, it would inevitably attract a major investigation afterwards.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan’s eyes gradually turned cold.
“Since you like playing dirty...”
“Then I’d like to see whether your background is bigger, or my background is bigger!”
The next moment, Yang Fan turned his head to look at the intelligent robot in the room.
“Go, call the missus over.”
“Master, the mistress is currently holding a shareholder meeting,” the intelligent robot replied respectfully.
“Interrupt her and have her come over immediately.”
“Yes, Master.”
The intelligent robot bowed in salute and then left the room.
Not long after, the door was abruptly pushed open.
Lu Wan walked in hurriedly.
“Husband, what happened?”
She looked at Yang Fan, a trace of worry in her eyes.
In the past when the two lived together, Yang Fan knew she was busy with affairs and rarely disturbed her during the day.
Now, suddenly having the intelligent robot interrupt the shareholder meeting and call her back directly.
Lu Wan knew very well that something major must have happened.
“I have important matters that need to be discussed with you and Gu Le together.”
Yang Fan’s expression was serious.
“Enter the Virtual World, the coordinates have already been sent to you.”
Lu Wan was slightly stunned.
She and Gu Le had known each other since childhood, but their relationship was not quite harmonious.
Although they both became Yang Fan’s wives now, there was also a default subtle relationship between each other.
After so long in the past, the two hadn’t even officially met yet.
But looking at Yang Fan’s serious expression at this moment, Lu Wan did not ask much.
She nodded, “I’ll go over immediately.”
A moment later, Yang Fan and Lu Wan followed the coordinates into the Virtual World.
Space transformed, and the two people’s consciousness arrived at a pure white room.
At this moment, Gu Le was already waiting here in advance.
“Husband, what on earth happened?”
Gu Le asked doubtfully.
Yang Fan glanced at the surrounding environment, his expression a bit hesitant.
Gu Le seemed to understand Yang Fan’s concerns and explained.
“Husband, rest assured, this is the private space of our Gu Family in the Virtual World.”
“Even the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence cannot pry into it.”
As the top forces of the Human race, the Five Great Families naturally could not be completely clean.
And the Virtual World was essentially a massive computing space composed of countless computing powers.
It could highly replicate the Real World, allowing human consciousness to cross space and freely communicate within it.
But since it was a computing world, intelligent lifeform naturally monitored it easily.
Of course, for ordinary people’s daily communications, the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence wouldn’t pay attention at all.
However, for existences of the level of the Five Great Families, some important matters naturally required absolute privacy.
This kind of private space of the Gu Family was actually equivalent to a special firewall.
When various families discussed some important matters, they would all choose to conduct them in this kind of place.
After confirming safety, Yang Fan hesitated no longer.
He copied the information given to him by Sima Tianci into two copies and handed them to Lu Wan and Gu Le.
The two took the information and began to check it carefully.
As the reading deepened, the expressions of the two gradually turned cold.
“Ma Huainan?”
“Is that the person who lost the War God Codex to Husband back then?”
Gu Le’s eyes were cold.
“He actually mobilized so many connections for an S-Rank Building?”
Lu Wan on the side also had a solemn expression.
Secretly investigating the Divine Kingdom information of other gods was a major taboo among all gods.
This was preparing for future revenge!
“Husband, where is the source of this information?” Lu Wan raised her head and asked.
“Sima Tianci.”
Hearing this, Lu Wan instantly understood.
“That explains it then.”
“Sima Tianci’s mother comes from the Gu Family,”
“And Sima Yurao also has an older brother, who is likewise a candidate for the Sima Family head.”
“However, his mother comes from the Qin Family.”
“Between the two sides, there inherently existed a huge interest competition.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“That’s right, Brother Tianci did not conceal it either; he indeed had the thought of utilizing me.”
“However, this news is true.”
Speaking of this, Yang Fan’s gaze swept across the two people.
“Regarding Ma Huainan, this poisonous snake hidden in the dark, what do you two think?”
