chapters.title: Chapter 427: A Gentleman Does Not Stand Under a Dangerous Wall
paragraphs: Both of his two wives were direct descendants of the Five Great Families.
Standing behind them were some of the absolute top existences in the entire Human Federation.
For a major matter involving the Five Great Families, federal rules, and the safety of the divine kingdom, Yang Fan felt it best not to make a judgment alone.
Otherwise, once handled incorrectly, it would likely bring unnecessary and massive trouble to himself.
Since he had such networking Resources, Yang Fan naturally would make good use of them.
“Since we have already offended him, he cannot be kept. We must find a way to deal with him.”
“His identity is indeed a bit troublesome, but when all is said and done, he is currently just a First-Order God. As long as we don’t leave any leverage, killing him is just killing him.”
The two women stated their thoughts almost simultaneously.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help feeling somewhat surprised in his heart.
He also harbored killing intent toward Ma Huainan.
He had originally thought that his two wives would first help him analyze the situation, or use the power of their backing families to pressure the other party.
He didn’t expect that their choices would be so simple and direct.
Yang Fan couldn’t help letting out a soft cough.
“Ahem.”
“This person currently lives in a villa belonging to the Sima Family on the frontline. I’m afraid he won’t leave for a short time, and making a move won’t be easy.”
Yang Fan frowned and said.
If Ma Huainan headed to the combat zone of the frontline, or if he left the frontline and went to a certain life planet alone.
Then Yang Fan wouldn’t mind making a trip personally to completely resolve this trouble.
But right now, the other party kept staying in a safe area, which was indeed somewhat tricky.
“Husband, the only troublesome part of this matter is the divine kingdom coordinates.”
Lu Wan sneered.
“Making a move in the Real World will leave traces no matter what.”
“Since he likes to investigate others in this way, we can also use his own method against him.”
“That’s right.”
Gu Le’s gaze was icy.
“Doesn’t he like to investigate?”
“Then we will investigate him too.”
“His Clan members, former classmates, controlled Subordinate God, and all his experiences over the years can all become breakthrough points.”
“He can use the channels of the Sima Family to bypass the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence to investigate Husband, so I can equally utilize the connections of the Gu Family.”
Gu Le’s tone was calm, but her gaze carried a trace of chillness.
“And my Lu Clan.”
Lu Wan continued.
“Even without mobilizing the relations on my mother’s side, solely relying on the investigative company I’ve controlled over these years is enough to find out a lot of things.”
“At that time, we will aggregate all the information and then use a large number of divine kingdom deduction cards.”
“If 1,000 cards don’t work, then 10,000.”
“If 10,000 cards don’t work, then 100,000 or 1 million.”
“As long as sufficient Resources are invested, there will always be a time when the deduction succeeds.”
Hearing this, a trace of a smile finally appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
As long as they could find Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom coordinates.
With his current strength, solving the other party was not a difficult task at all.
Thinking of the other party’s SS-rank Martial God Body Talent, Yang Fan even felt a faint sense of anticipation in his heart.
This was an important opportunity that could elevate his Divine Kingdom Talent once again.
“Husband, you don’t need to worry.”
“He won’t be jumping around for much longer.”
Lu Wan’s tone was firm.
“Once this person’s divine kingdom coordinates are deduced, I will arrange for people to make a move.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was stunned for a moment, “Arrange for others?”
“Of course.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“After all, Ma Huainan is a Peerless Prodigy rated by the Human Federation.”
“Even if we are in the right, directly making a move will still involve serious illegal acts.”
“But Husband can rest assured.”
“As for the company responsible for investigating his divine kingdom coordinates, I will prepare legal risk isolation in advance.”
“Even if it is eventually investigated, it won’t implicate us. By then, whoever should take the blame will take the blame, and whoever should go bankrupt will go bankrupt.”
“As for the people who actually make a move...”
A flash of sharp light crossed Lu Wan’s eyes.
“I happen to have a few suitable candidates on hand.”
“At that time, I will arrange the best lawyers for them and also give them sufficient remuneration.”
“They will voluntarily bear all responsibility.”
“I can guarantee that on the surface, neither the Federal Government nor the Sima Family will be able to pick out any problems.”
“As long as the person is dead, the people behind him won’t choose to tear their faces apart for a dead person.”
Speaking of this, a strong confidence surfaced on Lu Wan’s face.
She knew very well that many things in this world essentially revolved around a single word—Profit.
As long as the interests were large enough.
Even gods would have people willing to help others go to prison and take the blame.
After hearing Lu Wan’s idea, Yang Fan instantly widened his eyes, looking like he had discovered a new continent.
Can it even be played like this?

In Yang Fan’s original plan, it was to find a way to obtain Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom coordinates, and then directly mobilize the divine kingdom army to completely annihilate him and eliminate future troubles.
As a result, his own wife’s train of thought was obviously much higher than his by I don’t know how many levels.
Investigation, deduction, sending people to make a move, risk isolation, lawyer team, arranging scapegoats...
After a whole set of procedures, connections, Resources, and rules were utilized to the fullest.
Is this the real way big families play?
Always standing behind the scenes, needing only a single sentence, and someone would solve all troubles for oneself.
This is the true big boss!
Yang Fan gave a light cough and said, “Um... Ma Huainan’s strength is not strong. Once his divine kingdom coordinates are deduced, just hand it over to me.”
Borrowing the hands of others could indeed resolve a venomous snake hidden in the dark.
But the problem was... he still wanted to eat snake meat.
Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core was an important resource for the current Yang Fan.
However, just as his voice fell.
“No.”
“No.”
Gu Le and Lu Wan spoke almost simultaneously.
Yang Fan was stunned, and asked doubtfully, “Why?”
Gu Le said with a serious expression and slowly:
“Husband, you are now a person of the Five Great Families. You must understand a most basic principle.”
“A gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall.”
“A truly powerful person is not someone who does everything personally, but someone who knows how to recognize talent, understand people, and employ them.”

“After breaking through to become a god, Lifespan is nearly endless. If every Divine Kingdom War requires you to personally make a move, no matter how strong your strength is, there will always be times when accidents happen.”
“You can’t walk by the river without getting your shoes wet.”
Gu Le’s tone was solemn.
Lu Wan also continued:
“Besides that, Husband, you also have to consider another possibility.”
“Your divine kingdom combat power is indeed powerful, but if you drive Ma Huainan to a desperate situation, he will definitely make his divine kingdom coordinates public to the Sima Family.”
“By then, what you face will no longer be just a Ma Huainan, but the many Low-rank Deitys behind the Sima Family, or even dozens of gods joining forces!”
“Don’t forget, Ma Huainan possesses an SS-rank Talent, and now he has gotten together with Sima Yurao. His value to the Sima Family is not low.”
“Even if we want to solve him, we must make foolproof preparations in advance.”
Lu Wan’s expression was grave.
“Moreover, Husband, you just graduated from the Primordial Academy.”

“From high school until university graduation, all the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battles and Primordial Battlefield you have experienced, including your combat style and ability information, are recorded by the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.”
“If you personally dispatch believers to make a move, once Ma Huainan transmits the combat information out, it will inevitably trigger a federal investigation.”
“Professional matters should be left to professional people to do.”
Lu Wan looked at Yang Fan and said earnestly:
“Within our Human race, there naturally exist a batch of law-breaking and criminal gods.”
“As long as the price is sufficient, they are willing to handle some shady matters for others and bear the corresponding crimes.”
“There is fundamentally no need for us to personally step into the arena.”
“Husband, Divinity Points are earned precisely to be used.”
“There is no need to save in this kind of place.”

Standing behind them were some of the absolute top existences in the entire Human Federation.
For a major matter involving the Five Great Families, federal rules, and the safety of the divine kingdom, Yang Fan felt it best not to make a judgment alone.
Otherwise, once handled incorrectly, it would likely bring unnecessary and massive trouble to himself.
Since he had such networking Resources, Yang Fan naturally would make good use of them.
“Since we have already offended him, he cannot be kept.
We must find a way to deal with him.”
“His identity is indeed a bit troublesome, but when all is said and done, he is currently just a First-Order God.
As long as we don’t leave any leverage, killing him is just killing him.”
The two women stated their thoughts almost simultaneously.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help feeling somewhat surprised in his heart.
He also harbored killing intent toward Ma Huainan.
He had originally thought that his two wives would first help him analyze the situation, or use the power of their backing families to pressure the other party.
He didn’t expect that their choices would be so simple and direct.
Yang Fan couldn’t help letting out a soft cough.
“Ahem.”
“This person currently lives in a villa belonging to the Sima Family on the frontline.
I’m afraid he won’t leave for a short time, and making a move won’t be easy.”
Yang Fan frowned and said.
If Ma Huainan headed to the combat zone of the frontline, or if he left the frontline and went to a certain life planet alone.
Then Yang Fan wouldn’t mind making a trip personally to completely resolve this trouble.
But right now, the other party kept staying in a safe area, which was indeed somewhat tricky.
“Husband, the only troublesome part of this matter is the divine kingdom coordinates.”
Lu Wan sneered.
“Making a move in the Real World will leave traces no matter what.”
“Since he likes to investigate others in this way, we can also use his own method against him.”
“That’s right.”
Gu Le’s gaze was icy.
“Doesn’t he like to investigate?”
“Then we will investigate him too.”
“His Clan members, former classmates, controlled Subordinate God, and all his experiences over the years can all become breakthrough points.”
“He can use the channels of the Sima Family to bypass the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence to investigate Husband, so I can equally utilize the connections of the Gu Family.”
Gu Le’s tone was calm, but her gaze carried a trace of chillness.
“And my Lu Clan.”
Lu Wan continued.
“Even without mobilizing the relations on my mother’s side, solely relying on the investigative company I’ve controlled over these years is enough to find out a lot of things.”
“At that time, we will aggregate all the information and then use a large number of divine kingdom deduction cards.”
“If 1,000 cards don’t work, then 10,000.”
“If 10,000 cards don’t work, then 100,000 or 1 million.”
“As long as sufficient Resources are invested, there will always be a time when the deduction succeeds.”
Hearing this, a trace of a smile finally appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
As long as they could find Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom coordinates.
With his current strength, solving the other party was not a difficult task at all.
Thinking of the other party’s SS-rank Martial God Body Talent, Yang Fan even felt a faint sense of anticipation in his heart.
This was an important opportunity that could elevate his Divine Kingdom Talent once again.
“Husband, you don’t need to worry.”
“He won’t be jumping around for much longer.”
Lu Wan’s tone was firm.
“Once this person’s divine kingdom coordinates are deduced, I will arrange for people to make a move.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was stunned for a moment, “Arrange for others?”
“Of course.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“After all, Ma Huainan is a Peerless Prodigy rated by the Human Federation.”
“Even if we are in the right, directly making a move will still involve serious illegal acts.”
“But Husband can rest assured.”
“As for the company responsible for investigating his divine kingdom coordinates, I will prepare legal risk isolation in advance.”
“Even if it is eventually investigated, it won’t implicate us.
By then, whoever should take the blame will take the blame, and whoever should go bankrupt will go bankrupt.”
“As for the people who actually make a move...”
A flash of sharp light crossed Lu Wan’s eyes.
“I happen to have a few suitable candidates on hand.”
“At that time, I will arrange the best lawyers for them and also give them sufficient remuneration.”
“They will voluntarily bear all responsibility.”
“I can guarantee that on the surface, neither the Federal Government nor the Sima Family will be able to pick out any problems.”
“As long as the person is dead, the people behind him won’t choose to tear their faces apart for a dead person.”
Speaking of this, a strong confidence surfaced on Lu Wan’s face.
She knew very well that many things in this world essentially revolved around a single word—Profit.
As long as the interests were large enough.
Even gods would have people willing to help others go to prison and take the blame.
After hearing Lu Wan’s idea, Yang Fan instantly widened his eyes, looking like he had discovered a new continent.
Can it even be played like this?

In Yang Fan’s original plan, it was to find a way to obtain Ma Huainan’s divine kingdom coordinates, and then directly mobilize the divine kingdom army to completely annihilate him and eliminate future troubles.
As a result, his own wife’s train of thought was obviously much higher than his by I don’t know how many levels.
Investigation, deduction, sending people to make a move, risk isolation, lawyer team, arranging scapegoats...
After a whole set of procedures, connections, Resources, and rules were utilized to the fullest.
Is this the real way big families play?
Always standing behind the scenes, needing only a single sentence, and someone would solve all troubles for oneself.
This is the true big boss!
Yang Fan gave a light cough and said, “Um...
Ma Huainan’s strength is not strong.
Once his divine kingdom coordinates are deduced, just hand it over to me.”
Borrowing the hands of others could indeed resolve a venomous snake hidden in the dark.
But the problem was... he still wanted to eat snake meat.
Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core was an important resource for the current Yang Fan.

“No.”

“As long as the price is sufficient, they are willing to handle some shady matters for others and bear the corresponding crimes.”
“There is fundamentally no need for us to personally step into the arena.”
“Husband, Divinity Points are earned precisely to be used.”
“There is no need to save in this kind of place.”

chapters.title: Chapter 428: Surprise
paragraphs: At this point, Lu Wan looked at Yang Fan, a trace of strangeness even within her gaze.
She had always felt that her husband spent money like water, completely unaware of how to save.
Yet she never expected... that at a time like this, he was actually thinking of taking action personally.
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched.
Did he care about those few Divinity Points?
He cared about Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core!
However, after listening to the explanation of the two, Yang Fan had to admit that he seemed to have thought things too simply.
“If he makes his Divine Kingdom coordinates public, wouldn’t he be directly facing the entire Sima Family?” Yang Fan asked with a frown.
He was very confident in his own strength.
But he was not arrogant enough to think that his current self could frontally contend against a behemoth like the Sima Family that had existed for who knows how many epochs.
Hearing this, Gu Le couldn’t help laughing out loud.
“Husband, if it were really like what you thought, wouldn’t a slight conflict between the younger generation lead to a full-scale war between the two great families?”
“Then the Five Great Families would have long ceased to exist.”
She shook her head.

“The Five Great Families have passed down their Inheritance for who knows how many epochs, and the number of deities they possess is countless. The relationships among them have long since become complex to the extreme.”
“But no matter how complex the relationships are, the most core rule of this world will forever be just two words—interests.”
“When your Divine Kingdom encounters danger, as long as you are willing to pay a sufficient price and make the Divine Kingdom coordinates public, naturally there will be deities willing to help you.”

“Even with an identity like Sima Yurao’s, if her Divine Kingdom encounters a crisis, relying solely on her identity as the daughter of the Sima Family head would not allow her to mobilize other deities at will.”
“She likewise needs to pay a price: Divinity Points, high-tier buildings, company shares in the Real World... These are the things that can truly move other deities.”
Gu Le looked at Lu Wan and smiled:
“The reason why Cousin is so confident is not because we are stronger than the Sima Family.”
“Rather, it is because we are wealthier than Sima Yurao and Ma Huainan.”
“Divine Kingdom War, when all is said and done, is fought over Resources.”
“Most of the time, if you want others to help you, you also need to bring out sufficient Resources.”
She paused for a moment, her voice becoming even calmer.
“What of parents? What of brothers and sisters?”
“Even between husband and wife, in front of the core interests of the Divine Kingdom, concessions must be made.”
At this moment, Gu Le stared intently into Yang Fan’s eyes, her gaze wise and calm.
“Ma Huainan does not have any Foundation.”
“Solely discussing the fluid Resources on hand, let alone comparing Sima Yurao to Cousin Lu Wan—”
“Even compared to me, she might not match up.”
“Therefore, Husband, you don’t need to worry at all.”
At this moment, Lu Wan walked to Yang Fan’s side, gently holding his hand, and softly comforted him:
“Husband, leave this matter to me and Cousin Gu Le.”
“Very soon, I will be able to deduce this person’s Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
Looking at Lu Wan’s serious expression, Yang Fan ultimately nodded.
“After investigating all of Ma Huainan’s information clearly, send me a copy.”
“Alright.” Lu Wan gave a soft response.
Afterward, she looped her arm through Yang Fan’s, looked at Gu Le on the side, and a trace of a smile suddenly appeared on her face.
“Cousin, after graduation, you must hurry over to the frontline.”
“Husband is too formidable; I alone am somewhat unable to hold my ground.”
“I’ll be waiting for you, oh.”
Hearing these words, Gu Le instantly rolled her eyes.
“Tch, Cousin, what time is it right now, and you still have the mood to joke.”
“Rest assured, I’ll find a way to make some trouble for them when I go back later.”
“You hurry up with the investigation.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“I have already arranged for intelligent lifeform to start investigating.”
“Ma Huainan is merely from an ordinary life planet. Before joining the Sima Family, his identity information is not difficult to check.”
“At most a few days’ time, there will be a result.”
After the discussion of the matter concluded, the consciousness of Yang Fan and Lu Wan exited the Divine Kingdom and returned once again to the Real World.
As soon as she opened her eyes, Lu Wan stood up.
“Husband, I’ll go make arrangements first.”
“Very soon, this matter will be resolved.”
Watching her busy appearance, Yang Fan smiled helplessly, then nodded.
“Alright.”
Coming downstairs to the villa.
Without the slightest pause, Lu Wan put on the virtual helmet at the very first moment.
The next moment.
Her consciousness once again entered the Virtual World.
Accompanied by spatial shifting, Lu Wan arrived once again at that exact room from just moments ago.
At this moment, Gu Le was still sitting there.
Seeing Lu Wan appear, she said with a smile: “Cousin, why did you have me wait for you?”
Lu Wan glanced at her.
“Stop talking nonsense.”
“You and I both know that Ma Huainan is not that easy to resolve.”
“Husband’s potential is truly terrifying; in the future, he will certainly become a figure standing at the center of power of the Human Federation.”
“But his current self does not yet have sufficient Resources and Foundation to resolve this matter.”
“Therefore, the two of us must join forces on this matter.”
“Only in this way can we ensure nothing goes wrong.”
Hearing these words, the smile on Gu Le’s face gradually faded as she looked earnestly at Lu Wan.
“You make the arrangements.”
“These matters are inherently your strong suit.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“First, Husband’s Divine Kingdom coordinates must absolutely not be exposed.”
“Didn’t Auntie hand over the shares of All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical to you?”
“I remember Sima Yurao also owns shares in this company.”
“This is a company listed on the federal main board, after all. In a moment, you will directly convene a board meeting in the capacity of the largest shareholder and find a way to pressure her.”
“Under necessary circumstances, kick her out of the board of directors.”
Hearing this, Gu Le nodded.
“No problem, but should I directly have a showdown with her?”
“What allowed Ma Huainan to bypass the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence was precisely her network of connections.”
Lu Wan shook her head.
“No need, let her investigate it herself.”
“I have several listed investigative companies within two Starfields.”
“Next, I will intentionally reveal some traces.”
“Not only investigating Ma Huainan, but I will also add Sima Yurao into the investigation targets.”
Gu Le furrowed her brows slightly, “You want to—”
“That’s right.”
Lu Wan said calmly:
“She will soon notice the abnormality.”
“Having her investigate the truth out herself is easier to provoke her anger than us actively telling her.”
“As long as she is not a fool, she will definitely realize the severity of the matter.”
“At that time, there is a high probability she will press Ma Huainan to come over in person and apologize.”
Gu Le frowned slightly.
“Isn’t the risk quite high this way? After all, being caught by the other party with a handle...”
Yet Lu Wan didn’t care in the least.
“Don’t worry, these investigative companies are all held on my behalf by subordinates.”
“If a real problem occurs, at worst we apply for bankruptcy.”
“Without a responsible entity, plus me operating a bit in the federal court, it won’t cause too much trouble.”
Hearing this, the look Gu Le gave Lu Wan held a few parts of surprise for the very first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 429: Treating Peers with Respect
paragraphs: Gu Le didn’t expect that her cousin, who was always shrewd and calm, would actually be willing to take such a huge risk for Yang Fan.
Lu Wan continued,
“These losses are trivial matters.”
“The real trouble is how to completely destroy this person’s divine kingdom.”
“The circulating funds I can mobilize right now are probably only 170 trillion Divinity Points.”
“What about on your end?”
Gu Le was silent for a moment. “Around 40 trillion.”
Lu Wan’s brows furrowed slightly.
“Not enough. I still have some fixed deposits and federal bonds, and I will handle them as soon as possible.”
“As much as you can gather, help me gather it all.”
“Transfer it to me together then.”
Gu Le nodded. “Alright.”
Lu Wan was silent for a moment, then spoke again,
“There is one more matter.”
“Only you can handle this matter.”
Seeing Lu Wan suddenly turn serious, Gu Le’s expression also grew a bit more solemn.
“What matter?”
Lu Wan said slowly,
“Go see your father.”
“Uncle Gu should know a High-Order God from the Blade Clan.”
“After all, every year the Gu Family has quite a few Medicinal Pills flowing to the Blade Clan.”
Hearing this, Gu Le’s expression changed drastically.
“Are you crazy? The cost is too high.”
Lu Wan looked at her without the slightest change in her expression.
“This is the final insurance.”
“Since it’s being done, things must be done thoroughly.”
“Someone who dares to take the risk of investigating another person’s divine kingdom information just because of an S-Rank Building...”
“This kind of person already has a problem with their Mental State; they are an absolute villain.”
“Keeping him is a hidden disaster for Husband.”
“The sooner he is resolved, the sooner we can rest assured.”
“Rest assured, Uncle doesn’t need to step forward personally; I just need a channel.”
“The Blade Clan inherently likes doing this kind of transaction.”
“Give coordinates, give Resources, and they will take charge of resolving it.”
“No traces will be left behind.”
Gu Le took a deep breath. “Understood.”
Just as Lu Wan was preparing to exit the Virtual World,
“Cousin.” Gu Le suddenly spoke up to stop her.
Lu Wan stopped in her tracks and turned back in puzzlement. “What is it?”
Gu Le looked at her, and after hesitating for a moment, she couldn’t help saying,
“How come I feel... that you have more faith in Husband than I do?”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan was stunned for a moment.
Afterwards, she gently shook her head. “It’s not having faith in him.”
Gu Le’s brows raised slightly.
“Oh?”
“Then what is it?”
Instead, she became somewhat curious.
Lu Wan looked at her with a hint of a smile at the corners of her lips. “It’s because of love.”
Leaving behind these words,
the next moment, Lu Wan’s figure instantly vanished within the virtual space.
Leaving only Gu Le standing alone in place, she stood there in a daze for a long time.
“Can this even count as a reason?”
Gu Le opened her mouth, for a moment not knowing what to say at all.
She deeply doubted whether this was still the cousin she knew.
On the other side,
Yang Fan’s consciousness had already returned to his divine kingdom at this moment.
“Yang Da, immediately purchase divine kingdom deduction cards from all channels, the more the better.”
Yang Fan directly issued the order.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da nodded.
As an extension of Yang Fan’s will, he already knew about Ma Huainan’s affair.
Naturally, he also understood what Yang Fan was preparing to do next.
The next moment, Yang Fan continued,
“From now on, notify Yang Eleven, and have all White Zombie believers produce corpse pills with all their might.”
“Stop to Cultivate, the greater the quantity of corpse pills, the better.”
“Yes.” Yang Da said immediately.
“In addition,”
Yang Fan said in a deep voice,
“First, give you the authority for 500 trillion Divinity Points.”
“Arrange a large number of robots to procure disposable wartime supplies from various places along the frontline in batches.”
“The greater the quantity, the better. There is no upper limit for the time being.”
Yang Da was slightly startled. “Master, what needs to be procured?”
Yang Fan thought for a moment.
“Nuclear bombs, high-energy fusion bombs, space annihilation bombs, corrosive bombs...”
“Plague source crystals, destruction Talismans, realm-breaking thunder Talismans, curse scrolls...”
“As long as they are disposable consumables and powerful enough, buy them all for me, the more the better.”
Yang Da nodded. “Understood.”
However, after hesitating for a moment, he still reminded him,
“Master, he is merely a First-Order God; isn’t this a bit too wasteful?”
“Based solely on the combat power of the Zombie Kingdom right now, the opponent is simply not our match at all.”
These disposable wartime supplies were actually not popular among gods.
The reason was very simple: they had no long-term value and could not enhance the foundation of the divine kingdom.
They could not Cultivate dependents and could not increase production capacity.
Using a massive amount of Divinity Points to buy these things was essentially consuming Resources.

Smashing 500 trillion Divinity Points out like that—if it weren’t for the fact that Yang Da knew his own deity possessed a thousandfold yield ability, he would probably suspect that his master had gone crazy.
“Preparing more can’t be wrong after all.”
Yang Fan said indifferently.
“After all...”
“This Ma Huainan, just like me, is a matrilocal son-in-law.”
“When treating peers, naturally one must give a bit more respect.”
Speaking up to this point, a trace of an icy smile appeared at the corners of Yang Fan’s lips.
After communicating with Lu Wan and Gu Le, he had already figured things out clearly.
In this Divine Kingdom War, if he personally took action, he could only deploy zombie believers.
This was his deepest hidden trump card.
Throughout the entire federation, no one knew that his divine kingdom had developed the Zombie System.
When the time comes, capturing Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom with a zombie army—
no one would associate it with Yang Fan.
No matter how the opponent investigated, it would be impossible to trace it to a non-existent deity who walked the path of a Corpse Cultivator.
However, considering the Sima Family behind Ma Huainan,
Yang Fan naturally would not lower his guard.
The gods of the Sima Family were not as simple as that Angel Race god from back then.
Who knew how many trump cards they still held in their hands?
Therefore, for this battle, he must make sufficient preparations.
After giving instructions regarding the arrangements for the divine kingdom,
Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
At the very first moment, he sent a message to Ma Yu.
Then, putting on the virtual helmet, his consciousness descended upon Xiling Planet.
At the headquarters of the Yang Corporation, in the top-floor office,
Ma Yu had already been waiting for a long time.
Seeing Yang Fan appear, he immediately bowed respectfully, “Master.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“I am transferring 100 trillion Divinity Points to you.”
“Starting from now, through the Divine Shop, private trading channels, and other commercial channels, help me procure various types of disposable wartime supplies.”
“The greater the quantity, the better.”
“If funds are insufficient, contact me directly.”
“In addition, arrange a transport team to go to the frontline every day and hand over all the procured supplies to the robots.”
“Understood?”
Ma Yu did not hesitate in the slightest.
“Yes, Master.”
“I will arrange it immediately.”
He did not ask for the reason; he only needed to execute it.
After arranging the Yang Corporation, his consciousness descended upon the Gu Family Territory.
However, he did not go look for Gu Xuanting.
Instead, he directly opened the internal trading section of the Gu Family—Special Building Exchange.

sentences.text: Gu Le didn’t expect that her cousin, who was always shrewd and calm, would actually be willing to take such a huge risk for Yang Fan.
Lu Wan continued,
“These losses are trivial matters.”
“The real trouble is how to completely destroy this person’s divine kingdom.”
“The circulating funds I can mobilize right now are probably only 170 trillion Divinity Points.”
“What about on your end?”
Gu Le was silent for a moment.
“Around 40 trillion.”
Lu Wan’s brows furrowed slightly.
“Not enough.
I still have some fixed deposits and federal bonds, and I will handle them as soon as possible.”
“As much as you can gather, help me gather it all.”
“Transfer it to me together then.”
Gu Le nodded.
“Alright.”
Lu Wan was silent for a moment, then spoke again,
“There is one more matter.”
“Only you can handle this matter.”
Seeing Lu Wan suddenly turn serious, Gu Le’s expression also grew a bit more solemn.
“What matter?”
Lu Wan said slowly,
“Go see your father.”
“Uncle Gu should know a High-Order God from the Blade Clan.”
“After all, every year the Gu Family has quite a few Medicinal Pills flowing to the Blade Clan.”
Hearing this, Gu Le’s expression changed drastically.
“Are you crazy?
The cost is too high.”
Lu Wan looked at her without the slightest change in her expression.
“This is the final insurance.”
“Since it’s being done, things must be done thoroughly.”
“Someone who dares to take the risk of investigating another person’s divine kingdom information just because of an S-Rank Building...”
“This kind of person already has a problem with their Mental State; they are an absolute villain.”
“Keeping him is a hidden disaster for Husband.”
“The sooner he is resolved, the sooner we can rest assured.”
“Rest assured, Uncle doesn’t need to step forward personally; I just need a channel.”
“The Blade Clan inherently likes doing this kind of transaction.”
“Give coordinates, give Resources, and they will take charge of resolving it.”
“No traces will be left behind.”
Gu Le took a deep breath.
“Understood.”
Just as Lu Wan was preparing to exit the Virtual World,
“Cousin.” Gu Le suddenly spoke up to stop her.
Lu Wan stopped in her tracks and turned back in puzzlement.
“What is it?”
Gu Le looked at her, and after hesitating for a moment, she couldn’t help saying,
“How come I feel... that you have more faith in Husband than I do?”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan was stunned for a moment.
Afterwards, she gently shook her head.
“It’s not having faith in him.”
Gu Le’s brows raised slightly.
“Oh?”
“Then what is it?”
Instead, she became somewhat curious.
Lu Wan looked at her with a hint of a smile at the corners of her lips.
“It’s because of love.”
Leaving behind these words,
the next moment, Lu Wan’s figure instantly vanished within the virtual space.
Leaving only Gu Le standing alone in place, she stood there in a daze for a long time.
“You...
“Can this even count as a reason?”
Gu Le opened her mouth, for a moment not knowing what to say at all.
She deeply doubted whether this was still the cousin she knew.
On the other side,
Yang Fan’s consciousness had already returned to his divine kingdom at this moment.
“Yang Da, immediately purchase divine kingdom deduction cards from all channels, the more the better.”
Yang Fan directly issued the order.

Naturally, he also understood what Yang Fan was preparing to do next.

“Stop to Cultivate, the greater the quantity of corpse pills, the better.”
“Yes.” Yang Da said immediately.
“In addition,”
Yang Fan said in a deep voice,
“First, give you the authority for 500 trillion Divinity Points.”
“Arrange a large number of robots to procure disposable wartime supplies from various places along the frontline in batches.”
“The greater the quantity, the better.
There is no upper limit for the time being.”
Yang Da was slightly startled.
“Master, what needs to be procured?”
Yang Fan thought for a moment.
“Nuclear bombs, high-energy fusion bombs, space annihilation bombs, corrosive bombs...”
“Plague source crystals, destruction Talismans, realm-breaking thunder Talismans, curse scrolls...”
“As long as they are disposable consumables and powerful enough, buy them all for me, the more the better.”
Yang Da nodded.
“Understood.”

chapters.title: Chapter 430: Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers
paragraphs: As one of the Five Great Families, the Gu Family possesses many resource channels that ordinary gods cannot access.
Many special buildings that cannot be purchased in the Divine Shop, or are restricted, can be found here.
Yang Fan opened the search bar and entered two characters—”Zombie.”
In the next second, a large amount of text information instantly flashed across the screen.
Densely packed names of buildings quickly emerged.
[A-Rank Building: Death Plague Broodmother]
Price: 400,000 Divinity Points
Effect: Increases the reproduction speed of zombie groups and enhances their plague transmission ability.
[A-Rank Building: Corpse Conversion Altar]
Price: 300,000 Divinity Points
Effect: Can convert a large number of corpses into special zombie units.
[A-Rank Building: Undead Virus Research Institute]
Price: 1.2 million Divinity Points
Effect: Increases the probability of zombie evolution.
[B-rank building: Rotting Corpse Breeding Pool]
Price: 2,000 Divinity Points
Effect: Accelerates the birth rate of low-tier zombies.
[B-rank building: Undead Infection Tower]
Price: 5,000 Divinity Points
Effect: Enhances the infection capability of zombie units.
[B-rank building: Flesh Devouring Nest]
Price: 3,000 Divinity Points
Effect: Increases the growth speed of zombies.
Countless pieces of information flashed by continuously.
With Yang Fan’s powerful Mental Strength, in just a brief moment, he found his true target from among the massive number of buildings.
[A-Rank Building: Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers]
Price: 1 million Divinity Points
Effect: Facilitates zombie movement, contains independent small spaces to store zombie believers, and is equipped with various zombie-race war weapons...
“One million Divinity Points just to buy one.”
Looking at the information of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in front of him, Yang Fan couldn’t help but chuckle.
“These special buildings sold by the Gu Family are indeed quite expensive.”
In the shops of Primordial City’s trading district, the price of resource-type A-Rank Buildings is basically within 50,000 Divinity Points.
Even for war-type buildings, the price would be much higher.
But one million Divinity Points for one is definitely an extremely high premium.
However, Yang Fan could understand this price.
He had searched for similar buildings in the Divine Shop before.
It was just that... in the entire Human Federation, the number of gods who actually took the path of the Corpse Cultivator was simply too small.
Therefore, similar buildings in the Divine Shop were very rare, mostly below B-rank.
As for A-Rank War Structures, they were even rarer.
Only the Five Great Families like the Gu Family, with inventories accumulated over long years, could provide so many in a short time.
Without the slightest hesitation, Yang Fan browsed through the detailed information of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers once more.
Then, he directly clicked purchase.
And in the quantity column.
He directly entered a number—200 million.
In the next moment, a prompt from the Virtual World appeared.
[Do you confirm the purchase of the A-Rank War Structure: Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers?]
[Quantity: 200 million]
[Total Price: 200 trillion Divinity Points]
Yang Fan directly confirmed.
The appearance of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers was actually not that huge; it overall presented a massive rectangular box structure.
With four feet on the ground, it was like a mobile war fortress.
The footprint of a single building was only about one-third of an Intelligent Mecha.
But its internal space was more than a hundred times its own building volume.
This was also the reason why it could store a massive zombie army.
According to Yang Fan’s current estimation, these 200 million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers were enough to allow the Zombie Kingdom to usher in another large-scale surge of troops.
Unlike believers of the Martial Arts and Cultivation systems, zombies had absolutely no requirements for their living environment.
As long as there was a space to stand and a sufficiently dense corpse Qi, they could continuously grow.
The current Eternal Corpse Mine had already formed its own world within Yang Fan’s divine kingdom.
And these Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers would construct countless independent small spaces once again within this world of death.
At the exact moment Yang Fan submitted the purchase application.
Deep within the Gu Family Territory, a Mechanical prompt tone suddenly rang out.
[Warning: Abnormal transaction behavior detected.]
[Querying transaction identity...]
[Identity verification complete. Peerless Prodigy-level Genius, purchase authority approved.]
[Querying building inventory... Inventory is sufficient.]
[Based on the transaction amount, automatically submitting for advanced audit.]
[Auditor: Gu Xuanting.]
In the next moment, a red warning light slowly lit up in the core area of the Gu Family’s high-order intelligent lifeform.
Real World.
Gu Family Territory.
Gu Xuanting and Lu Qinglan were sitting in the courtyard drinking tea.
Suddenly, the prompt tone of the intelligent lifeform came from inside the room.
“Third Elder, Yang Fan, the external Genius of your lineage, has applied to purchase a large number of A-Rank special buildings.”
“According to Clan procedures, it requires your audit.”
Hearing this, Gu Xuanting raised his eyebrows slightly. “Since when does our Gu Family have such a rule?”
The intelligent lifeform immediately replied:
“According to the Gu Family’s regulation number 10086.”
“If a Clan member purchases a large number of special buildings at one time, exceeding the risk limit, it requires an audit by a Clan Elder.”
Gu Xuanting nodded.
Then, with a thought, the information from the intelligent lifeform instantly streamed into his consciousness.
However, in the next moment, Gu Xuanting’s expression became somewhat odd.
Aside him, Lu Qinglan noticed his change.
“What’s wrong? What did that child Yang Fan buy?”
“To actually trigger an audit even from the Gu Family’s intelligent lifeform?”
Gu Xuanting was silent for a moment, then slowly said:
“This kid...”
“Spent 200 trillion Divinity Points, all to purchase A-rank war weapons.”
“And they are war weapons for the Corpse Cultivator path.”
Hearing this, Lu Qinglan also showed a look of confusion.
“Corpse Cultivator?”
“Such buildings should be completely useless to his divine kingdom, right?”
Gu Xuanting shook his head.
“I’m not sure, but I have already approved the audit.”
“Let the young people resolve their own matters.”
“If they really can’t resolve it, we Elders can step in then.”
After speaking, he picked up his teacup and took a gentle sip.
“What do you know?” Lu Qinglan asked, puzzled.
“I don’t know, but just now, your precious daughter asked me for the contact information of a Blade Clan High-Order God.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Lu Qinglan, who was sitting opposite him, suddenly stood up.
“What?”
“She wants the contact information of a Blade Clan High-Order God?”
“Nonsense! Is that kind of existence something she can contact right now?”
“Could Le’er have run into some big trouble?”
“No, I have to go ask her.”
Saying so, Lu Qinglan prepared to leave.
Gu Xuanting shook his head helplessly.
“Alright, Le girl just defeated an Alien Demigod not long ago, and she is not far from breaking through to a god.”
“If we arrange everything for her, she will never truly grow.”
“Let her handle it herself.”
Gu Xuanting couldn’t help but laugh.
“Don’t you know her personality by now?”
“When has this girl ever suffered a loss since she was a child?”
“Whenever she gets a chance, she thinks about how to fleece Resources from the two of us.”
“If she really encountered something she couldn’t resolve, she would probably have run to me to act spoiled and ask for help long ago.”
Lu Qinglan thought about it and felt it made some sense, but her face still carried a bit of worry.
Gu Xuanting shook his head and laughed.
“These two children... they are clearly just Low-rank Deitys, yet they dare to spend money like this.”
“200 trillion Divinity Points, how much investment in their divine kingdoms could that have made?”
“Buying life planets, company shares, which of those isn’t good?”
“Yet they spent it all on war buildings.”
Speaking up to this point, a hint of curiosity also appeared in Gu Xuanting’s eyes.
“I really am quite curious to know what exactly happened to the two of them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Kicked Out of the Board of Directors
paragraphs: At this moment, Yang Fan was standing within the Gu Family Territory of the Virtual World, quietly waiting for the transaction to be completed.
Before long, a Mechanical prompt tone sounded all around.
“Application approved.”
“Please pay the Divinity Points.”
Yang Fan’s thoughts moved slightly.
The next moment, his consciousness connected to his Divine Kingdom.
Two trillion Divinity Points were instantly paid from the Divine Kingdom to the Gu Family.
“Transaction successful.”
“It has been detected that the Peerless Prodigy Yang Fan is currently at the frontline.”
“Considering the immense value of this transaction, the Gu Family will initiate a dedicated spatial wormhole to directly transfer the purchased Resources to your Divine Kingdom.”
The Mechanical voice sounded once again.
Hearing this, a trace of a smile appeared at the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
Afterwards, his consciousness exited the Virtual World.
Real World.
Yang Fan opened his eyes once more.
At the very first moment, he perceived the situation of his Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, a trace of surprise appeared on his face.
The Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers had actually all arrived.
“The space at the frontline is so unstable that ordinary goods simply cannot be purchased through the Divine Shop.”
“Yet the Five Great Families actually possess exclusive channels to stably transmit Resources.”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but shake his head and smile.
“As expected... The gap between upper-class people and ordinary people is truly not ordinary.”
“Yang Da, load all Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers into the Eternal Corpse Mine.”
“In addition, continue purchasing cloning nutrient tanks; the more the quantity, the better.”
“The Zombie Kingdom requires more sources of troops.”
Yang Fan directly transmitted his voice.
“Yes, Master.”
In his mind, Yang Da’s response immediately sounded.
After arranging everything, Yang Fan came to the window.
Looking into the distance, he said softly,
“Next, we’ll just wait for Wan’er and the others to finish their investigation.”
“Ma Huainan... Your Divine Kingdom Core, I’ve claimed it.”
Ever since Yang Fan loaded the Eternal Corpse Mine into his Divine Kingdom, Yang Da had never stopped purchasing Resources.
Through various channels, a massive amount of flesh and blood energy continuously entered Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Afterwards, through the Life Essence Conversion Pool, it was transformed into the purest corpse qi.
Now, inside the Eternal Corpse Mine, the corpse qi had long since grown rich to the extreme.
Under the effect of the Evolution Talent, as long as a sufficient number of clones were invested,
these originally ordinary lives would quickly complete their zombification.
Furthermore, nourished by the sufficient corpse qi, they would rapidly grow into Zombie Generals of the Qi Refining Realm.
According to Yang Fan’s estimation, the 200 million Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers purchased this time, although vastly expanding the living space for the zombies,
would still take about a thousand years to completely fill these spaces.
In the Real World, that would be about ten days.
By then, the power of the Zombie Kingdom would usher in another explosive growth.
And the investigation into Ma Huainan’s information by Lu Wan and Gu Le obviously couldn’t be completed so quickly.
Therefore, Yang Fan was not in a hurry.
Besides this, to ensure that this war was foolproof,
he also invested five to six hundred trillion Divinity Points to massively purchase various disposable war supplies.
With such terrifying Resources all invested into a war, let alone Low-rank Deitys, even Mid-tier Gods wouldn’t dare.
Yet Yang Fan did not hesitate in the slightest, because he wanted to annihilate the opponent with thunderous momentum.
After all, being a Peerless Prodigy evaluated by the Federal Government, the longer the time dragged on, the more variables there would be.
Meanwhile,
in the second-floor bedroom of the Sima Family villa in the frontline region,
there was only Sima Yurao inside the room at this moment.
She slowly took off her virtual helmet, her complexion ugly to the extreme.
The next second.
“Bang!”
With a loud crash, the virtual helmet was fiercely smashed onto the ground by her.
Terrifying power erupted instantly, causing even the entire villa to vibrate slightly.
However, the villas in the frontline region were all crafted using special materials.
Even if a god attacked with full force, it would be very difficult to easily destroy them.
“Wife, what happened?”
Ma Huainan’s voice came from outside the door.
Sima Yurao’s expression was gloomy.
“It’s none of your business, and you can’t help anyway.”
“Don’t come disturbing me, scram.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s extended right hand paused slightly outside the door, and his expression turned somewhat ugly.
But only a moment later, he took a deep breath, and a gentle smile reappeared on his face.
“Wife Yurao, then I won’t disturb you.”
“We are husband and wife; if there is any trouble, you must tell me.”
“Also... I love you.”
Having said that, Ma Huainan turned and left.
However, the moment he turned around, the smile on his face vanished instantly, and a flash of disgust even crossed his eyes.
“She is simply a woman with an S-grade Divine Kingdom Talent.”
“Isn’t it just that her background is a bit better than mine?”
“If it weren’t to obtain the Sima Family’s Resources and additional investments...”
“How could I possibly take a fancy to an old woman like you?”
Ma Huainan muttered discontentedly in his heart.
Inside the room, Sima Yurao seemed to have completely not heard the commotion outside the door.
At this moment, she was constantly pacing back and forth in the room.
Message after message on Feixun was rapidly sent out by her.
“Young Miss Sima, Young Miss Gu currently owns 61% of All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical’s shares.”
“Even if the request she puts forward is unreasonable, the board of directors can only execute according to her decision.”
“Niece Yurao, I have no way out regarding this matter either.”
“At today’s board meeting, I already explicitly expressed my opposition.”
“Sigh...”
“Just how on earth did you provoke her?”
“President Lu has already transferred all shares to her; as long as she hasn’t infringed upon the core interests of the company,”
“indeed no one can stop the removal of a board seat.”
“Young Miss Sima, I helped you ask about it tactfully.”
“However, CEO Gu’s side did not reply.”
“Think of a way to ease the relationship yourself.”
“On my end, there is also no way.”
Sima Yurao looked at the replying messages one by one on Feixun, her expression growing increasingly ugly.
All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical controlled about 0.5% of the herb market across the entire Human Federation.
As a behemoth enterprise listed on the federal main board, it had always been one of Sima Yurao’s greatest sources of Resources.
Of course, simple company dividends actually weren’t much.
What she truly valued were the board seats.
Because as long as one entered the board of directors of All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical,
then she could have a hand in the company’s material procurement, bidding selection, financial planning, and even future development direction.
These hidden interests were the truly massive Resources.
These were all power, truly important resource channels.
However... Sima Yurao still hadn’t figured out by now what on earth had happened.
In the past, the benefits she obtained from the company were all within the scope permitted by the rules.
Even many matters were handled very covertly by her.
Why suddenly...
would Gu Le convene a board meeting without any warning?
Furthermore, an announcement was temporarily issued an hour ago, requiring all board members to be present immediately.
At that time, Sima Yurao even thought whether the company had some major project or strategic adjustment.
She even had intelligent lifeform prepare a detailed speech draft in advance,
thinking whether she could take this opportunity to strive for some new Resources and authorities.
As a result, no matter what she thought, she never expected...
This board meeting, from the very beginning, was convened specifically targeting her.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: Don't Blame This Young Miss For Being Impolite
paragraphs: Thinking of the scene in the Virtual World where Gu Le calmly announced the revocation of her seat on the All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical board of directors and then directly exited,
Sima Yurao grinded her teeth in anger.
“Bastard!”
“Is being an only daughter such a big deal?”
“How on earth did I offend you?”
Sima Yurao slammed her palm hard on the desk.
Although in the eyes of outsiders, Sima Yurao was the daughter of the Sima Family head with an incomparably noble status,
only she herself knew just how massive the gap was between her and Gu Le.
Her mother was merely a sixth-order god from the Qin Family, failing to reach the core circle of the Five Great Families.
As for her father, although he was the current head of the Sima Family, he had a vast number of offspring.
Aside from the tiny minority who truly displayed top-tier talent and ability, most of the other offspring were left in a laissez-faire state.
For Sima Yurao to reach where she was today, she relied much more on her own abilities and opportunities.
But Gu Le was different; both parents were High-Order Gods, and she was an only daughter.
The identities of the two seemed to both belong to the direct line of the Five Great Families,
but the Resources and heritage they truly mastered were completely on different levels.
The gap between them was like the difference between clouds and mud.
Sima Yurao took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the fury in her heart.
Then she opened Feixun and dialed a video call.
Soon, the projection of a middle-aged man wearing a deep black suit appeared on the room’s wall.
“Little sister, I just heard about it.”
The man’s tone was calm.
This person was precisely Sima Yurao’s biological older brother—Sima Zhao.
He had graduated from Primordial Academy for over three hundred years and was likewise a Peerless Prodigy.
Today, he was also one of the important candidates for the next head of the Sima Family.
“Brother.”
Seeing Sima Zhao appear, Sima Yurao finally couldn’t help saying,
“I spent nearly a hundred years just to enter the All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical board of directors!”
“Waiting in line, pulling strings, and continuously accumulating connections.”
“Only then did I finally secure this position.”
“Now, with a single sentence from Gu Le, I’ve been kicked straight out of the board.”
“I refuse to accept this!”
The more Sima Yurao spoke, the more furious she became.
Losing her board seat meant far more to her than just losing a share of benefits.
Instead, it meant that her Divine Kingdom’s planning, resource investment, and development route for the next century might all be immensely impacted.
This loss was already too great for her to accept.
Sima Zhao rubbed the space between his brows.
“Little sister, how on earth did you provoke her?”
Hearing this, Sima Yurao instantly grew anxious.
“No, brother!”
“Today is the first time I’ve ever seen her.”
“In the past, I only heard others mention her; I don’t know this person at all.”
“I’ve already explained to everyone, but not a single person believes me.”
“They seem to have concluded that I was the one who did something wrong!”
Sima Yurao’s face was filled with incomprehension.
Until now, she still didn’t know how she had offended Gu Le.
Looking at the expression on his biological younger sister’s face, Sima Zhao’s brows furrowed tighter and tighter.
“Since you don’t know Gu Le,”
“that means the one you offended is not her personally, but someone close to her.”
“Her parents are both big shots standing at the pinnacle of the Federation; with our status, it’s simply impossible to come into contact with them on ordinary days.”
“So... it can only be her friends or people close to her.”
“Think carefully, have you provoked anyone recently?”
Sima Zhao asked in a deep voice.
“Brother, I’ve always been very careful in what I do.”
Sima Yurao quickly explained.
“Even if I used my position’s convenience to obtain some company Resources, it was entirely within the scope permitted by the rules.”
“The benefits that should be distributed were never shortchanged. Not a single person who needed to be buttered up was left out.”
“As for the people on the Gu Family side, I have never offended them either.”
“Moreover, at today’s board meeting, there were even a few direct descendants of the Gu Family speaking up for me.”
Speaking to this point, Sima Yurao suddenly stopped, freezing in place as if a flash of inspiration swept through her mind.
“What’s wrong? Did you think of something?”
Sima Zhao immediately noticed her change.
“That...”
Sima Yurao hesitated for a moment.
“I remember now, Gu Le’s husband, Yang Fan.”
“It seems he has some grievance with Ma Huainan.”
Hearing these words, Sima Zhao’s gaze instantly turned cold.
“In other words... the person who truly caused the trouble is Ma Huainan?”
“However...”
Sima Yurao frowned.
“This isn’t even any big deal.”
“And I already took the initiative to apologize to the other party during the previous gathering.”
“At the time, the other party didn’t show any abnormality either.”
“If it were just because of this matter, Gu Le wouldn’t make such a huge fuss. This is unreasonable.”
On the other end of the video, Sima Zhao fell into silence.
A moment later, he slowly spoke:
“This Ma Huainan... his talent is indeed not bad.”
“But in terms of Mental State, he is still lacking somewhat.”
“I’ve reminded you long ago to be more on guard against this person.”
“Go, immediately arrange for intelligent lifeform to investigate what he has done recently, especially regarding the internal channels of the Sima Family.”
“I want to know the entire process.”
“Once the matter is investigated clearly, I’ll find a way to help you act as this middleman.”
Sima Zhao didn’t say anything more and directly closed the video call.
Inside the room.
Sima Yurao was silent for a moment.
Then she slowly turned her head to look toward the door, her gaze gradually turning icy.
“Zero.” She said softly.
“Master, what are your orders?”
The Mechanical voice of the intelligent lifeform sounded in the room.
“Immediately investigate what Ma Huainan has done recently, focusing on the internal channels of the Sima Family.”
“Additionally...”
“Find a professional background check company to help me investigate three people.”
“Yang Fan, Gu Le, Lu Wan.”
“Remember, do not dig too deep; just basic recent information.”
Sima Yurao said.
“Yes, Master.” The intelligent lifeform responded.
Sima Yurao leaned back in her chair, quietly looking at the starry sky outside the window.
A long time later, she muttered softly:
“Ma Huainan... if you really did something foolish to block my Dao path,”
“then don’t blame this Young Miss for being impolite.”
In the Real World, half a month passed in a flash.
During this period of time, the Zombie Kingdom in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom finally completed a new round of troop replenishment.
Not only that, because of Yang Fan’s resource inclination during this period,
a large number of alien corpses were continuously purchased back through shops on the frontline and then all poured into the Life Essence Conversion Pool.
After half a month of accumulation, the concentration of corpse Qi in the Eternal Corpse Mine increased by about another twenty percent.
Now in that world of death, the dense corpse Qi even formed black mist visible to the naked eye.
A large number of zombies continuously evolved within it, and the number of Zombie Generals grew increasingly high.
Even quite a few Zombie Kings successfully achieved a breakthrough to the White Zombie level.
However, what made Yang Fan slightly regretful was that the breakthrough of high-order believers walking the Corpse Cultivator route was more difficult than imagined.
Until now, not a single White Zombie believer had broken through to a higher level.
In the afternoon, Yang Fan was inside his room, listening to Yang Da’s report.
“Master, the number of stored corpse pills in the Zombie Kingdom has currently reached...”
“Additionally, the procurement progress of one-time war supplies has reached forty percent.”
“I have already let Yang Eleven reorganize the troops and prepare for war.”
“On the Dark Web auction...”
Just at this moment,
“Dong, dong, dong.”
The door was suddenly knocked on.

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Underlying Mindset
paragraphs: Yang Fan looked up, “Come in.”
The next moment, Lu Wan pushed the door open and entered.
Holding two electronic tablets in her hands, she walked quickly toward Yang Fan.
A trace of excitement was on her face.
But at the same time, there was also a hint of exhaustion in her eyes.
“Husband, the basic information has been investigated clearly.”
“Although the deduction probability is still very low, it has already reached the minimum standard for deduction.”
After all, Ma Huainan was a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius, and he also had the Sima Family behind him. Investigating his past was not an easy task.
Especially since much of the critical data was protected by Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
Wanting to find loopholes bit by bit without triggering the alarm required a lot of effort, even for Lu Wan.
“You’ve worked hard, Wife Wan’er,” Yang Fan said with heartache.
Yang Fan looked at the electronic tablet in his hand.
The level of detail in the information above far exceeded his imagination.
From Ma Huainan’s birth, to the Awakening of his divine kingdom, and then to being recruited in advance by the Sima Family to enter Primordial Academy as an early admission student.
Every experience was recorded clearly.
Parents, family members, high school classmates, and college friends.
Even including the Subordinate God he once subdued, there was detailed information.
Not only that, it unexpectedly even recorded the divine kingdom coordinates of some Divine Beings.
These coordinates were all marked, and most of them were classmates or friends who had cooperated with Ma Huainan during his high school days.
These seemingly ordinary pieces of information had extreme value for deducing the divine kingdom coordinates.
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly.
He was very clear that Ma Huainan’s security Level was the same as his own.
Wanting to investigate the data to this extent without triggering the alert of Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence.
Lu Wan must have paid a heavy price.
Thinking of this, a trace of warmth involuntarily rose in Yang Fan’s heart.
Afterward, he picked up the other electronic tablet and began to read it.
Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
Because the data on it was unexpectedly that of Sima Yurao.
“Wan’er, why did you even investigate her divine kingdom information?” Yang Fan asked with some confusion.
Hearing this, Lu Wan chuckled softly.
“Just a convenience, mainly to let this Young Miss of the Sima Family know that I am investigating her.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly, “Oh? You let her discover it on purpose?”
“That’s right.”
Lu Wan nodded.
“The day before yesterday, an investigation company of mine in the Tianyuan Starfield was sealed by the Federal Government.”
“Presumably by now, Sima Yurao should already know.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression changed slightly, “Are you alright?”
Lu Wan looked at his worried appearance and shook her head with a smile.
“Husband, rest assured, it’s just that an investigation company was sealed.”
“I have already applied pressure through the Lu Family’s channels, from the planetary court to the high court of the entire Starfield, and then to the Federal Government Supreme Court.”
“Going through the procedures layer by layer.”
“Without ten years, this matter simply cannot be discussed to a result.”
“Even if we really lose in the end, at worst we will just let this company go bankrupt directly.”
Lu Wan waved her hand dismissively.
“It’s just a local listed company; compared to the safety of your divine kingdom, Husband, it’s simply nothing at all.”
“Presumably, Sima Yurao must be at her wits’ end by now, and Ma Huainan won’t have the ability to continue investigating Husband’s information over there either.”
Hearing these words, a wave of emotion inevitably rose in Yang Fan’s heart.
This pampered life... felt simply too amazing.
If he had to handle it himself, he would probably only be able to find a way in the Real World to look for an opportunity and directly solve Ma Huainan with absolute military force.

After all, although the Yang Corporation was developing at an extremely fast speed nowadays, it was ultimately just starting out.

Yang Fan held Lu Wan in his arms and said seriously.
Lu Wan leaned into his arms, her eyes similarly filled with tenderness.
“Husband, rest assured, I will protect you well.”

“Right, Husband.”
“Although I have handed these investigative data to you, the matter of deducing Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom coordinates should still be left to my team to handle.”
“Husband, you don’t need to worry. Just leave the subsequent matters to Wan’er.”

Relying solely on these investigative data, wanting to deduce the divine kingdom coordinates of a deity had a success probability far lower than deducing through the Subordinate God Divine Kingdom Core.
It could even be said that there was a gap of a thousand or ten thousand times between the two.
The only advantage was that this method could be tried repeatedly.
But every deduction required consuming a divine kingdom deduction card.
In Lu Wan’s view, Yang Fan didn’t even want the dowry of 100 trillion Divinity Points when marrying her as husband and wife.
Now the development of his divine kingdom was probably at a tight stage.
This kind of matter that required consuming a large amount of Resources should naturally be borne by her.
“Got it, but Wan’er, you don’t need to be too anxious; just take your time.”
Yang Fan said seriously.
Lu Wan smiled.
“Alright, Husband, I’ve been working very hard during this period, so you must properly compensate me.”
“Of course.” Yang Fan laughed loudly.
Afterward, he put the two electronic tablets into his divine kingdom. While beginning to undress, he used mental communication to contact Yang Da and passed down the subsequent arrangements.

“Slap!”
A crisp sound rang out.
Sima Yurao fiercely slapped Ma Huainan across the face.
At this moment, Ma Huainan was kneeling on the ground.
Although his divine kingdom followed the Martial Route and his Physical Body was incomparably powerful.
But after all, he had just achieved a breakthrough as a deity not long ago, and facing Sima Yurao, he had no qualification to resist at all.
In just a short moment, his face had already swollen like a pig’s head.
“Idiot!”
“You actually dared to use the Sima Family’s authority, bypassing the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence to investigate Yang Fan’s divine kingdom information!”
Sima Yurao’s expression was ice-cold.
“Lu Wan and Gu Le are standing behind Yang Fan; don’t you know this point?”
“Because of your self-assertion, do you know how much profit I lost?”
“My board seat in All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical was directly stripped away by Gu Le!”
“Now it’s fine; Lu Wan has already started investigating the divine kingdom information of both of us.”
“Are you satisfied?”
Ma Huainan lowered his head and did not speak.
Sima Yurao became more and more furious the more she spoke.
“As expected of someone who came from a small place.”
“No matter how high the Genius is, they cannot get rid of that kind of underlying mindset.”
“Holding a grudge for a lifetime over a minor matter.”
“Daring to take such a big risk because of so-called face.”
“How could this Young Miss have taken a fancy to someone like you in the first place!”
After speaking, Sima Yurao snorted coldly.
“Keep kneeling for me.”
“You are not allowed to stand up for the whole day today!”
Leaving these words behind, she turned and walked upstairs.
Watching Sima Yurao’s retreating figure.
Ma Huainan clenched his fists tightly, his eyes filled with anger and unwillingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 434: A Dignified Ending
paragraphs: “Stupid woman... Do I have a bottom-tier mindset?”
“Is Yang Fan not the same?”
“He and I are essentially the same kind of person.”
“Given the opportunity, he would likewise strike at me without the slightest hesitation.”
“I am merely making my move first.”
Ma Huainan roared inwardly.
In reality, Ma Huainan and Yang Fan had extremely similar experiences.
Both of them came from remote planets.
Both relied on their own talents to be discovered by top-tier factions, and then walked step by step to where they were today.
People of the same kind are often the easiest to see through one another.
During that gambling duel back then, on the surface, it appeared that Ma Huainan merely lost a War God Codex.
He also admitted that he held a grudge against Yang Fan because of this.
But at the same time, he was also clear that Yang Fan must have seen through his grudge.
Later, Sima Yurao offered to ease the relationship for him.
Although Ma Huainan agreed, his true purpose was to lower Yang Fan’s vigilance and make the other party think that the conflict between the two had been resolved.
That night, after listening to Sima Yurao recount the entire process of the banquet,
Ma Huainan completely confirmed that Yang Fan’s words were all just “polite pleasantries” and completely insincere.
This world is simply like this.
The so-called peace is merely an illusion when there are temporarily no conflicts of interest.
Since they had already formed a feud, rather than waiting for someone else to make the first move, it was better to seize the initiative himself.
Because losers are not qualified to regret.
Although Ma Huainan was extremely confident in his SS-Rank Martial God Body talent,
he also understood that the ultimate competition in the development of a Divine Kingdom still came down to Resources.
When he learned that Yang Corporation had been established by Yang Fan, and even injected 200 trillion Divinity Points all at once,
he realized that the longer time dragged on, the lower the probability of him catching up would be.
Therefore... he had to resolve this hidden danger in advance.
“Damn it!”
“Why was I exposed so quickly?”
Ma Huainan’s eyes were gloomy.
“That person Yang Fan will absolutely not give up on deducing my Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“Could it be... that I really can only make my Divine Kingdom coordinates public and seek help from the Sima Family?”
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan’s heart was filled with unwillingness.
Meanwhile, in the second-floor room, Sima Yurao closed the door.
She immediately dialed Sima Zhao’s video call at the first opportunity.
Moments later, Sima Zhao’s projection appeared in the room.
At this moment, his expression was also somewhat weary.
“I have seen all the messages you sent me.”
“You basically don’t have to think about a board seat in All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical anymore.”
“Since you won’t be able to interfere with the company’s core operations in the future, you should dispose of the shares in your hands as soon as possible.”
Sima Zhao said in a deep voice.
“As for the matter of investigating someone else’s Divine Kingdom coordinates behind their backs...”
“It is not a misunderstanding that can be easily resolved just by meeting for a meal and ceding a little benefit.”
Sima Yurao gritted her teeth.
“Brother, I know, but right now Lu Wan is investigating the Divine Kingdom information of me and Ma Huainan.”
“Although I have sealed up the other party’s company in time,”
“I simply don’t know how much they have found out.”
Sima Zhao was silent for a moment, then said:
“Since matters have reached this step, both sides of you must take a step back.”
“You and Ma Huainan will immediately go to apologize in person.”
“Prepare a Divine Kingdom Contract to guarantee that neither side will deduce the other’s Divine Kingdom coordinates in the future.”
“In addition, have Ma Huainan give the two War God Codexes you brought as part of your dowry to Yang Fan as a compensation gift.”
“After all, they haven’t truly suffered losses. As long as the attitude is sincere enough, the other party should accept it.”
Sima Yurao sighed, “Brother, I know.”
Sima Zhao nodded.
But the next moment, his expression became serious.
“There is one more matter. You immediately have intelligent lifeform draft a divorce application.”
Sima Yurao was stunned, “What?”
“During the marriage, Ma Huainan severely harmed your Divine Kingdom interests, which already constitutes a major fault.”
“Make him return those shares. As for the Divine Kingdom investments and S-Rank Buildings that Mother gave him back then, let them be considered severance pay.”
“Let everyone end things with dignity.”
Sima Zhao’s tone was calm, but his eyes were extremely serious.
Hearing this, Sima Yurao looked at her brother in the video with disbelief.
“Brother... Although Ma Huainan indeed has problems with his character,”
“after all, his Divine Kingdom Talent is an SS-Rank Martial God Body.”
“In the future, he has a great chance of becoming a Human race High-Order God.”
“It was already not easy for me to find such a husband. Do I really want to give him up?”
Although Sima Yurao also possessed an S-Rank Divine Kingdom Talent,
she was very clear that her talent was among the weakest batch of S-Ranks.
The biggest backing that allowed her to have her current position in the Sima Family over the years was not her own talent,
but rather that she had an outstanding brother—Sima Zhao.
In addition, the Resources and connections in her hands also relied heavily on her status in the Sima Family.
Although on ordinary days she always belittled Ma Huainan as being worth nothing,
in reality, Sima Yurao knew very clearly in her heart.
Ma Huainan’s potential was not weak at all; an SS-Rank Divine Kingdom Talent belonged to the absolute top-tier talent looking across the entire Human Federation.
If they truly divorced,
with her own conditions, she would likely find it hard to ever find a partner more outstanding than Ma Huainan in the future.
As for so-called love...
for gods, it was inherently the cheapest thing.
Long lifespans made emotions even more complicated.
The combination between the vast majority of gods never looked at love, but rather at interests.
What Ma Huainan valued were immediate interests.
And what Sima Yurao valued were future interests.
“Trust your brother’s judgment.”
Sima Zhao looked at his younger sister and persuaded her patiently:
“After the divorce, relying on the identity of the Sima Family, it is not difficult to find a well-matched Human Race Prodigy from the Five Great Families.”
“This Ma Huainan has too poor a Mental State.”
“Even if ten thousand years in the future, he truly becomes a High-Order God,”
“with his personality, there is a high probability that he will abandon you one day.”
“People who come from small places like this do not understand what dignity is.”
“Since he cannot be controlled, then cut your losses in time and do not continue to pour in more sunk costs.”
After hearing these words, Sima Yurao was silent for a long time, and finally let out a long sigh.
“I know, Brother.”
After hanging up the communication, Sima Yurao sat in the room with a complex mood.
When she first got together with Ma Huainan, she thought she had picked up a huge bargain.
A Peerless Prodigy who came from an ordinary planet yet possessed an SS-Rank Divine Kingdom Talent.
As long as she cultivated him slightly, he would definitely be able to become her assistance in the future.
But looking at it now...
this investment seemed to have suffered a huge loss.
The massive Resources invested in the earlier stage had almost all gone down the drain.
Not only that, but because of Ma Huainan’s reckless behavior, she lost her position on the board of directors of All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical.
Thinking of this, Sima Yurao even wished she could go back down and beat him up fiercely again.
But in the end, she still suppressed the anger in her heart.
After all, Ma Huainan’s talent was right there.
Even without her help, his future achievements would not be low.
Brother was right; the most rational choice right now was a dignified ending.
