chapters.title: Chapter 435: Clown
paragraphs: In the afternoon, on the second floor of the Lu Family Villa.
Yang Fan and Lu Wan were sitting on the balcony, drinking afternoon tea.
At that moment, the intelligent lifeform walked up the stairs.
“Master, Sima Yurao and Ma Huainan have come to visit.”
Hearing these words, a cold sneer appeared at the corner of Lu Wan’s mouth.
“Their reaction is really slow.”
“It’s been so long, and only now are they thinking of coming over to apologize.”
Yang Fan looked at her. “Wan’er, do you think we should see them?”
Lu Wan shook her head.
“There is no need. Matters have already progressed to the step of investigating the Divine Kingdom’s information.”
“Both sides can actually be considered to have completely torn off their masks.”
“The reason why I deliberately let Sima Yurao discover my actions was simply to let her know the reason.”
“To warn Ma Huainan not to continue investigating.”
Speaking of this, Lu Wan’s gaze gradually turned cold.
“Since we have already offended them, my suggestion is still to root them out completely.”
After saying this, she raised her hand and gently made a slashing motion in front of her neck, her gaze devoid of the slightest warmth.
Seeing this, Yang Fan nodded.
“That’s right. Even if we meet them, it would just be some polite superficialities, which is meaningless.”
Afterwards, Yang Fan directly gave the order, “No one is home, send them away.”
“Yes.” The intelligent lifeform responded.
Then it exited the room and closed the door halfway.
Outside the villa.
Hearing the reply from the intelligent lifeform, Sima Yurao’s expression instantly turned as ugly as could be.
“No one?”
“What a joke!”
“If there was no one, why did it need to go inside to announce just now?”
She never expected that Yang Fan and Lu Wan wouldn’t give her any face at all.
They weren’t even willing to meet her; this completely exceeded her expectations.
On the other hand, Ma Huainan beside her looked much more relaxed.
Because he never thought that Yang Fan would stop investigating just because of an apology.
Now at least his two War God Codexes were preserved.
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan looked at Sima Yurao and said gently,
“Wife, let’s go back.”
“This matter was my recklessness.”
“In the future, I will definitely tell you everything in advance.”
“Let’s work hard together to develop the Divine Kingdom and run this home well.”
“When I become a High-Order God in the future... I will definitely buy the entire All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical and give it to you.”
As he spoke, the corners of Ma Huainan’s eyes turned slightly red, and his face was full of remorse.
Just like a little boy who had made a mistake and was trying hard to make up for it.
However, Sima Yurao just quietly looked at him.
After a moment, she took a deep breath and said,
“Ma Huainan, although gods possess endless lifespans, the one or two hundred-year age gap between you and me is nothing.”
“But you are still too young.”
Ma Huainan was stunned, not understanding the other person’s meaning.
Sima Yurao suddenly chuckled, but in that smile, there was not the slightest bit of warmth.
“Over the years, I, Sima Yurao, have had at least one or two hundred boyfriends.”
“Do you think... I really can’t see through these little thoughts of yours?”
Ma Huainan’s expression changed slightly.
Sima Yurao continued speaking:
“You’ve even made empty promises reaching all the way to a High-Order God.”
“I have to say, your imagination is quite rich.”
“Little husband, in the past, I played along with you and listened to those sweet words because you had value, and because your future was worth investing in.”
“But now...”
“You don’t need to continue performing this act in front of me.”
As her voice fell, the smile on Ma Huainan’s face gradually froze.
For a moment, he was actually somewhat at a loss.
“I have already submitted the divorce application.”
“You belong to the party at serious fault during the continuation of the marriage.”
“Therefore, you only need to return those shares that my mother and elder brother gave you back then.”
“As for the other Resources... consider them a breakup fee.”
Sima Yurao’s tone was calm, as if she were simply dealing with a most ordinary trivial matter.
Hearing these words, Ma Huainan felt as if he had been struck by lightning.
“You want to divorce me?”
There was a hint of disbelief in his voice.
Sima Yurao looked at him and gently shook her head.
“Why ever not?”
“This Young Miss originally chose to be with you after getting a divorce.”
“Now it seems... uniting with you is probably the most failed investment in my divine career.”
Speaking of this, Sima Yurao couldn’t even help giving a bitter chuckle.
Ma Huainan’s expression was ugly, and he suppressed his anger as he said,
“Why should the shares be returned to you?”
“You were the one who initiatively proposed the divorce.”
Hearing this, Sima Yurao did not show any expression of surprise, but only said indifferently,
“My eldest brother said you lacked decency, and now it seems he really wasn’t wrong.”
“We signed a prenuptial agreement before, and your intelligent lifeform should be very clear about its contents.”
“If you agree, then end this relationship as soon as possible, so we both have one less trouble.”
“If you don’t agree... then you can only spend a huge price to hire a legal-type high-order intelligent lifeform to help you fight the lawsuit.”
“However... this is a lawsuit you are bound to lose.”
Speaking of this, Sima Yurao suddenly approached Ma Huainan and whispered in his ear:
“Husband.”
“That little trick of yours of ‘I love you’, I wonder which girl at Heavenly Fragrance Club you learned it from?”
Ma Huainan’s expression changed slightly.
But Sima Yurao did not stop.
“In the past, there was also a Human Race Prodigy who liked to live off women, saying these words to me every day.”
“Hearing it too much... I became numb to it long ago.”
“I’ll give you a piece of advice: next time if you want to live off women in this way,”
“You’d better learn from Yang Fan and find a younger one.”
“Your methods are still too naive, you can deceive young women with them.”
“But if you want to deceive me... you aren’t qualified yet.”
After finishing, Sima Yurao directly turned and left.
After walking a few steps, she paused, and without looking back, she said:
“Your things will be moved to the new villa by the intelligent robot in a moment.”
“Although we are already divorced, with your identity as a Peerless Prodigy, you can still continue to live in the Sima Family’s villa.”
“You are a smart person; you should know how to choose.”
“Transfer the shares back early, and when we meet in the future, we will still be friends.”
Watching Sima Yurao’s retreating figure,
Ma Huainan stood in place without speaking for a long time, a trace of bewilderment in his eyes.
He had always thought that Sima Yurao hitting and scolding him on ordinary days
was simply because this woman had a strong personality and a bad temper.
But in reality, he had always relied on the so-called “honey trap” to take advantage of the other party.
He thought he controlled everything and thought Sima Yurao was infatuated with his talent and future.
But until this moment, he realized that the other party knew everything; she just didn’t care about those small matters in the past.
Those so-called sweet words of his and his intentionally weak ingratiation
in Sima Yurao’s eyes, from start to finish, were nothing more than a clumsy performance.
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan suddenly felt that he was like a thorough clown.

Yang Fan and Lu Wan were sitting on the balcony, drinking afternoon tea.
At that moment, the intelligent lifeform walked up the stairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: Matters Have Priorities
paragraphs: “Bastard! It’s all because of you!”
Ma Huainan suddenly raised his head and fiercely glanced in the direction of the Lu Family Villa.
“Yang Fan, as long as you give me time...”
“I will definitely get rid of you, this poisonous snake!”
After saying that, he turned and left.
On the other side.
After returning to the villa,
Sima Yurao dialed Sima Zhao’s video communication at the first instance.
Soon, Sima Zhao’s projection appeared.
“Brother, I didn’t see anyone.”
“However, the matter of the divorce has been handled well.”
Sima Zhao’s brows slightly furrowed, “The other party didn’t see you?”
“Mm.”
Sima Yurao nodded.
“And her attitude was extremely tough. Clearly she was in the villa, but she purposely let the smart robot tell us that no one was home.”
Speaking of this, she helplessly let out a sigh.
Sima Zhao was silent for a moment, then said:
“This Miss Lu... I have actually heard of her.”
“Although her Divine Kingdom Talent is only S-grade, her status in the Lu Clan is completely cultivated according to the level of a Peerless Prodigy.”
“In the future, she is very likely to become an important controller of the Lu Clan’s business system.”
“Such a person... why would she act so extremely?”
Sima Zhao was somewhat puzzled.
“According to normal circumstances, wouldn’t it be the best result for both sides to take a step back now?”
Sima Yurao shook her head.
“I don’t know either, it’s not like we’re investigating her Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“I really don’t know what this Miss Lu is thinking.”
She paused for a moment.
“Just now on the way, the intelligent lifeform sent word.”
“That investigation company under her has already prepared to file a lawsuit with the Federation Supreme Court.”
“Even if the company goes bankrupt in the end, she doesn’t plan to compromise.”
“I really don’t understand.”
After hearing this, Sima Zhao suddenly burst into laughter.
“Hehe, it seems... this Yang Fan really has some skills.”
Sima Yurao was stunned, “Brother, what do you mean?”
A trace of understanding flashed in Sima Zhao’s eyes.
“What else could it mean, this Miss Lu is probably truly falling in love.”
“Otherwise, she wouldn’t go to this extent.”
“Everyone belongs to the Five Great Families. Even if conflicts occur on ordinary days, they are all controlled within a certain range.”
“A situation like hers and Gu Le completely not getting face from each other...”
“Is indeed very rare.”
A trace of worry appeared on Sima Yurao’s face.
“Brother, what should we do now?”
“They won’t really deduce my Divine Kingdom coordinates, will they?”
Sima Zhao shook her head.
“Don’t worry too much. If they really want revenge, the target is most likely your ex-husband.”
“After all, your father is the head of the Sima Family, and Lu Wan and Gu Le are both people from the Five Great Families; they know the rules.”
Hearing this, Sima Yurao’s expression eased slightly.
Then she couldn’t help gritting her teeth.
“It’s all Ma Huainan’s fault, this trash.”
“Big Brother, you were right.”
“Just when we separated, I could clearly feel...”
“This fellow probably even hates me by now.”
Thinking of this, Sima Yurao’s expression became even uglier.
“I really hope they can directly help solve this trouble.”
Sima Zhao pondered for a moment and said,

“At most, they will just deduce his Divine Kingdom coordinates, and then arrange some Tier 3 Gods to put pressure on him, forcing Ma Huainan to actively disclose his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family.”
“After all, the other party possesses an SS-grade Divine Kingdom Talent, and the Sima Family has invested a huge amount of Resources into him.”
“The Clan will not easily give up such a Genius.”
“As for Yang Fan and the others...”
Sima Zhao shook her head.
“They shouldn’t really expend a huge price to seize Ma Huainan’s divine core.”
“The cost is too high, and the risk is too great; it’s not worth it.”
“Alright, you should participate in a few more wars on the frontline now to try to make up for this loss.”
“Having lost the All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical channel, your future Divine Kingdom development plan will probably have to be postponed for a bit.”
Sima Yurao nodded.
Afterwards, Sima Zhao hung up the communication.
At the same time.
Inside Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom,
at this moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness was currently in the core area of the Mechanical Civilization.
Here was the entire Divine Kingdom’s most massive intelligent computing center, with countless Mechanical buildings standing tall within the steel giant city.
A large number of high-tier intelligent lifeform shuttled through it continuously.
And atop a huge metal platform in the central area,
densely packed divine kingdom deduction cards piled together, looking from afar like a small mountain.

Countless fourth-tier intelligent lifeform were constantly taking out the divine kingdom deduction cards, then inputting the information on the electronic boards one by one, beginning to try to deduce the target Divine Kingdom coordinates.
Ma Huainan and Sima Yurao’s coordinates were being deduced at the same time.
“Deduction failed.”
“Deduction failed.”
“Deduction failed.”
The prompt tones of the intelligent lifeform kept ringing.
Card after card of divine kingdom deduction cards decreased rapidly, like consumables on an assembly line.
Within a short span of time, hundreds and thousands of divine kingdom deduction cards had been completely consumed.
“Master, currently in order to purchase divine kingdom deduction cards, five trillion Divinity Points have already been consumed,” Yang Da reported.
After hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression did not change in the slightest.
“Continue buying. If five trillion is not enough, then fifty trillion.”
“If still not enough... then five hundred trillion.”
“It’s nothing more than Divinity Points after all.”
Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
“As long as I can absorb Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom Core, I can obtain an S-grade Divine Kingdom Talent.”
“All investments are worth it.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da responded.
divine kingdom deduction cards themselves were not considered scarce Resources.
Especially in the frontline area, where a large number of gods every day determined the coordinates of Foreign Deitys through divine kingdom deduction cards.
Therefore, the trading volume of divine kingdom deduction cards on the frontline was extremely massive.
The smart robots arranged by Yang Da were scattered across various shops to make purchases, and would not attract any attention.
After all, the trading mode of the frontline was completely different from the outside world.
Transactions here were not completed directly through the virtual Divine Shop.
Instead, smart robots went to various shops to directly extract the corresponding materials from the shop owners’ divine kingdoms.
Throughout the entire process, the shop owners did not know who the trading object was.
The degree of confidentiality was far higher than the virtual Divine Shop.
As for Yang Fan’s current purchase volume, although it looked very astonishing,
placed in the entire the frontline area, it was only a small part and wouldn’t attract attention at all.
“Yes, Master.”
“I will arrange more intelligent lifeform to participate in the deduction.”
“I believe we will get results very soon.”
Yang Da assured.
Yang Fan nodded.
“Very good. Once the coordinates are deduced, notify me at the first instance.”
“For a poisonous snake, the faster it is resolved, the better.”
“Yes.”
Yang Da responded.
Afterwards, as if thinking of something, he continued to report:
“Reporting to Master, there is one more matter.”
“Just now, through the Alien Divine Kingdom Core sent by Li Tianheng, we successfully deduced the coordinates of a Black Armored Beetle Race god.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up.
“Good thing, record the coordinates first.”
“After dealing with Ma Huainan, we will consider the invasion.”
“Matters have priorities.”

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Even More Terrifying Than Expected
paragraphs: The Black Armored Beetle Race, Yang Fan naturally had some impression of them.
When he was a demigod, he had once absorbed the core of a demigod from that race.
Unexpectedly, on the frontline, he deduced the coordinates of a Black Armored Beetle Race god once more; what a coincidence.
However, matters like expanding the area of the divine kingdom were not something to be rushed.
Since the coordinates were already mastered, they could act at any time.
The most important thing now was still to deal with Ma Huainan, the venomous snake hidden in the dark.
In the Real World, another ten days passed.
During these ten days, a large number of divine kingdom deduction cards were sent into Yang Fan’s divine kingdom every day.
And now, in order to deduce the divine kingdom coordinates of Ma Huainan and Sima Yurao.
Hundreds of thousands of fourth-rank intelligent lifeform forms were participating in it simultaneously, constantly repeating the same work.
Inputting information, consuming the deduction cards, and then waiting for the result.
Failing, and then continuing with the next deduction.
You must know, Yang Fan possessed the Evolution Talent.
One day in the outside world was a hundred years inside the divine kingdom.
By now, the divine kingdom deduction cards had already consumed a full thousand years’ worth of time.
For this, the Divinity Points Yang Fan invested were also close to thirty trillion.
But regarding this, Yang Fan still didn’t feel any anxiety.
What if the probability was low?
As long as the number of attempts was sufficient, there would always be a time of success.
If deducing coordinates was compared to buying a lottery ticket.
Then Yang Fan’s approach was very simple: while others bought one, he bought one hundred million.
Others gambled on probability, while he directly bought out all possibilities.
That morning, when Yang Fan was checking the condition of his divine kingdom,
he suddenly received a message from Han Jue: ‘The Secret Realm reclamation is over.’
With five gods cooperating, the efficiency was naturally far beyond what a single person could compare to.
In only about a month, this Earth-grade Secret Realm was completely developed and completed.
Soon, Yang Er also brought the army back to the divine kingdom.
Through the report, Yang Fan learned the specific gains of this Secret Realm reclamation, with a total value of about four hundred and sixty trillion Divinity Points.
Even for the direct descendants of the Five Great Families, this batch of Resources was a huge fortune.
But for the current Yang Fan... it was equivalent to just one or two months of divine kingdom income.
Therefore, he was not as excited as Sima Tianci.
However, in order to fit in, Yang Fan still gave plenty of face.
He agreed to Han Jue’s invitation to go to the Han Family’s villa in the Real World for a gathering.
At the banquet, everyone exchanged cups and toasted each other, and the atmosphere was very lively.
Han Jue raised his wine glass and said with a smile:
“In the future, we are all major shareholders of Star Group.”
“I, Han Jue, will propose a toast first.”
“In the future, whether in the development of the divine kingdom or industrial cooperation in reality, everyone is friends and brothers.”
“Let’s help each other and develop together!”
Hearing this, the rest of them also raised their glasses in response, all with smiles on their faces.
With this gain of four hundred and sixty trillion Divinity Points, Han Jue had practically led everyone to get a huge amount of Resources for free.
Naturally, they kept this favor in their hearts.
After three rounds of drinks, the atmosphere gradually became heated.
Sima Tianci suddenly leaned close to Yang Fan and whispered with a smile:
“Brother Yang, your methods are still high!”
“How long has it been?”
“My Sister Yurao has already divorced Ma Huainan.”
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, then smiled, “Moving so fast?”
With Sima Yurao suffering such a heavy loss, Yang Fan was not surprised that she and Ma Huainan divorced.
“Of course.”
Sima Tianci shook his head.
“Basically the younger generation of the Sima Family knows about it.”
“First, Sister Yurao was kicked out of the All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical board of directors, and then the news of their divorce spread.”
“Ma Huainan returned his shares, and both parties parted ways peacefully.”
There was a hint of emotion in Sima Tianci’s eyes.
At this moment, he was somewhat amazed by Yang Fan’s methods, or rather, his energy.
Yang Fan waved his hand and shamelessly said, “What ability could I have? It’s all because my wife is amazing.”
Sima Tianci was stunned for a moment, then couldn’t help laughing.
“Brother Yang, this is also a kind of ability. It would be great if I had luck like yours.”
“In the future, I estimate there is a high probability of a political marriage for me.”
“Wanting to find a wife who will go all out for oneself regardless of everything... I’m afraid that’s impossible.”
Sima Tianci was full of envy.
He was very satisfied with the result of this incident.
Sima Zhao’s lineage could be said to have suffered heavy losses.
Sima Yurao cut ties with Ma Huainan, a Genius with a different surname.
Not only that, the other party also lost her seat on the All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical board of directors.
More importantly.
On the surface, Sima Zhao’s lineage had offended the two Young Misses, Lu Wan and Gu Le.
Looking back at Sima Tianci, from beginning to end, he only revealed some information.
He both gave Yang Fan a favor and smoothly weakened a potential competitor.
No matter how one calculated it, it was a steady profit without any loss.
Thinking of this, Sima Tianci’s gaze towards Yang Fan grew a bit more complicated.
This brother... was even more terrifying than he had imagined.
After the gathering ended, Yang Fan and Lu Wan took a private spaceship and returned toward the direction of the villa.
The spaceship shuttled through the sky above the frontline, with countless streams of light flashing past outside the window.
Lu Wan leaned beside Yang Fan and said softly:
“Husband, without the relationship layer of Sima Yurao, the subsequent trouble will be much less.”
“Moreover, the current Ma Huainan can no longer continue to use the Sima Family’s network of connections to investigate you.”
“Next, we just need to handle it slowly.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded, and then asked with some curiosity, “If we resolve this person now, what trouble will there be?”
Lu Wan pondered for a moment, then explained seriously:
“If Ma Huainan’s death is confirmed, the only thing we will face is an investigation by the Federal Government.”
“After all, in the Real World, both sides’ investigative actions have already left traces.”
“Logically speaking, a motive for the crime does exist.”
“However...”
Lu Wan smiled.
“Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence only looks at the chain of evidence, and whether to finally convict requires going through a complete legal process.”
“These are matters at the level of legal rules.”
“By then, I will naturally find a way to resolve it.”
Yang Fan nodded.
Lu Wan continued:
“The most important thing now is to first deduce his divine kingdom coordinates.”
“And the truly difficult part is how to completely destroy his divine kingdom.”

“After all, Ma Huainan is a Peerless Prodigy. Once a Divine Kingdom War breaks out and he is driven to a desperate situation, he will definitely publicize his divine kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family.”
“By that time, the war will no longer be a simple war between two gods.”
“Instead, it will be a collision of Resources and values behind the scenes.”
Lu Wan’s eyes were serious.
“A Divine Kingdom War fights for believers, Resources, and financial strength.”
“Although Ma Huainan has good talent, after all, he is not a direct blood relative of some High-Order God.”
“The Sima Family will help him, but they will never spare no expense for his sake.”

“In the end, when the Sima Family’s intelligent lifeform judges that the cost of continued support has exceeded the value of protecting the Peerless Prodigy Ma Huainan himself... they will naturally choose to stop investing.”
Yang Fan listened carefully to Lu Wan’s popular science explanation, thoughtful.
The support of large families for gods is not unlimited; any action requires precise calculation.
The enemy’s strength, the consumption of war, and future returns—all of these will be evaluated by the Clan’s intelligent lifeform.

Unexpectedly, on the frontline, he deduced the coordinates of a Black Armored Beetle Race god once more; what a coincidence.

Failing, and then continuing with the next deduction.

One day in the outside world was a hundred years inside the divine kingdom.

For this, the Divinity Points Yang Fan invested were also close to thirty trillion.

As long as the number of attempts was sufficient, there would always be a time of success.

he suddenly received a message from Han Jue: ‘The Secret Realm reclamation is over.’

chapters.title: Chapter 438: Successful Deduction
paragraphs: “Of course, this standard isn’t absolute. If it were Sima Yurao, the Family Head’s daughter, the cost of support would naturally be higher.”
“After all, there is no such thing as absolute fairness in this world.”
Lu Wan said softly.
After listening, Yang Fan nodded slowly. “Understood.”
He looked out the window, a cold glint flashing in his deep eyes.
Seeing Yang Fan’s expression, Lu Wan gently took his hand.
“Hubby, don’t worry.”
“I have already asked two Tier 3 Mechanical gods to help with the deduction. We will definitely get results within two years.”
Yang Fan was slightly taken aback. “Two years?”
Lu Wan nodded.
“That’s already very fast.”
“And that’s without considering the consumption of Resources.”
“In this world, grudges between many gods can last for hundreds or even thousands of years.”
“Some gods work to earn Resources while purchasing divine kingdom deduction cards just to locate their mortal enemies’ coordinates.”
“There are plenty of people who dedicate centuries or millennia of deduction just to find the other party’s divine kingdom coordinates.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was somewhat speechless.
Spending hundreds or thousands of years just to deduce the coordinates of someone’s divine kingdom—how deep could a grudge possibly be?
The airship slowly descended outside Lu Family Villa.
The hatch opened, and Yang Fan and Lu Wan walked down together.
However, after taking only a few steps, Yang Fan’s figure suddenly paused.
Lu Wan noticed the anomaly and turned to look at him. “What’s wrong, Hubby?”
Yang Fan snapped back to his senses, the corners of his mouth curving slightly upward. “The divine kingdom’s intelligent lifeform just sent some good news.”
Hearing this, a hint of curiosity flickered in Lu Wan’s eyes.
However, she did not pry further, merely saying gently:
“Hubby, go ahead and attend to it. Developing your divine kingdom is the most important thing.”
“As for Ma Huainan’s side, I’ll continue handling it for you.”
“There’s no need for you to waste too much time and energy on this matter.”
Yang Fan was slightly surprised. “Aren’t you curious?”
Lu Wan smiled.
“Between husband and wife, there must be boundaries.”
“Information about one’s divine kingdom is inherently a god’s most core secret.”
“Even though we are married, it doesn’t mean I need to control everything about you.”
“Prying into every single detail isn’t care; it’s restraint.”
She looked at Yang Fan and said earnestly:
“A truly lasting relationship isn’t about having zero secrets from each other.”
“Rather, it’s about supporting each other on a foundation of mutual trust.”
“In reality, we can manage Resources together and help each other grow.”
“But the divine kingdom is a unique Dao belonging exclusively to each god.”
“So even divine parents who have lived together for tens of thousands or even millions of years might not necessarily know the specific coordinates of each other’s divine kingdoms.”
“Because they respect each other’s independence.”
Lu Wan continued softly:
“Only those Divine Beings with lifespans of merely a few centuries like to share their coordinates after becoming partners to showcase their love and reckless devotion.”
“Their believers farm, gather herbs, and mine together because efficiency and basic survival matter most to them.”
“But gods are different; our lifespans are infinite.”
“There are countless epochs ahead.”
“A truly mature relationship isn’t about trying to possess the other person.”
“It’s about helping each other become better versions of ourselves across the endless passage of time.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but chuckle. “Wan’er, saying all this doesn’t make you sound like a woman in her twenties at all.”
Lu Wan rolled her eyes at him playfully. “Then what does Hubby think I sound like?”
“Like an ancient god who has lived for tens of thousands of years,” Yang Fan teased.
“You’re awful.”
Yang Fan returned to his room, his consciousness instantly entering his divine kingdom.
As soon as he appeared, Yang Da’s voice came over.
“Master, the coordinates of Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom have been successfully deduced.”
Hearing this, a cold glint flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
Finally... found it.
After all, in order to deduce the coordinates,
an entire area had been specially cleared out in the core region of the Mechanical Civilization.
A massive number of Tier 4 intelligent lifeform queued up, performing repeated calculations non-stop.
Under a hundredfold time flow, the number of trial-and-error attempts had long reached a terrifying figure.
This level of efficiency was far beyond what the two Mechanical gods arranged by Lu Wan could compare to.
“Very good.” Yang Fan nodded.
“Master,”
Yang Da continued asking, “Should we continue deducing Sima Yurao’s divine kingdom coordinates?”
Yang Fan pondered for a moment before replying:
“Continue. Since we have already investigated her information, we naturally can’t let it go to waste.”
Although Sima Yurao’s divine kingdom talent wasn’t as great as Ma Huainan’s, she had been a god for centuries after all.
With so many years of development and accumulation, the foundation of her divine kingdom was by no means comparable to Ma Huainan, who had only recently achieved breakthrough into godhood.
More importantly, she had an extraordinary background.
Therefore, although Yang Fan chose to continue deducing her divine kingdom coordinates,
he had no intention of making a move in the short term.
It wouldn’t be too late to harvest her once he achieved breakthrough to higher tiers in the future and had sufficient confidence.
After all, to Yang Fan, a Human race Divine Kingdom Core was far more precious than an alien one.
The only downside was that the deduction cost was too high.
But now, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom already possessed nearly five hundred thousand S-rank resource-type buildings.
Combined with a thousandfold return,
these expenditures were practically negligible to him.
First know where the meat is; as for when to eat it, that would be his own choice.
“Understood, Master,” Yang Da replied.
Yang Fan then continued issuing orders:
“I’ll give you fifty years of divine kingdom time. Begin war preparations immediately.”
“War buildings, single-use war supplies, logistical Resources, Smart Weapons—prepare all of them.”
“You, Yang Yi, and Yang Eleven will be jointly responsible for this matter.”
“Once I wake up from my sleep, begin the invasion of Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom.”
Hearing this, a gleam of excitement flashed in Yang Da’s eyes.
“Yes, Master!”
“I guarantee everything will be arranged properly!”
Fifty years of divine kingdom time was more than enough for intelligent lifeform to arrange, even if the amount of war materials for this battle was enormous.
Withdrawing his consciousness from the divine kingdom,
Yang Fan returned to reality and changed into loose pajamas.
He then went to the spa room below the villa, closed his eyes, and quietly enjoyed himself.
Three smart robots precisely controlled their pressure at the same time and began a professional massage.
Meanwhile.
the frontline, Sima Family villa area.
In a villa that had been vacant for a long time, numerous smart robots were busy at this moment.
Moving furniture, tidying rooms, and cleaning up the environment.
In a second-floor room, Ma Huainan’s consciousness was also inside his own divine kingdom.
But in reality, his physical body clenched its fists tightly.
“Master, currently your largest source of income is the military merit subsidy obtained from the frontline.”
“Besides that, divine kingdom investments yield an income of approximately two thousand Divinity Points per month.”
“The Sima Family’s Resource subsidies have already stopped.”
“The company shares have also been returned, so the dividend income previously received each quarter is no longer available.”
“Currently, the development speed of your divine kingdom has dropped to only twenty percent of what it used to be.”
The highest intelligent lifeform of the divine kingdom reported, a hint of worry even present in its Mechanical voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 439: Hundred-Billion Scale
paragraphs: Right now, Ma Huainan had just achieved a breakthrough as a god not long ago, and his Divine Kingdom was currently in a stage of rapid development.
The number of his believers was growing rapidly.
He needed to purchase a massive amount of Resources from the outside world.
Food, city buildings, Cultivation sites, Cultivation Resources... all of these required continuous investment.
More importantly, after the area of his Divine Kingdom suddenly expanded, a large amount of open land needed to be replanned.
Planting high-value Spirit Plants, cultivating special life forms, and purchasing Resource buildings for long-term investment.
And all of this was inseparable from Divinity Points.
The more abundant the Divinity Points were, the faster the Divine Kingdom would develop, and the higher the future returns would be.
But now, all of this had experienced a severe decline in development speed due to the breakdown of his marriage.
“This is news I obtained through the internal channels of the Sima Family. In the next few centuries, the frontline is highly likely to erupt into a medium-scale conflict.”
“Many companies have already begun purchasing various healing Resources in advance, and market demand will only grow larger.”

“Now, I’ll sell off all those stable, low-yield assets deployed previously, and then arrange one hundred million tiered believers who haven’t undergone Awakening of the Martial God Body to be responsible for Planting Resources.”
“Without a wealthy sugar mommy, I’ll rely on myself to forge ahead!”
Fighting spirit reignited in Ma Huainan’s eyes.
“I, Ma Huainan, am an SS-Rank Martial God Body and a Peerless Prodigy recognized by the Human Federation. I will never fade into obscurity like this.”
“Divorce is fine too; at least I also obtained a generous breakup fee.”
“When I become a High-Order God in the future, I’ll have plenty of chances to find a better one!”
Hearing this, the intelligent lifeform of his Divine Kingdom immediately echoed, “Master will definitely succeed.”
Early the next morning.
Yang Fan slowly woke up from the hydrotherapy area and stretched, feeling incomparably comfortable all over his body.
Given his current strength, even going without sleep for several months wouldn’t have any effect on him.
But enjoying it occasionally also made him feel very relaxed.
After washing up, Yang Fan came to the living room.
At this moment, the intelligent robot had long since prepared breakfast, and Lu Wan was sitting there waiting for him just like usual.
“Wan’er, don’t work so hard lately.”
Yang Fan walked over, reached out to pinch Lu Wan’s tender white cheeks, and said gently,
“Since Ma Huainan no longer has the ability to continue investigating me, we can completely take our time.”
“During this period of time because of my matters, you have noticeably grown much more haggard.”
Hearing this, a trace of a smile flashed in Lu Wan’s eyes.
“I know, Husband.”
As she spoke, she took out an exquisite jade box from the side.
“This is the Blood Dragon Fish I plucked from my mother.”
“I heard that the survival rate of this kind of fish is extremely low, and to truly mature, it takes at least ten thousand years.”
“Husband, taste it and see how the flavor is?”
Finished speaking, Lu Wan picked up a piece of bright red fish meat and placed it into Yang Fan’s bowl.
Afterwards, she picked up the ground Heaven-Rank Spirit Plant powder from the side and gently sprinkled a little bit on top.
“And this.”
Lu Wan took out another crystal-clear Medicinal Pill.
“This is a Clear Spirit Pill.”
“The energy contained within the Blood Dragon Fish is far too immense and difficult to digest. Pairing it with this Medicinal Pill as a supplement is the best approach.”
Yang Fan didn’t stand on ceremony either, directly placing that piece of Blood Dragon Fish into his mouth.
The next instant, an incomparably pure wave of energy instantly spread out.
It was as if a warm current coursed through his entire body, nourishing his divine body.
Following that, the so-called Clear Spirit Pill was also casually tossed into his mouth by Yang Fan like candy.
Yang Fan carefully sensed it for a moment, then nodded, “The taste is not bad.”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan’s eyes instantly lit up.
“It’s good as long as Husband likes it.”
“Then I’ll go ask my mom for tens of thousands of jin later. From now on, whenever Husband wants to eat it, you can eat it.”
Yang Fan had just taken a sip of tea and almost couldn’t help choking on it.
“Cough, cough...”
“Wan’er, fleece her a little less, I’m getting embarrassed.”
Lu Wan blinked, wearing an innocent expression.
“How can this be called fleecing?”
“My mother can’t finish using it anyway; only in my hands can it truly display its value.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was instantly left speechless between laughter and tears.
He truly admired the direct descendants of these major families now.
Gu Le was like this, and Lu Wan was the same.
At every turn, they would ask their Clan elders for Resources, shares, and all kinds of precious items.
Even for a single breakfast, they could find a way to get top-tier ingredients from their elders.
However, Yang Fan had to admit that ever since he got together with Lu Wan, his quality of life had indeed undergone earth-shaking changes.
In the past, although his Divine Kingdom was rich in Resources, the things he ate daily were mostly pre-made products mass-produced through the Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub.
Although these foods contained a massive amount of energy, compared to the things enjoyed by a noble daughter of a major Clan like Lu Wan, they were completely on two different levels.
In Lu Wan’s view, those foods produced by Divine Kingdom buildings were essentially Resources that existed to elevate the strength of believers.
A true god should naturally enjoy those precious spiritual objects nurtured by heaven and earth.
Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh with emotion that a person’s life trajectory truly changed because of the people around them.
The importance of a significant other far exceeded imagination.
An outstanding partner was not just companionship, but could also allow you to see a world you had never touched before.
For ordinary people, many things might never be known in a lifetime.
Therefore, boys needed to constantly grow and learn to choose partners upward.
It wasn’t to attach oneself to anyone, but to make oneself qualified to touch a broader world.
Otherwise, even with boundless potential, one might forever remain trapped within one’s own cognition.
Breakfast ended.
Lu Wan went to the second floor of the villa to handle her work, while Yang Fan came to the entertainment area on the first floor of the villa.
He lay on the soft massage sofa, enjoying the professional massage of the intelligent robot.
However, Yang Fan’s consciousness had already entered his own Divine Kingdom.
The moment he appeared, he cast his gaze toward the Eternal Corpse Mine.
The scene before his eyes made him couldn’t help but nod.
Today’s Eternal Corpse Mine was already different from last night.
Looking as far as the eye could see, rows of Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers were neatly arranged, resembling a dense forest.
These A-Rank War Structures were massive in size, their four legs supporting a huge square space inside which a massive army of zombies was stored.
Loaded in the front row of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers were those ordinary zombies that had just been infected and had not yet given birth to spiritual wisdom.
Dense piles of zombies were stacked within, almost filling the entire space.
For warfare, they were the cheapest and most easily consumable cannon fodder, and their purpose was to infect the enemy.
In the middle area were neatly arranged rows of Zombie Generals.
These zombies that had already reached the Qi Refining Realm had even larger bodies, and their aura far surpassed ordinary zombies.
They stood quietly inside the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, waiting for the moment the war began.
As for the further rear areas, they were all Zombie Kings.
These Zombie Kings already possessed considerable intelligence and were the backbone of the entire zombie army.
Those White Zombie believers did not enter the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
They were still sitting cross-legged inside the Eternal Corpse Mine, continuously absorbing thick corpse qi and condensing corpse pills.
Even though the war was about to begin, they were still earnestly producing.
Right now, the number of zombie believers who had prepared for war reached a scale of one hundred billion.

sentences.text: Right now, Ma Huainan had just achieved a breakthrough as a god not long ago, and his Divine Kingdom was currently in a stage of rapid development.
The number of his believers was growing rapidly.
He needed to purchase a massive amount of Resources from the outside world.
Food, city buildings, Cultivation sites, Cultivation Resources... all of these required continuous investment.
More importantly, after the area of his Divine Kingdom suddenly expanded, a large amount of open land needed to be replanned.
Planting high-value Spirit Plants, cultivating special life forms, and purchasing Resource buildings for long-term investment.
And all of this was inseparable from Divinity Points.
The more abundant the Divinity Points were, the faster the Divine Kingdom would develop, and the higher the future returns would be.
But now, all of this had experienced a severe decline in development speed due to the breakdown of his marriage.
“This is news I obtained through the internal channels of the Sima Family.
In the next few centuries, the frontline is highly likely to erupt into a medium-scale conflict.”
“Many companies have already begun purchasing various healing Resources in advance, and market demand will only grow larger.”

“Now, I’ll sell off all those stable, low-yield assets deployed previously, and then arrange one hundred million tiered believers who haven’t undergone Awakening of the Martial God Body to be responsible for Planting Resources.”
“Without a wealthy sugar mommy, I’ll rely on myself to forge ahead!”
Fighting spirit reignited in Ma Huainan’s eyes.
“I, Ma Huainan, am an SS-Rank Martial God Body and a Peerless Prodigy recognized by the Human Federation.
I will never fade into obscurity like this.”
“Divorce is fine too; at least I also obtained a generous breakup fee.”
“When I become a High-Order God in the future, I’ll have plenty of chances to find a better one!”
Hearing this, the intelligent lifeform of his Divine Kingdom immediately echoed, “Master will definitely succeed.”
Early the next morning.
Yang Fan slowly woke up from the hydrotherapy area and stretched, feeling incomparably comfortable all over his body.
Given his current strength, even going without sleep for several months wouldn’t have any effect on him.
But enjoying it occasionally also made him feel very relaxed.
After washing up, Yang Fan came to the living room.
At this moment, the intelligent robot had long since prepared breakfast, and Lu Wan was sitting there waiting for him just like usual.
“Wan’er, don’t work so hard lately.”
Yang Fan walked over, reached out to pinch Lu Wan’s tender white cheeks, and said gently,
“Since Ma Huainan no longer has the ability to continue investigating me, we can completely take our time.”
“During this period of time because of my matters, you have noticeably grown much more haggard.”
Hearing this, a trace of a smile flashed in Lu Wan’s eyes.
“I know, Husband.”
As she spoke, she took out an exquisite jade box from the side.
“This is the Blood Dragon Fish I plucked from my mother.”
“I heard that the survival rate of this kind of fish is extremely low, and to truly mature, it takes at least ten thousand years.”
“Husband, taste it and see how the flavor is?”
Finished speaking, Lu Wan picked up a piece of bright red fish meat and placed it into Yang Fan’s bowl.
Afterwards, she picked up the ground Heaven-Rank Spirit Plant powder from the side and gently sprinkled a little bit on top.
“And this.”
Lu Wan took out another crystal-clear Medicinal Pill.
“This is a Clear Spirit Pill.”
“The energy contained within the Blood Dragon Fish is far too immense and difficult to digest.
Pairing it with this Medicinal Pill as a supplement is the best approach.”
Yang Fan didn’t stand on ceremony either, directly placing that piece of Blood Dragon Fish into his mouth.
The next instant, an incomparably pure wave of energy instantly spread out.
It was as if a warm current coursed through his entire body, nourishing his divine body.
Following that, the so-called Clear Spirit Pill was also casually tossed into his mouth by Yang Fan like candy.
Yang Fan carefully sensed it for a moment, then nodded, “The taste is not bad.”
Hearing these words, Lu Wan’s eyes instantly lit up.
“It’s good as long as Husband likes it.”
“Then I’ll go ask my mom for tens of thousands of jin later.
From now on, whenever Husband wants to eat it, you can eat it.”
Yang Fan had just taken a sip of tea and almost couldn’t help choking on it.
“Cough, cough...”
“Wan’er, fleece her a little less, I’m getting embarrassed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 440: Sister Is Also Afraid of Trouble
paragraphs: Besides these zombie armies, a large number of intelligent lifeform were also gathered here.
However, compared to the zombie armies preparing for war, their responsibilities were much simpler.
Transporting supplies, organizing inventory, checking equipment.
Crates of corpse pill were stored by category, and a large number of Smart Weapon were neatly arranged.
Various poison-attribute Medicinal Pill produced from the Alchemy Spirit World were also transported to designated areas.
In addition, there were the disposable war supplies that Yang Fan had purchased from various shops on the frontline over the years.
Various explosive talismans, poison gas bombs, corrosive weapons, energy annihilation devices... all piled up according to category.
A large amount of storage equipment was stacked together, almost forming a mountain.
Just waiting for Yang Fan’s order, this army would be able to enter Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom directly from the Eternal Corpse Mine via a spatial channel.
“Master, everything is ready.”
Two figures appeared in front of Yang Fan.
Besides Yang Da, Yang Eleven also followed behind, bowing respectfully.
As the supreme military commander of the entire Zombie Kingdom, this war to invade Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom would naturally be personally led by Yang Eleven.
At this moment, although Yang Eleven’s expression remained calm, the excitement in his eyes could not be hidden.
Last time, when facing the Angel Race gods, although they achieved victory, the entire process made him feel incredibly stifled.
The Angel Race possessed extremely strong resistance to the zombie virus, so many methods could not exert their intended effects at all.
But the Human race was different; those human believers had significantly weaker resistance to the zombie virus.
After thousands of years of development, the Zombie Kingdom had now perfected its war system.
Yang Eleven was filled with anticipation.
In this battle, he must fight a beautiful victory for his Master to prove his worth.
“Yang Eleven.” Yang Fan looked at him.
“Subordinate is here!”
Yang Eleven immediately stepped forward and gave a standard military salute.
“This battle does not require a quick resolution.”
Yang Fan spoke slowly.
“Advance as a whole, and you must proceed steadily and surely.”
“The forces entering the opponent’s Divine Kingdom at the beginning will not be too many.”
“Remember, my goal is not to quickly invade the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.”
“What I want is to eliminate as much of the opponent’s vital strength as possible.”
“The more his believers suffer losses, and the more severely his Divine Kingdom environment is destroyed, the better.”
After all, Ma Huainan was an owner of an SS-grade Divine Kingdom Talent.
Even though he had divorced Sima Yurao, the Sima Family would never easily give up on such a Peerless Prodigy.
Once the war reached the Divine Kingdom Core area, Ma Huainan would inevitably reveal his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family.
Therefore, the true victory or defeat of this war did not lie in who was stronger between Yang Fan and Ma Huainan.
But rather, in whether the Sima Family was willing to continue their support.
In this world, everything has value.
The support of a big Clan is the same.
What Yang Fan needed to do was to continuously lower Ma Huainan’s value.
Eliminate his believers in large numbers, destroy his Divine Kingdom buildings, and ruin his Divine Kingdom environment.
Yang Fan did not care about ordinary Resources at all.
His goal from beginning to end was only one—the Divine Kingdom Core.
Once the Sima Family judged that the cost of continuing to support Ma Huainan exceeded his value, this war would naturally end.
As for how much a Peerless Prodigy was worth, Yang Fan did not know.
But he knew that he could lower this price.
“Yes!”
Yang Eleven’s voice was loud and clear.
“Subordinate guarantees to complete the mission!”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Go.”
“This battle may last for a long time.”
“After the war ends, I will prepare enough Mechanical Heart for you to help you upgrade.”
Hearing this, a trace of joy flashed in Yang Eleven’s eyes, “Thank you for your cultivation, Master!”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
The next moment.
Yang Eleven turned and looked at the vast zombie army in the distance.
His figure flashed, and he instantly arrived atop one of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
“Array No. 1, one hundred thousand units!”
“Array No. 2, fifty thousand units!”
“Array No. 3, ten thousand units!”
“As the vanguard, set out immediately!”
The moment the order was given.
The entire Zombie Kingdom began to operate.
Inside each ten thousand corpse military tomb, countless zombies opened their eyes.
Subsequently, the Divine Kingdom space vibrated slightly.
A spatial channel slowly opened.
Under Yang Fan’s gaze, only a small portion of the zombie army began to teleport, leaving the Eternal Corpse Mine.
And his gaze, through these believers, also saw the situation in Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom clearly.
On the other side, at this moment, Ma Huainan’s consciousness was in a high-spec conference hall within the Virtual World.
The entire conference hall was luxuriously decorated, with a large number of intelligent devices floating all around.
And sitting opposite him was a woman wearing a black suit.
If Yang Fan were here, he would definitely be able to recognize this person.
It was precisely Qin Xue, who had lent him 30 trillion Divinity Points back then.
“Sister Qin Xue, can the loan limit be increased a bit more?”
“I can provide collateral.”
Ma Huainan’s tone carried a hint of restraint.
The current him no longer had the high spirits he possessed when he first became a god.
Divine Kingdom development required Resources; even cultivating Spirit Herb and building Planting infrastructure required a large initial investment.
Not to mention training believers and letting them learn various production, breeding, and Planting techniques.
These were all money-burning projects.
Qin Xue heard this and sighed softly.
“Little Brother Huainan, you also know that my authority is limited.”
“Being able to lend you 10 trillion Divinity Points back then was already the limit.”
“That was only because of your relationship with Young Miss Sima.”
“Now that the two of you have...”
Qin Xue did not continue, but the meaning was already very clear.
“Now, among the high-level intelligent lifeform in my company, your risk rating has already triggered a red light.”
Ma Huainan’s expression sank slightly.
“I can take a War God Codex as collateral!”
“I only need you to lend me another 100 million Divinity Points!”
When he spoke, his tone was already somewhat urgent.
A War God Codex was of immense value.
If it were in the past, he would never have considered using such Resources as collateral.
But now it was different; his Divine Kingdom had just achieved a breakthrough in the god Realm and was in a period of rapid development.
Without funds, it meant that the speed of development would be severely slowed down.
Qin Xue shook her head.
“Little Brother Huainan, you should know that several important shareholders in my company are from the Gu Family.”
“The conflict between you and Yang Fan is no longer a secret.”
“If I continue to cooperate with you now, once Young Miss Gu Le finds out...”
“Sister is also afraid of trouble.”
The matter of Gu Le forcefully kicking Sima Yurao out of the All-Spirit Bio-Pharmaceutical board of directors had caused quite a stir in the entire business circle.
After all, that was a giant enterprise listed on the main board of the Human Federation.
A Young Miss of the Gu Family, for the sake of her husband, directly used business means to purge the other party’s Clan members.
Such matters were naturally listed by major enterprises as key risk control case studies.
And Ma Huainan, because of this, had become a high-risk individual for many companies.
Now, wanting to raise funds was incomparably more difficult than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 441: Saving Every Penny
paragraphs: Hearing this, Ma Huainan took a deep breath.
He suppressed the anger in his heart, then gritted his teeth and said: “Two War God Codexes.”
“I can give a 40% annual interest rate.”
Upon hearing this, a glimmer of light flashed in Qin Xue’s eyes.
“Since little brother Huainan has said as much,”
“it would indeed be heartless of me not to help.”
Qin Xue said with a smile.
Then, she snapped her fingers, and two virtual contracts instantly appeared before them.
Ma Huainan did not hesitate and immediately had the intelligent lifeform scan the contract content.
After confirming there were no issues, he quickly signed his name.
The contract was established.
The smile on Qin Xue’s face became even brighter.
“By the way, our company’s reception room has a partnership with Heavenly Fragrance Club.”
“You are our big client, would you like to go over and relax?”
Qin Xue showed a meaningful smile.
“I imagine little brother has been through a lot lately, it’s time to properly relax.”
Hearing this, a flash of temptation crossed Ma Huainan’s eyes.
However, the next moment, his pupils suddenly contracted slightly.
“No need, I still have some matters to attend to.”
“I will come to bother Sister Qin Xue again next time.”
After saying this, Ma Huainan did not hesitate at all and exited the Virtual World directly.
Watching Ma Huainan suddenly disappear, a trace of surprise appeared on Qin Xue’s face.
“Strange... this kid surnamed Ma, he didn’t take advantage today?”
“Could it be that he was really stimulated and is preparing to work hard and become an ascetic?”
Qin Xue shook her head.
However, her gaze quickly fell on the contract on the table, and the smile on her face deepened once more.
“Without the support of Sima Yurao’s branch, he will likely be in a state of severe capital shortage for the next few hundred years.”
“This is a long-term investment.”
“I just don’t know how many times it will multiply in the future.”
After returning to the Real World.
Ma Huainan did not delay at all and his consciousness instantly entered his Divine Kingdom.
As soon as he appeared, the notification sound from the highest-ranking intelligent lifeform of the Divine Kingdom immediately rang out.
“Master, an intrusion target has been detected.”
“The opponent belongs to the Human race gods, and they are following the Corpse Cultivator path.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan frowned slightly.
As a god, his consciousness instantly covered the entire Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, he sensed the situation on the periphery of the Divine Kingdom.
A moment later, Ma Huainan’s tightly furrowed brows gradually relaxed.
“Fortunately, I was overthinking.”
“In such a short time, even if the information Yang Fan investigated is detailed, it is impossible for him to deduce my Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“It should just be an ordinary, unknown god.”
Ma Huainan breathed a long sigh of relief.
There is not only one way to obtain Divine Kingdom coordinates, which is the divine kingdom deduction card.
There is also a more primitive way, which is to dispatch believers above the Qi Refining Realm to explore the vast and boundless Divine Kingdom world.
The Divine Kingdom world is simply too vast; sending believers out to travel and search for other gods’ Divine Kingdoms and various Secret Realms is essentially like buying a lottery ticket.
Perhaps there will be no harvest for countless years.
But it is also possible to have heaven-defying luck and actually discover the Divine Kingdom coordinates of an unknown god.
Once successful, that is a massive fated opportunity.
At this moment, Ma Huainan regarded Yang Fan’s zombie believers as this type of situation.
After all, in his view, it was impossible for Yang Fan to deduce his Divine Kingdom coordinates so quickly, and the opponent was not following the unpopular path of a Corpse Cultivator.
The zombie believers before him were most likely just an ordinary god following the Corpse Cultivator path who had accidentally discovered his Divine Kingdom.
Although Ma Huainan had just achieved a breakthrough to become a god, he was, after all, an SS-Rank Divine Kingdom Talent holder.
His believers’ combat power far exceeded those of the same Realm.
He was a Peerless Prodigy who graduated from the Primordial Academy, and within his Divine Kingdom, he possessed many S-Rank Buildings.
How could such a foundation be compared to those ordinary Rogue Cultivator gods in the outside world?
“Go, have the war-type intelligent lifeform lead 50 million Martial Disciple Realm believers to advance toward the periphery of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Wipe out all intruders.”
Ma Huainan said indifferently.
“Yes, Master!”
The intelligent lifeform immediately executed the order.
Subsequently, Ma Huainan continued to arrange:
“The 1 trillion Divinity Points just obtained from the loan.”
“A portion will be used to purchase Spirit Plant seeds.”
“Arrange for a batch of believers to enter the Primordial Academy to learn relevant Planting and cultivation knowledge.”
“The remaining funds will be used to find suitable Divine Kingdom investment projects, focusing on short-term returns.”
“The most important thing now is to ensure the liquidity of the Divine Kingdom’s funds; once the fields are reclaimed, a large amount of capital investment will be needed.”
The intelligent lifeform was silent for a moment, then reminded him:
“Master, the current combat power of the enemy god is unknown.”
“Is it necessary to reserve some funds to deal with potential war risks?”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan couldn’t help but laugh.
“War risks?”
“Just a mere Rogue Cultivator god.”
“After my breakthrough to become a god, the Sima Family gave me two S-rank war building, so there is no need to worry about this threat.”
“What I lack most now are Resources, Divinity Points.”
“What I need to do is develop the Divine Kingdom as quickly as possible, not leave funds idle on this stress-free war.”
Speaking of this, a sneer appeared on the corner of Ma Huainan’s mouth.
“After getting the coordinates of this Corpse Cultivator god, there is no need to invade the opponent.”
“War consumes too many Resources.”
“At that time, I will just sell the coordinates to an alien race in exchange for some working capital.”
In his eyes, the zombie believers on the periphery were not enemies at all, but a fortune about to arrive.
“Yes, Master.”
The intelligent lifeform responded.
After arranging everything, Ma Huainan took a look at the development of the Divine Kingdom.
“I have to go to the frontline trading zone in person.”
“See if there is any cheap fertile Spirit Soil.”
“Now, I cannot waste Resources like before; I must save every penny.”
After speaking, Ma Huainan’s consciousness exited the Divine Kingdom.
Then he left his villa.
Just after Ma Huainan left the Divine Kingdom.
On the periphery of his Divine Kingdom, the spatial fluctuations became more and more obvious.
However, what appeared was not a zombie army, but crates of war supplies being teleported over.
Within the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, Yang Eleven looked at the Resources that kept appearing and began to issue orders.
“These are all corpse pills.”
“Next, proceed slowly according to the plan.”
“If you discover rivers, any Spirit Fields with traces of Planting, orchards, or livestock areas.”
“Then feed a corpse pill to a normal zombie and cast them into it.”
Yang Eleven’s voice was cold.
“Remember, the god of this Divine Kingdom is an evil god; he actually dared to deduce the location of our home. We must eliminate him.”
“The Divine Decree says, in this battle, do not seek a rapid advance.”
“Our goal is to destroy his Divine Kingdom environment, infect the life of the Divine Kingdom, and destroy his production system.”
“Let his Divine Kingdom lose the possibility of development.”

“it would indeed be heartless of me not to help.”

Once successful, that is a massive fated opportunity.

How could such a foundation be compared to those ordinary Rogue Cultivator gods in the outside world?

chapters.title: Chapter 442: Is That It?
paragraphs: As Yang Eleven’s voice faded,
In the last row of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, a large number of Zombie Kings opened their eyes at the same time.
“Yes, Lord Marshal!”
“We guarantee the mission will be completed!”
“For the God! For the Divine Kingdom!”
Because Yang Fan’s strategic goal was not to breach the enemy’s Divine Kingdom Core in a short period of time, Yang Eleven was in no hurry.

At this moment, those Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers were more like slowly moving transport vehicles, carrying countless zombie believers, steadily advancing towards the core position along the outer regions of Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom.
As they penetrated deeper, the situation in the outer regions of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom gradually became clear.
Ma Huainan was indeed very keen on managing his own Divine Kingdom investments.
Even in the outer areas, he had still planned out a large number of Resource Planting zones.
Plots of low-tier spiritual fields had been reclaimed, and there were even quite a few C-grade and D-grade Spirit Plants growing inside.
In addition, there were also some low-tier Demon Beast breeding farms.
Clearly, Ma Huainan had not given up on these seemingly low-yield industries just because he had become a deity.
Every time they passed such an area, a Zombie General would walk out from the forefront of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
It would casually grab an ordinary zombie and stuff a corpse pill into its mouth.
Then, it would directly toss it into the spiritual fields or breeding areas below.
This was the lowest-cost infection method Yang Eleven had chosen after calculations.
If a corpse pill were directly exposed to the air, the corpse poison contained within, though overbearing, would quickly dissipate.
However, if it was devoured by an ordinary zombie, the corpse poison would slowly spread as it moved.
These mindless zombies would instinctively approach areas with life aura, thereby expanding the infection range.
Wanting to rely on corpse poison to directly destroy all living beings in the entire Divine Kingdom, just like dealing with a demigod...
This method was simply extremely difficult to implement against a true deity.
A deity’s Divine Kingdom easily spanned tens of billions of square kilometers, and its inherent purification capability was far beyond what a demigod could compare to.
Even corpse poison would find it hard to affect the entire Divine Kingdom in a short period of time.
But if it was just targeting certain areas for destruction, it would be much simpler.
corpse poison would not only affect those living beings, but also had an extremely strong destructive effect on water sources, plants, and even the soil environment.
Once the pollution was formed, recovering from it would consume a vast amount of Resources.
And this was exactly the effect Yang Eleven wanted.
What he wanted to do was not pure slaughter.
Instead, he wanted to gradually lower the value of the enemy’s Divine Kingdom through war.
At this moment, Yang Fan, who was inside his own Divine Kingdom, was observing everything in Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom through the perspective of his believers.
Looking at those carefully planned low-tier Resource areas, Yang Fan could not help but shake his head.
“Tsk tsk...”
“Is that it?”
“This kind of Cultivating environment is worthy of being called a Peerless Prodigy?”
A trace of disdain appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
“Being his believer is just too miserable.”
“He has already become a deity, yet he is still Planting C-grade Spirit Plants on the outskirts of his Divine Kingdom. He won’t even let go of such petty profits?”
“No sense of grand vision at all.”
As he spoke, Yang Fan even wore an expression of ‘it’s hard to associate with him’.
Standing nearby, Yang Da’s lips could not help but twitch as he heard this.
In his understanding, Ma Huainan’s approach actually had no issues whatsoever.
After all, a deity’s Divine Kingdom being invaded was itself an extremely low-probability event.
The vast majority of deities would not experience a real Divine Kingdom War even a few times in hundreds of years.
Steadily developing the Divine Kingdom on ordinary days and increasing Resource output was originally the choice of the vast majority of deities.
What’s more, Ma Huainan had only recently made a breakthrough to deityhood.
The area of his Divine Kingdom had suddenly expanded a hundredfold, with a vast amount of land appearing out of thin air.
Utilizing these areas to Plant some low-tier Spirit Plants, breed some creatures, and increase income was originally the most reasonable way of development.
His own master’s current appearance...
To put it bluntly, it was a typical case of ‘why don’t they eat minced meat’.
If other deities were also given a thousand-fold yield rate, they probably wouldn’t bother using their brains either, and would just buy Resource buildings.
However, Yang Da had now learned not to correct Yang Fan on such minor matters.
“Master, Ma Huainan is, after all, a Peerless Prodigy who graduated from the Primordial Academy. There are probably quite a few trump cards left in his Divine Kingdom.”
“Should we arrange for 100 Flesh Scourge Mother Nests to go over first?”
“With these 100 S-rank war building present, even if the opponent has some hidden means, we can still guarantee the initiative in the war.”
Yang Da analyzed seriously.
Hearing this, Yang Fan nodded.
“Sure, in that case, dispatch a F3500 fighter jet over.”
“Have a Patrol Robot carry a spatial storage device to deliver these structures into Yang Eleven’s hands.”
“But remember, Yang Eleven is not allowed to use them unless it is a critical moment.”
Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly.
“What I want is not a war that ends in a short period of time.”
“But to slowly wear him down.”

“If we display overwhelming power from the very beginning and make Ma Huainan realize he cannot resist at all, he will very likely choose to disclose his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family.”
“When that happens, things will become troublesome instead.”
Yang Fan knew very well that the real enemy in this war was never Ma Huainan.
But the Sima Family behind him.
Whether it was the F3500 fighter jet or the Patrol Robot, they were both ordinary assets that could be easily purchased from the Divine Shop.
Yang Fan dispatched these precisely to hide his own existence to the greatest extent.
On the surface, this war was merely a strange deity on the Corpse Cultivator path suddenly invading Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
It had nothing to do with him, Yang Fan.
Although the timing was indeed a bit coincidental.
But since a Divine Kingdom War took place within the Divine Kingdom world, it was inherently extremely difficult to trace.
What’s more, Yang Fan currently walked the three paths of Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanics.
The outside world would not link him with a Corpse Cultivator at all.
As for whether anyone would suspect that he had secretly hired another deity to take action...
Yang Fan was even less worried about that.
Because he had simply never done such things, so how could they investigate?
“Yang Da, continue to purchase one-time war Resources from various shops on the frontline.”
Yang Fan’s gaze was calm.
“This Divine Kingdom War will not end so easily. A truly tough battle will come sooner or later.”
“The more prepared we are, the greater our chances of victory.”
“Yes, Master, your subordinate understands.”
Yang Da responded respectfully.
After arranging everything, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality.
He slowly opened his eyes, glanced out the window, and then closed them again.
He lay on the sofa in the spa area, continuing to enjoy the professional massage of the intelligent robot.
Now that the Divine Kingdom War had only just begun, he didn’t need to personally pay attention to the early probing and layout at all.
With intelligent lifeform like Yang Da and Yang Eleven coordinating and commanding, the entire war process would naturally proceed according to his plan.
And what he needed to do was wait.
Wait for Ma Huainan to fall into a desperate situation step by step.
