chapters.title: Chapter 443: What a Grand Gesture
paragraphs: On the other side.
the frontline, Sima Family villa.
It wasn’t until the afternoon that Ma Huainan finally returned to his residence.
At this moment, his face wore a look of satisfaction, and he held two Resources cards in his hand.
“Those bitter days in the past weren’t entirely meaningless.”
“Running to the trading area in person saved me tens of millions of Faith Points compared to the market price.”
Ma Huainan looked at the Resources cards in his hand, his eyes full of seriousness.
“Money is saved.”

“By controlling short-term consumption, investing Resources into the development of my Divine Kingdom, and relying on the accumulation of time and compound interest, one day, I will also become a truly wealthy God.”
He kept cheering himself on.
Thinking of Sima Yurao’s extravagant lifestyle in the past, Ma Huainan couldn’t help but curl his lip.
“A woman who doesn’t know how to live within her means.”
“One day, I will become stronger than you and wealthier than you.”
“At that time, I’ll see who begs whom.”
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan took a deep breath.
Subsequently, he took the Resources cards and his consciousness re-entered his Divine Kingdom.
One day in the outside world is one year in the Divine Kingdom.
In order to save costs, Ma Huainan had personally gone to the trading area to haggle with the owners of various shops.
Meanwhile, in the Divine Kingdom, nearly five months had passed.
Just after descending into the Divine Kingdom, Ma Huainan’s gaze subconsciously looked towards the outer regions.
The next second, his expression froze instantly.
Confusion, bewilderment, shock.
Finally, his entire face turned flushed red.
“This...”
“What is this?”
Ma Huainan widened his eyes.
A moment later, a roar of extreme anger resounded through the Divine Kingdom.
“My Spirit Plant!”
“My spiritual fields!”
“My Demon Beast farm!”
“My money! This is all my money!”
At this moment, the outer regions of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had already become a mess.
Under his perception, one deep green area after another, exuding a strange aura, appeared on his Divine Kingdom’s land.
Those places were exactly the resource zones he had carefully planned in the past.
The spiritual fields, medicinal gardens, and farms were all polluted by corpse poison.
The land that was originally full of vitality had now lost its original vigor.
Those precious Spirit Plants withered in large swaths, and the farmed Demon Beasts showed mutations.
Watching this scene, Ma Huainan only felt a tightness in his chest; a mouthful of blood almost sprayed out.
The loss of these Spirit Plants and Demon Beasts was actually just on the surface.
What Ma Huainan truly couldn’t accept were the fixed assets that had been polluted.
To develop his Divine Kingdom for the long term, he had spent a large amount of Divinity Points to purchase advanced spiritual soil and special farming buildings from the Divine Shop.
These resource buildings were originally meant for long-term investment.
Even if they were cultivated in the Divine Kingdom for tens of thousands of years, they could still continue to provide returns.
But now... these valuable fixed assets had all been destroyed by the corpse poison.
Only five months in the Divine Kingdom.
To save tens of millions of Faith Points, he had personally gone to the trading area to haggle with shop owners.
As a result, upon returning, the value of the Resources lost in his own Divine Kingdom already exceeded tens of thousands of Divinity Points.
This huge disparity was something Ma Huainan simply could not accept.
“Tell me!”
“What exactly happened?”
“Why weren’t all these invaders eliminated?”
Ma Huainan questioned angrily.
The intelligent lifeform’s voice carried a hint of solemnity.
“Master, the opponent’s believers are not simple.”
“The 50 million believers in the Martial Disciple Realm that were initially dispatched were all converted into zombies.”
“This is the recorded war footage.”
As the voice fell, a huge projection appeared in front of Ma Huainan.
In the image, it was the scene of the first battle between the two sides.
Ma Huainan’s believers possessed the SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, Martial God Body enhancement.
Even if they were only in the Martial Disciple Realm, their Physical Body strength far exceeded ordinary peers.
Facing those Zombie Generals, they almost presented a crushing posture, taking one out with a single punch.
However, the next second, the battle situation changed abruptly.
Those zombies did not continue to fight head-on but quickly retreated, returning to the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Immediately after, this A-Rank War Structure revealed its true terror.
A large amount of zombie aura erupted from within, and the defensive barrier on the surface of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers rose.
Ordinary believers in the Martial Disciple Realm, without the assistance of a Formation, simply could not shake a war building of this level.
Subsequently, a large amount of dense corpse poison began to spread outward.
Even streaks of green mucus were sprayed out from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Even believers with the Martial God Body, once contaminated, would have their skin rot instantly and their Qi and blood decay.
Immediately after, Medicinal Pills exuding a strange aura were thrown out by the zombie believers.
The entire battlefield was instantly shrouded in extremely dense corpse Qi.
His 50 million believers were completely trapped inside.
They wanted to retreat, but found that the surroundings had long been surrounded by the zombie army.
They wanted to break through, but couldn’t find a direction at all.
As time passed, the corpse poison continuously eroded their bodies.
These Martial God Body believers who once possessed powerful combat strength began to have their consciousness gradually blur, and their bodies began to mutate.
Finally... one by one, they turned into the most ordinary zombies.
The whole process had no fierce fighting, no earth-shattering great battle.
It was filled with eeriness everywhere.
Having watched the entire war footage.
Ma Huainan stood in place, veins bulging on his forehead, his fists clenched tightly.
“Speak!”
“What exactly are these square iron lumps?”
Ma Huainan lowered his voice and asked with a gloomy face.
The intelligent lifeform immediately responded:
“Reporting to Master, it has been investigated clearly.”
“This is the Zombie System’s A-Rank War Structure—Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers!”
“A-Rank War Structure?”
Ma Huainan was slightly stunned.
Subsequently, his eyes instantly became cold.
“Since it is an A-Rank War Structure, why didn’t you warn me at the beginning?”
The intelligent lifeform was silent for a moment, then explained:
“Reporting to Master, the number of Gods among the Human race who choose the Zombie System is extremely small.”
“So small that there is no detailed sales information for similar buildings in the entire Divine Shop.”
“It wasn’t until the army of 50 million believers was annihilated that I realized the situation was abnormal.”
“Subsequently, using Master’s authority, I queried the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence and only then obtained the relevant information.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the anger in his heart.
At this moment, the ease on his face had completely disappeared, replaced by a hint of solemnity.
“Nearly ten thousand A-Rank War Structures...”
“What a grand gesture.”
“It seems I truly underestimated the opponent.”
Ma Huainan’s eyes flickered.
“This is definitely not an foundation that an ordinary Rogue Cultivator God could possess.”
“The opponent is likely a Tier 3 God who has accumulated for thousands, or even tens of thousands of years.”
“Just like those heads of great families in the county where I was originally located.”
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan couldn’t help but clench his fists.
“If I had known this, I should have personally commanded the first battle.”
“It wouldn’t have resulted in such a huge loss.”

sentences.text: On the other side.
the frontline, Sima Family villa.
It wasn’t until the afternoon that Ma Huainan finally returned to his residence.
At this moment, his face wore a look of satisfaction, and he held two Resources cards in his hand.
“Those bitter days in the past weren’t entirely meaningless.”
“Running to the trading area in person saved me tens of millions of Faith Points compared to the market price.”
Ma Huainan looked at the Resources cards in his hand, his eyes full of seriousness.
“Money is saved.”

“By controlling short-term consumption, investing Resources into the development of my Divine Kingdom, and relying on the accumulation of time and compound interest, one day, I will also become a truly wealthy God.”
He kept cheering himself on.
Thinking of Sima Yurao’s extravagant lifestyle in the past, Ma Huainan couldn’t help but curl his lip.
“A woman who doesn’t know how to live within her means.”
“One day, I will become stronger than you and wealthier than you.”
“At that time, I’ll see who begs whom.”
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan took a deep breath.
Subsequently, he took the Resources cards and his consciousness re-entered his Divine Kingdom.
One day in the outside world is one year in the Divine Kingdom.
In order to save costs, Ma Huainan had personally gone to the trading area to haggle with the owners of various shops.
Meanwhile, in the Divine Kingdom, nearly five months had passed.
Just after descending into the Divine Kingdom, Ma Huainan’s gaze subconsciously looked towards the outer regions.
The next second, his expression froze instantly.
Confusion, bewilderment, shock.
Finally, his entire face turned flushed red.
“This...”
“What is this?”
Ma Huainan widened his eyes.
A moment later, a roar of extreme anger resounded through the Divine Kingdom.
“My Spirit Plant!”
“My spiritual fields!”
“My Demon Beast farm!”
“My money!
This is all my money!”
At this moment, the outer regions of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom had already become a mess.
Under his perception, one deep green area after another, exuding a strange aura, appeared on his Divine Kingdom’s land.
Those places were exactly the resource zones he had carefully planned in the past.
The spiritual fields, medicinal gardens, and farms were all polluted by corpse poison.
The land that was originally full of vitality had now lost its original vigor.
Those precious Spirit Plants withered in large swaths, and the farmed Demon Beasts showed mutations.
Watching this scene, Ma Huainan only felt a tightness in his chest; a mouthful of blood almost sprayed out.
The loss of these Spirit Plants and Demon Beasts was actually just on the surface.
What Ma Huainan truly couldn’t accept were the fixed assets that had been polluted.
To develop his Divine Kingdom for the long term, he had spent a large amount of Divinity Points to purchase advanced spiritual soil and special farming buildings from the Divine Shop.
These resource buildings were originally meant for long-term investment.
Even if they were cultivated in the Divine Kingdom for tens of thousands of years, they could still continue to provide returns.
But now... these valuable fixed assets had all been destroyed by the corpse poison.
Only five months in the Divine Kingdom.
To save tens of millions of Faith Points, he had personally gone to the trading area to haggle with shop owners.
As a result, upon returning, the value of the Resources lost in his own Divine Kingdom already exceeded tens of thousands of Divinity Points.
This huge disparity was something Ma Huainan simply could not accept.
“Tell me!”
“What exactly happened?”
“Why weren’t all these invaders eliminated?”
Ma Huainan questioned angrily.
The intelligent lifeform’s voice carried a hint of solemnity.
“Master, the opponent’s believers are not simple.”
“The 50 million believers in the Martial Disciple Realm that were initially dispatched were all converted into zombies.”
“This is the recorded war footage.”
As the voice fell, a huge projection appeared in front of Ma Huainan.
In the image, it was the scene of the first battle between the two sides.
Ma Huainan’s believers possessed the SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, Martial God Body enhancement.
Even if they were only in the Martial Disciple Realm, their Physical Body strength far exceeded ordinary peers.
Facing those Zombie Generals, they almost presented a crushing posture, taking one out with a single punch.
However, the next second, the battle situation changed abruptly.
Those zombies did not continue to fight head-on but quickly retreated, returning to the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Immediately after, this A-Rank War Structure revealed its true terror.
A large amount of zombie aura erupted from within, and the defensive barrier on the surface of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers rose.
Ordinary believers in the Martial Disciple Realm, without the assistance of a Formation, simply could not shake a war building of this level.
Subsequently, a large amount of dense corpse poison began to spread outward.
Even streaks of green mucus were sprayed out from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Even believers with the Martial God Body, once contaminated, would have their skin rot instantly and their Qi and blood decay.
Immediately after, Medicinal Pills exuding a strange aura were thrown out by the zombie believers.
The entire battlefield was instantly shrouded in extremely dense corpse Qi.
His 50 million believers were completely trapped inside.
They wanted to retreat, but found that the surroundings had long been surrounded by the zombie army.
They wanted to break through, but couldn’t find a direction at all.
As time passed, the corpse poison continuously eroded their bodies.
These Martial God Body believers who once possessed powerful combat strength began to have their consciousness gradually blur, and their bodies began to mutate.
Finally... one by one, they turned into the most ordinary zombies.
The whole process had no fierce fighting, no earth-shattering great battle.
It was filled with eeriness everywhere.
Having watched the entire war footage.
Ma Huainan stood in place, veins bulging on his forehead, his fists clenched tightly.
“Speak!”
“What exactly are these square iron lumps?”
Ma Huainan lowered his voice and asked with a gloomy face.
The intelligent lifeform immediately responded:
“Reporting to Master, it has been investigated clearly.”
“This is the Zombie System’s A-Rank War Structure—Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers!”
“A-Rank War Structure?”
Ma Huainan was slightly stunned.
Subsequently, his eyes instantly became cold.
“Since it is an A-Rank War Structure, why didn’t you warn me at the beginning?”
The intelligent lifeform was silent for a moment, then explained:
“Reporting to Master, the number of Gods among the Human race who choose the Zombie System is extremely small.”
“So small that there is no detailed sales information for similar buildings in the entire Divine Shop.”
“It wasn’t until the army of 50 million believers was annihilated that I realized the situation was abnormal.”
“Subsequently, using Master’s authority, I queried the Federal Supreme Artificial Intelligence and only then obtained the relevant information.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the anger in his heart.
At this moment, the ease on his face had completely disappeared, replaced by a hint of solemnity.
“Nearly ten thousand A-Rank War Structures...”
“What a grand gesture.”
“It seems I truly underestimated the opponent.”
Ma Huainan’s eyes flickered.
“This is definitely not an foundation that an ordinary Rogue Cultivator God could possess.”
“The opponent is likely a Tier 3 God who has accumulated for thousands, or even tens of thousands of years.”
“Just like those heads of great families in the county where I was originally located.”
Thinking of this, Ma Huainan couldn’t help but clench his fists.
“If I had known this, I should have personally commanded the first battle.”
“It wouldn’t have resulted in such a huge loss.”

chapters.title: Chapter 444: Obsolete Product
paragraphs: However, his gaze soon fell upon the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the projection.
A hint of greed gradually emerged in his eyes.
“An A-Rank War Structure... and so many of them.”
“If I can obtain them, not only will I be able to recoup this loss, but I could even make a huge profit.”
Ma Huainan licked his lips.
“It seems that after dealing with these zombies, it will be necessary to take a trip to the other side’s Divine Kingdom.”
“If their Divine Kingdom is rich enough...”
“It’s not like I couldn’t keep this coordinate for myself.”
Having said this, Ma Huainan looked at the intelligent lifeform again.
“What about those Medicinal Pill?”
“Why are they able to release such terrifying corpse poison?”
The intelligent lifeform quickly analyzed it and replied:

“Reporting to Master, there is no relevant information in the Divine Shop either. It should be a poison-attribute Medicinal Pill developed by the other side’s Divine Kingdom itself, and its Level is not low.”
Upon hearing this, Ma Huainan’s expression became even more serious.
A moment later, he issued an order directly:
“Suspend Divine Kingdom investment and immediately arrange for advanced war-type intelligent lifeform to reorganize and prepare for battle.”
“Summon an army of one billion believers.”
“At the same time, bring along the two S-Level Immortal Army Soul Stele.”
“Even a lion uses its full strength to hunt a rabbit.”
“Since I know the other side is not simple, I cannot give them any more chances.”
“With the force of thunder, completely wipe out these zombies!”
For Ma Huainan, this was not just for safety.
More importantly, he absolutely could not allow these zombies to continue penetrating deeper into his Divine Kingdom.
Although there were many Resource investments in the outer areas, their value was limited; however, the closer one got to the Divine Kingdom Core area, the more advanced Resources he had invested.
If he let these zombies continue to advance.
The losses could be assets worth millions, or even tens of millions, of Divinity Points.
He could not afford such a price.
After arranging everything, Ma Huainan’s consciousness returned to the Real World.
He did not delay at all, directly opening Feixun and dialing a number.
Soon, the call connected.
“So it’s Young Master Ma. It’s been a long time since you patronized my weapon shop.”
“I wonder what you would like to purchase this time?”
An enthusiastic voice came from the other end of the phone.
Ma Huainan did not waste words and asked directly: “Do you have any biochemical protective suits or gas masks for sale?”
“Yes, yes!”
“However, these items are special Smart Weapon produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom, and the price is not cheap.”
Hearing the words “Smart Weapon”, Ma Huainan frowned slightly.
What he lacked most right now was capital; if he spent a large amount of Divinity Points to buy Smart Weapon just to deal with these zombies, it obviously would not be cost-effective.
Seeming to sense his hesitation, the other party smiled and said:
“Young Master Ma, if you feel that buying them is not cost-effective, I also offer rental services here.”
“But let me state beforehand, if too much damage occurs during use, you will need to pay double the price as compensation.”
“That is acceptable.”
Ma Huainan did not hesitate at all.
“Draft the contract and send it to me.”
“I will provide the address. Remember, the sooner you send them over, the better.”
“Understood, Young Master Ma.” An excited voice came from the other end of the call.
The call ended, and Ma Huainan let out a slow breath.
“My believers possess the Martial God Body, and coupled with the two Immortal Army Soul Stele.”
“After forming a military formation, even an A-Rank War Structure cannot stop them.”
Thinking of this, confidence returned to Ma Huainan’s face.
Although the overall combat power of the Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom was not enough to make Yang Fan take it seriously.
But after all, this was a Divine Kingdom War, and Yang Fan did not completely leave it unattended.
Every day, he would set aside a small amount of time to enter the Divine Kingdom to check the situation on the battlefield so that he could respond to any sudden changes at any time.
His consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom Core area.

At this moment, a large number of monitoring devices had already been installed on the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers, and the battlefield footage was being transmitted back in real-time, projected in front of Yang Fan.
Looking at the scene before him, an expression of oddity could not help but appear on Yang Fan’s face.
He saw that the battlefield was teeming with people.
The opponent’s nearly one billion believers were arranged in neat military formations, and among them, there were nearly one hundred million powerhouses of the Martial Master Realm.
It must be said that the SS-Level Divine Kingdom Talent, Martial God Body, is indeed terrifying.

The fact that Ma Huainan was able to Cultivate such a scale of Martial Master believers in less than a year since breaking through to become a deity is enough to prove the power of the Martial God Body.
However, what Yang Fan felt was somewhat strange was not the combat power of the opponent’s believers.
After all, in his Divine Kingdom now, just the Martial King-Level believers already numbered nearly ten billion, and Martial Emperor-Level existences had even been born.
A mere one hundred million Martial Masters did not amount to much for the current Yang Fan.
What really surprised him was... the attire of these believers of Ma Huainan.
He saw that on the battlefield, nearly one billion believers were all wearing uniform white protective suits.
The surface of the protective suits was covered with a layer of transparent gelatinous film, as if the bodies had been encased in a special shell.
And on their heads, they were all wearing huge transparent covers; looking from a distance, it was like a group of people appearing on the battlefield with small fishbowls inverted over their heads.
Seeing this scene, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly. “What kind of look is this?”
However, after just one glance, he guessed the purpose of this equipment.
It must be some kind of high-level biochemical protective suit and gas mask.
It was just... when paired with these Martial Artist, it really seemed somewhat incongruous.
“Master, after searching, this belongs to the first-generation model of the [Azure Biochemical Protective Suit].”
Yang Da explained.
“This equipment was designed and manufactured by the mid-tier Mechanical deity—Mo Yuan.”
“Its main function is to defend against various toxins, plagues, and special energy pollution.”
“Its advantage is that its defensive capability is extremely strong, and it has a very good isolation effect against the vast majority of biochemical attacks.”
“However, its disadvantages are equally obvious.”

“Due to the use of a first-generation Mechanical structure, the equipment’s stability is relatively poor, energy consumption is relatively high, and it is extremely prone to damage during high-intensity combat.”
“Therefore, it is now considered an obsolete product.”
“Currently, this type of equipment is used more in experimental areas of Divine Kingdoms, rather than in real wars.”
After hearing the explanation, Yang Fan could not help but speak out, “So it’s actually an obsolete product; it certainly looks intimidating, though.”
Yang Fan’s gaze fell back onto the battlefield.
“This person has broken through to become a deity for less than a year in the Real World.”
“If this army of nearly one billion were all lost, I fear he would truly be heartbroken enough to vomit blood.”
Yang Da nodded.
“Master, according to calculations, Ma Huainan should have already utilized one-tenth of his Divine Kingdom’s combat power.”
“His Divine Kingdom environment is not considered superior, and even with the SS-Level Martial God Body, the Cultivate speed of his believers is ultimately limited.”
Yang Fan smiled, “It seems this guy is truly desperate.”
By deploying nearly one-tenth of his combat power at once, the opponent’s goal was clear: he wanted to settle the outcome in one battle.
A trace of confidence flashed in Yang Da’s eyes.
“If not for Master’s concern that he might expose the Divine Kingdom coordinate to the Sima Family too early, with our current strength, we could have already swept through all the way.”
“These believers are simply unable to stop our current army of zombies.”

chapters.title: Chapter 445: Smart Weapon???
paragraphs: Now, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom possessed two A-Level Cultivation talents: the Myriad Phenomena Spirit Physique and the Undying Body.
Yang Yi had long since replaced the embryos in the cloning nutrient tanks.
The clones born now possessed even stronger Innate Physiques.
If these clones with special Physiques were converted into zombies, their overall combat power in the Zombie Kingdom would also see a massive increase once they grew up.
Currently, among the many factions within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, the Zombie Kingdom was a force with vast numbers but relatively weak combat power.
Yet, even so, it was definitely not something Ma Huainan could challenge.
If not for the consideration of the Sima Family, this Divine Kingdom War would have already ended long ago.
“After all, he is a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius; the Sima Family might not give up easily.”
Yang Fan sat on the main seat of the Divine Kingdom’s great hall, watching the battlefield in the projection with a calm gaze.
“Since that’s the case, then let’s take it slow.”
“Boiling a frog in warm water—if we keep dragging this out, he will be the one in pain.”
After speaking, Yang Fan leaned back on the throne, watching this Divine Kingdom War with great interest.
Inside Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Above the army of one billion believers, a phantom figure slowly condensed.
It was none other than the consciousness phantom of the god, Ma Huainan.
At this moment, he stood in the sky, looking down at the slowly advancing zombie army in the distance, his eyes cold and solemn.
“Fellow Daoist, you’ve paid such a huge price to destroy my Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem and spread corpse poison throughout my Divine Kingdom.”
“You must be doing this to force me into a decisive battle with you here, right?”
“Since that is the case, why continue to hide?”
“Show yourself!”
Ma Huainan’s voice resonated through the entire Divine Kingdom like thunder.
However, the only response he received was the mechanically uniform footsteps of the zombie army in the distance.
No god appeared, and there was no response whatsoever.
Yang Fan was currently in his own Divine Kingdom, and seeing Ma Huainan in this state, a smile couldn’t help but tug at the corner of his mouth.
Want him to show himself?
How is that possible?
The reason he chose to have the zombie army invade was precisely to hide his own identity.
To the outside world, this war was merely a Divine Kingdom War between an unknown Corpse Cultivator god and Ma Huainan.
If he were to appear in person, all previous arrangements would lose their meaning.
A full quarter of an hour passed, and there was still no response.
Ma Huainan’s expression gradually darkened.
“You rat hiding your head and showing your tail!”
“Since you dare not show yourself, then let me see what qualifications you have to invade my Divine Kingdom!”
“Today, I will bury all of your believers right here!”
After speaking, Ma Huainan slowly raised his right hand.
“I am the Master of the Divine Kingdom!”
“All my believers are under my protection!”
“Those who offend my Divine Kingdom shall pay with blood!”
“Today, follow me into battle and suppress the invading enemy!”
As his voice fell, the one billion believers erupted into a heaven-shaking roar simultaneously.
“Kill! Kill! Kill!”
A terrifying force of Qi and blood instantly surged into the sky.
Countless streaks of blood-colored energy intertwined in the sky, eventually condensing into a massive phantom.
It was an ancient, wild giant beast.
It roared at the sky, its terrifying pressure sweeping across the heavens and earth.
The Qi and blood of the one billion believers connected, surging like a sea of blood.
However, facing such a terrifying aura, Yang Eleven remained expressionless within the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the rear.
“Second array, deploy ten million Zombie Generals.”
“Third array, deploy one million Zombie Kings.”
“Deploy the Zombie Tide Dance Formation at the front!”
“All participating believers, consume one corpse pill before the battle! To prevent any accidents.”
As Yang Eleven’s order was issued.
In an instant, the neatly arranged Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the rear opened simultaneously, and a large number of high-Level zombies walked out from within.
These zombies were not in the slightest bit chaotic; they were all equipped with Smart Weapons.
Energy patterns intertwined with scarlet and emerald green constantly flowed over their pitch-black bodies.
Cold Mechanical armor covered their body surfaces, making the originally ferocious zombies even more oppressive.
Step, step.
The uniform footsteps sounded like war drums.
Ten million Zombie Generals stood at the very front, with one million Zombie Kings following closely behind.
Subsequently, a grand formation slowly formed, and cold corpse energy surged into the sky, forming a stark contrast to the opponent’s monstrous blood energy.
Seeing this scene, Ma Huainan, high in the sky, couldn’t help but have his consciousness pause for a moment.
“This...”
“Is this a Smart Weapon?”
“And it’s an advanced Smart Weapon?”
His pupils constricted sharply.
“No!”
“This is impossible!”
Shouldn’t the Corpse Cultivator path rely on infection, mass production, and winning through sheer numbers?
Why are these zombies, every single one of them, equipped with such high-Level Smart Weapons?
How many Divinity Points would this consume?
For a moment, Ma Huainan felt his understanding of reality being challenged.
“Master, do not be careless!”
The voice of the intelligent lifeform rang out urgently.
“After detection, these are third-Level Smart Weapons!”
“And those Zombie Kings in the back, who have reached the combat power of a Martial Master, are equipped with even higher fourth-Level Smart Weapons!”
“The actual combat power of this ten-million-strong zombie legion far exceeds what it appears to be!”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan snapped back to his senses, and the contempt in his eyes vanished instantly.
But the next moment, he took a deep breath and raised his right hand.
“My believers!”
“Follow me into battle!”
“Kill!”
Boom!
The next instant, the vanguard of the army began to charge.
The earth trembled, and the sky roared.
Countless Martial Apprentice and Martial Master-level believers erupted with Qi and blood simultaneously.
They stepped on the earth, advancing forward like a torrent of steel.

With every step they took, the the void seemed to be twisted by the pressure of their Qi and blood, and the rolling Qi and blood surged into the sky like ten million blood-colored Dragons, causing the entire battlefield to tremble.
“Frontline soldiers, release energy shields and block the enemy’s charge!”
“Focus on collecting war data, and prioritize testing the attack intensity of the opponent’s formation!”
In the rear, Yang Eleven calmly issued orders.
Now, these Smart Weapons were all equipped with a complete interaction System.

Yang Eleven didn’t need to personally command the battle at the frontline like in the past; by using the real-time data fed back from the Smart Weapons combined with the battlefield footage, he could precisely control the entire army.
The efficiency of war command had increased by who knows how many times compared to the past.
Boom!
A deafening roar.
Ma Huainan’s vanguard army, like a blood-colored spear, smashed heavily against the light blue energy shield.
The terrifying force of Qi and blood struck frantically.
However, in the next second, a large amount of data had already been collected by the Smart Weapons.
“Detection complete.”
“Enemy attack intensity has reached 0.5% of the current defense limit.”
“Comprehensive assessment: No danger.”
“Smart Weapons automatically adjusted to low-power operating mode.”
“According to the current war intensity, energy reserves are estimated to last for 100 years of combat.”
“War danger level: Extremely low.”
Very quickly, the Smart Weapons provided the feedback.
And this information was simultaneously transmitted to Yang Fan in the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Seeing this result, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.

sentences.text: Now, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom possessed two A-Level Cultivation talents: the Myriad Phenomena Spirit Physique and the Undying Body.
Yang Yi had long since replaced the embryos in the cloning nutrient tanks.
The clones born now possessed even stronger Innate Physiques.
If these clones with special Physiques were converted into zombies, their overall combat power in the Zombie Kingdom would also see a massive increase once they grew up.
Currently, among the many factions within Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, the Zombie Kingdom was a force with vast numbers but relatively weak combat power.
Yet, even so, it was definitely not something Ma Huainan could challenge.
If not for the consideration of the Sima Family, this Divine Kingdom War would have already ended long ago.
“After all, he is a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius; the Sima Family might not give up easily.”
Yang Fan sat on the main seat of the Divine Kingdom’s great hall, watching the battlefield in the projection with a calm gaze.
“Since that’s the case, then let’s take it slow.”
“Boiling a frog in warm water—if we keep dragging this out, he will be the one in pain.”
After speaking, Yang Fan leaned back on the throne, watching this Divine Kingdom War with great interest.
Inside Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Above the army of one billion believers, a phantom figure slowly condensed.
It was none other than the consciousness phantom of the god, Ma Huainan.
At this moment, he stood in the sky, looking down at the slowly advancing zombie army in the distance, his eyes cold and solemn.
“Fellow Daoist, you’ve paid such a huge price to destroy my Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem and spread corpse poison throughout my Divine Kingdom.”
“You must be doing this to force me into a decisive battle with you here, right?”
“Since that is the case, why continue to hide?”
“Show yourself!”
Ma Huainan’s voice resonated through the entire Divine Kingdom like thunder.
However, the only response he received was the mechanically uniform footsteps of the zombie army in the distance.
No god appeared, and there was no response whatsoever.
Yang Fan was currently in his own Divine Kingdom, and seeing Ma Huainan in this state, a smile couldn’t help but tug at the corner of his mouth.
Want him to show himself?
How is that possible?
The reason he chose to have the zombie army invade was precisely to hide his own identity.
To the outside world, this war was merely a Divine Kingdom War between an unknown Corpse Cultivator god and Ma Huainan.
If he were to appear in person, all previous arrangements would lose their meaning.
A full quarter of an hour passed, and there was still no response.
Ma Huainan’s expression gradually darkened.
“You rat hiding your head and showing your tail!”
“Since you dare not show yourself, then let me see what qualifications you have to invade my Divine Kingdom!”
“Today, I will bury all of your believers right here!”
After speaking, Ma Huainan slowly raised his right hand.
“I am the Master of the Divine Kingdom!”
“All my believers are under my protection!”
“Those who offend my Divine Kingdom shall pay with blood!”
“Today, follow me into battle and suppress the invading enemy!”
As his voice fell, the one billion believers erupted into a heaven-shaking roar simultaneously.
“Kill!
Kill!
Kill!”
A terrifying force of Qi and blood instantly surged into the sky.
Countless streaks of blood-colored energy intertwined in the sky, eventually condensing into a massive phantom.
It was an ancient, wild giant beast.
It roared at the sky, its terrifying pressure sweeping across the heavens and earth.
The Qi and blood of the one billion believers connected, surging like a sea of blood.
However, facing such a terrifying aura, Yang Eleven remained expressionless within the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the rear.
“Second array, deploy ten million Zombie Generals.”
“Third array, deploy one million Zombie Kings.”
“Deploy the Zombie Tide Dance Formation at the front!”
“All participating believers, consume one corpse pill before the battle!
To prevent any accidents.”
As Yang Eleven’s order was issued.
In an instant, the neatly arranged Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the rear opened simultaneously, and a large number of high-Level zombies walked out from within.
These zombies were not in the slightest bit chaotic; they were all equipped with Smart Weapons.
Energy patterns intertwined with scarlet and emerald green constantly flowed over their pitch-black bodies.
Cold Mechanical armor covered their body surfaces, making the originally ferocious zombies even more oppressive.
Step, step.
The uniform footsteps sounded like war drums.
Ten million Zombie Generals stood at the very front, with one million Zombie Kings following closely behind.
Subsequently, a grand formation slowly formed, and cold corpse energy surged into the sky, forming a stark contrast to the opponent’s monstrous blood energy.
Seeing this scene, Ma Huainan, high in the sky, couldn’t help but have his consciousness pause for a moment.
“This...”
“Is this a Smart Weapon?”
“And it’s an advanced Smart Weapon?”
His pupils constricted sharply.
“No!”
“This is impossible!”
Shouldn’t the Corpse Cultivator path rely on infection, mass production, and winning through sheer numbers?
Why are these zombies, every single one of them, equipped with such high-Level Smart Weapons?
How many Divinity Points would this consume?
For a moment, Ma Huainan felt his understanding of reality being challenged.
“Master, do not be careless!”
The voice of the intelligent lifeform rang out urgently.
“After detection, these are third-Level Smart Weapons!”
“And those Zombie Kings in the back, who have reached the combat power of a Martial Master, are equipped with even higher fourth-Level Smart Weapons!”
“The actual combat power of this ten-million-strong zombie legion far exceeds what it appears to be!”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan snapped back to his senses, and the contempt in his eyes vanished instantly.
But the next moment, he took a deep breath and raised his right hand.
“My believers!”
“Follow me into battle!”
“Kill!”
Boom!
The next instant, the vanguard of the army began to charge.
The earth trembled, and the sky roared.
Countless Martial Apprentice and Martial Master-level believers erupted with Qi and blood simultaneously.
They stepped on the earth, advancing forward like a torrent of steel.

With every step they took, the the void seemed to be twisted by the pressure of their Qi and blood, and the rolling Qi and blood surged into the sky like ten million blood-colored Dragons, causing the entire battlefield to tremble.
“Frontline soldiers, release energy shields and block the enemy’s charge!”
“Focus on collecting war data, and prioritize testing the attack intensity of the opponent’s formation!”
In the rear, Yang Eleven calmly issued orders.
Now, these Smart Weapons were all equipped with a complete interaction System.

Yang Eleven didn’t need to personally command the battle at the frontline like in the past; by using the real-time data fed back from the Smart Weapons combined with the battlefield footage, he could precisely control the entire army.
The efficiency of war command had increased by who knows how many times compared to the past.
Boom!
A deafening roar.
Ma Huainan’s vanguard army, like a blood-colored spear, smashed heavily against the light blue energy shield.
The terrifying force of Qi and blood struck frantically.
However, in the next second, a large amount of data had already been collected by the Smart Weapons.
“Detection complete.”
“Enemy attack intensity has reached 0.5% of the current defense limit.”
“Comprehensive assessment: No danger.”
“Smart Weapons automatically adjusted to low-power operating mode.”
“According to the current war intensity, energy reserves are estimated to last for 100 years of combat.”
“War danger level: Extremely low.”
Very quickly, the Smart Weapons provided the feedback.
And this information was simultaneously transmitted to Yang Fan in the Divine Kingdom Core area.
Seeing this result, the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Is This the Corpse Cultivator Route?
paragraphs: “Ahem...”
“Um, Yang Da.”
“My main purpose in sending a Zombie army to invade the other party’s Divine Kingdom this time is to hide my true identity and avoid legal issues in the Real World.”
“Will the large-scale use of these Smart Weapons expose anything?”
Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask.
After all, the scene before him looked somewhat exaggerated no matter how one viewed it.
His Zombie army was entirely equipped with Smart Weapons.
How was this any different from the Mechanical Civilization participating in the war directly?
Moreover, the disparity was simply too great; the opposing army of one billion believers looked earth-shattering in their aura.
Yet, after clashing, they couldn’t even break through the energy shield.
This was a bit of a bully move.
Upon hearing this, Yang Da immediately explained:
“Master, there is no need to worry about this.”
“Smart Weapons are different from war buildings.”
“As the Mechanical Civilization continues to develop, Smart Weapons are constantly updated and iterated; currently, there are over a hundred million types of Smart Weapons sold in the Federal Mall.”
“The biggest difference between them is often not their appearance, but their energy efficiency, internal component quality, service life, and combat adaptability.”
“The outside world cannot judge these things simply by looking at the surface.”
“For example, among the Smart Weapons currently used by the Divine Kingdom, there are tens of thousands of similar models in the Divine Shop.”
“The Federal Government cannot use these alone as a basis for investigation.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally breathed a sigh of relief, then he couldn’t help but show a strange expression.
“I see.”
“It’s just... isn’t this a bit too much of a bully move?”
Saying this, Yang Fan himself couldn’t hold it in and couldn’t help but want to laugh.
Yang Da was silent for a moment, then answered seriously:

“A little. Under normal circumstances, if a third-grade Smart Weapon is controlled by intelligent lifeform, it can completely go head-to-head with a Cultivator in the Core Formation Realm or a Martial King-level believer.”
“Although these Zombie believers cannot unleash the full power of the Smart Weapons, they are far from something a Martial Master can contend with.”
After listening, Yang Fan’s lips curled up slightly.
“Is that so... Then let’s leave him some hope.”
“Immediately send an order to Yang Eleven: don’t kill them too quickly; make the other party feel like they still have a chance.”
The number of believers currently sent into the other party’s Divine Kingdom was not very large.
The first batch of the Zombie army deployed was only on the scale of a few hundred million.

If they showed completely overwhelming strength right at the beginning of the battle, making Ma Huainan realize the huge disparity between the two sides, he might very well disclose the coordinates of his Divine Kingdom to the Sima Family.
At that point, things would become troublesome instead.
After all, the overall destruction level of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom was currently less than 10%, far from reaching the effect Yang Fan wanted.
On the other side, on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
A row of Zombie Generals, clad in Smart Weapons, stood at the very front of the battlefield, relying on energy shields to forcefully block the charge of Ma Huainan’s vanguard army.
Behind them, a large number of Zombies raised their right hands simultaneously.
Hum!
The next moment, countless Mechanical patterns lit up simultaneously.
Terrifying energy began to gather frantically.
Rays of dazzling light condensed between the palms of the Zombies.
“Fire!”
As the order was given.
Boom, boom, boom!
Energy cannons filled the sky, instantly tearing through the air like a torrential rain, pouring down towards Ma Huainan’s army.
Seeing this scene, Ma Huainan’s expression changed drastically.
“All legions, form a defensive Formation immediately!”
The Divine Decree instantly spread across the entire battlefield.
The next moment, the believers simultaneously erupted with Qi and blood, and an extremely dense blood-colored power shot up into the sky.
Countless strands of Qi and blood power connected with each other, eventually forming a massive defensive barrier.
The sky within a radius of hundreds of miles was enveloped by this blood-colored power.
Boom!
The first round of energy cannons fell, colliding with the bloody Qi and blood.
For a moment, the entire world was plunged into violent tremors.
After those energy cannons entered the blood-colored Domain, their speed significantly decreased.
Then... they exploded with a bang!
“Columns 2 through 100, accumulate energy!”
“Columns 100 through 200, fire energy cannons!”
“Columns 200 through 300, begin preparation!”
“Maintain fire suppression!”
Behind the Zombie army, a White Zombie was temporarily taking over the command task.
He held a specially made command flag in his hand, waving it continuously to control the attack rhythm of the Smart Weapons in front.
However... watching the energy cannons falling one after another, this White Zombie couldn’t help but yawn.
“The Smart Weapons bestowed upon us by our God are truly too easy to use.”
“It seems there is no chance to use the Zombie Tide Dance Formation that the Marshal helped us practice!”
He couldn’t help but sigh.
Energy cannons filled the sky, bombarding continuously, and the blood-colored aura that originally enveloped the battlefield was fading at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Soon, under the continuous suppression of artillery fire, the Qi and blood defensive Formation composed by Ma Huainan’s believer army finally could not hold on.
Boom!
Accompanied by a loud noise, the massive blood-colored barrier shattered with a bang.
The next moment.
Countless energy cannons fell directly into the crowd like a torrential rain.
Boom, boom, boom!
Terrifying explosions rang out one after another.
Rays of brilliant light exploded within Ma Huainan’s believer army.
Even if a Martial Master-level believer was hit head-on by an energy cannon, the powerful impact would instantly tear their Physical Body apart.
Flesh and blood flew, and severed limbs were scattered across the battlefield.
And those believers slightly further away from the center of the explosion were also unable to escape unscathed.
The terrifying energy aftermath swept through, causing heavy injuries to a large number of believers, causing them to lose the ability to continue fighting.
For a time, the entire battlefield fell into complete chaos.
Screams, wails, and roars rang out continuously.
The army of one billion, which originally had an earth-shattering aura, was now like it had been covered by a devastating disaster.
Looking at this scene, Ma Huainan, who was high in the sky, froze completely.
His body couldn’t even help but tremble slightly.
“This... what exactly is going on?”
“Is this the Corpse Cultivator Route?”
“Which Corpse Cultivator god would buy so many Smart Weapons?”
“Are you walking the Corpse Cultivator Route or the Mechanical Path!”
Ma Huainan’s massive consciousness projection raised his right hand, pointing at the distant Zombie army; for the first time, his voice contained undisguised shock, and even a hint of fear.
He had personally commanded the army in this battle to completely resolve this invasion.
Therefore, before the war began, he had learned a large amount of information about gods on the Corpse Cultivator Route through the Virtual World.
The information he had searched for showed that the development direction of Corpse Cultivator gods was very clear.
Army building, infection, using corpse poison to infect the other party’s ordinary believers.
Gradually eroding the enemy’s Divine Kingdom through a massive number of low-tier Zombies.
Their most powerful weapon was not single-unit combat power, but their endless numbers.
Therefore, he had specifically spent a large amount of Divinity Points to rent a batch of biochemical protective equipment from the weapons shop at the frontline.
The purpose was to prevent his own believers from being infected by corpse poison.
But now... what was this scene before him?
Why did the arms of a group of Zombies turn into a form similar to cannon barrels?
Why was the power of the Smart Weapons equipped by these Zombies so strong?
This had completely exceeded his understanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: This Is The Corpse Cultivator Route
paragraphs: If not for the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom rules, a High-Order God could not directly invade a Low-rank Deity.
At this moment, Ma Huainan even suspected that a mid-tier Mechanical God might be hiding their identity to attack his Divine Kingdom.
“Something is wrong... very wrong!”
“Who exactly is the opponent?”
Cold sweat had already appeared on Ma Huainan’s forehead.
Clearly, the number of zombies the opponent had committed to the battlefield was only in the hundreds of millions.
Yet, at this moment, he felt an inexplicable fear.
On the other side, Yang Eleven quickly received the message sent by Yang Da.
The next moment, he immediately gave an order.
“Stop using the energy cannons and reduce the frequency of using Smart Weapons.”
As the order was passed down, the zombie legion, which had been outputting crazily, instantly stopped their large-scale attacks.
The White Zombie standing to the side was stunned for a moment, “Marshal, why is this?”
Yang Eleven glanced at him, then said in a deep voice:
“In a moment, you will personally head to the frontline.”
“I am allocating 50 million ordinary zombies to you.”
“Next, you will preside over the Zombie Tide Dance Formation.”
“I want you to fight an evenly matched war against the opponent’s army.”
Upon hearing this, that White Zombie was clearly stunned.
“Ah?”
“But Marshal, these Smart Weapons can automatically recover energy.”
“With this level of consumption, they can recover in just a few months at most.”
“There is no need to restrict their use, is there?”
Yang Eleven shook his head.
“You only need to remember one thing.”
“Our God’s gaze is far further than what we can see.”
“The believers before us are not scary. With our strength, we could annihilate them at any time.”
“What truly needs to be guarded against are those reinforcements that have not yet appeared.”
Yang Eleven looked into the distance, his voice low.
“This is not an ordinary Divine Kingdom War.”
“The longer time is dragged out, the more severe the damage suffered by the opponent’s Divine Kingdom, and the greater our advantage will be.”
Hearing this, the doubt in the White Zombie believer’s eyes instantly vanished, replaced by absolute firmness.
“This subordinate understands, I will definitely perform this play well.”
After saying this, he immediately exited the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and rushed toward the frontline battlefield.
Ma Huainan, who was commanding the battle, suddenly noticed that the energy cannons falling from the sky had actually stopped.
He was slightly stunned, then a look of wild joy appeared on his face.
“All believers, listen to my order: the opponent’s Smart Weapon energy has been exhausted, immediately form up and counterattack!”
Following the transmission of the Divine Decree, the believers who had been suppressed instantly erupted with powerful Qi and blood energy.
“And they call themselves third-grade Smart Weapons; their endurance is actually so short. I’m afraid they’re just discarded goods scavenged from somewhere.”
Ma Huainan sneered.
However, the next moment, the voice of the intelligent lifeform rang out in his mind.
“Master, beware of a trap!”
Ma Huainan frowned slightly.
“What trap could there be?”
“If their energy hadn’t been exhausted, these Smart Weapons alone would have been enough to slowly grind my believers to death.”
“In the face of absolute power, is there any need to play tricks?”
Ma Huainan’s eyes were filled with confidence.
“Powerful might, but insufficient endurance—that is the biggest flaw of these Smart Weapons.”
Hearing his own God’s analysis, the intelligent lifeform fell silent.
It still felt that something was wrong.
According to the data in its database, third-grade Smart Weapons should not have exhausted their energy in such a short time, even in a high-intensity combat state.
But what Ma Huainan said also made sense.
This is a Divine Kingdom War; apart from the two Gods, only these believers exist on the battlefield.
If the opponent is acting, then who is it for?
Could it be that there is really a God who would do such a meaningless thing?
This does not fit logic.
Thinking of this, the intelligent lifeform could only temporarily suppress the doubt in its heart.
The next moment, Ma Huainan’s army of believers began a full-scale counterattack.
Under Yang Eleven’s order, all zombie believers on the frontline voluntarily turned off the automatic mode of their Smart Weapons.
Subsequently, one Zombie King after another led their armies to begin setting up the Zombie Tide Dance Formation.
Boom!
Thick corpse Qi and blood energy instantly surged into the sky.
The two armies collided once again.
Only this time, the situation on the battlefield was completely different.
Zombie believers rely on numbers and infection capabilities to fight; in terms of individual combat power, they are far unable to compare with those believers who possess the Martial God Body.
The moment they engaged in close-quarters combat, the Zombie General at the very front was sent flying by a punch.
The terrifying force directly smashed their bodies hundreds of meters away, causing bones to break and bodies to twist.
If it weren’t for the third-grade Smart Weapons they were wearing, these Zombie Generals would likely have been completely destroyed after just one collision.
The battle damage ratio instantly widened: 1:10.
Not long after, the battle damage reached 1:100.
Yang Fan’s zombie army was being consumed at an astonishing rate.
However, facing this scene, Yang Fan, who was in the Divine Kingdom Core, felt no heartache at all.
In his Divine Kingdom, there were nearly a hundred billion troops ready to be committed to the battlefield at any time.
This little loss before him meant nothing to him.
“This SS-rank Talent is indeed powerful.”
Yang Fan looked at the battlefield and said slowly, “If it were the same Realm, I’m afraid those Martial Arts believers in my Divine Kingdom would really not be a match for these believers.”
“Master, zombie believers are not good at individual combat to begin with.”
Yang Da explained.
“As a large number of zombies die, the concentration of corpse poison in the battlefield will continuously increase.”
“According to data analysis, we can let the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers release corrosive acid.”
“Once these dark blue biochemical defensive suits are destroyed, the opponent’s believers will be affected by the corpse poison, and their combat power will gradually decline.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Synchronize the data with Yang Eleven and let him control the progress of the war.”
“However, those one billion believers must be completely consumed.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da immediately responded.

Yang Fan looked at the battlefield and couldn’t help but shake his head, “They are really weak. Even with an SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, they are actually so much weaker than that Angel Race God from before.”
“Master, this is normal.”
Yang Da explained.
“Ma Huainan has been a God for less than a year.”
“His Divine Kingdom’s Evolution time is probably not even one-hundredth of that Angel Race God’s.”
“Although he has an SS-rank Talent, it also requires time to accumulate.”
Hearing this, a smile appeared on the corner of Yang Fan’s mouth.
“If the strength isn’t enough, one should develop in a low-profile manner. If you insist on courting death, you can’t blame anyone else.”
In fact, the SS-rank war-type Divine Kingdom Talent that Ma Huainan possessed was considered one of the top potentials in the entire Human Federation.
But the problem was that the time he had been a God was simply too short.
No matter how powerful the talent is, it requires a long time to convert into true foundation.
If not for the fear of the external factor of the Sima Family, Ma Huainan would likely have been one of the easiest Gods for Yang Fan to deal with.
Within the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
As the battle continued, another 50 million ordinary zombies appeared on the frontline.
These zombies had no powerful combat strength, nor did they have intelligence.
Their existence was meant to serve as war consumables.
Charge up, die, and then leave behind more corpse poison.
Throughout the entire battlefield, corpses had piled up like mountains.
However, the vast majority of them were the corpses of ordinary zombies whose heads had been smashed.
Extremely thick corpse Qi permeated for hundreds of miles.
The originally clear river gradually turned into an eerie green.
Large areas of vegetation began to wither, and even the surrounding rocks were stained with a layer of unnatural green.
Seeing this scene, the solemnity in Ma Huainan’s eyes gradually disappeared, and he regained his confidence.
“This is what a zombie is!”
“This is the Corpse Cultivator route!”
He couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
“Good, good, good!”
“I was almost really bluffed by you just now!”
Ma Huainan raised his hand and pointed at the distant zombie army.
“You hiding coward!”
“Listen to me!”
“Once I finish off these believers of yours, I will follow the coordinates to your Divine Kingdom.”
“The losses my Divine Kingdom has suffered... I will make you pay it back a hundredfold, a thousandfold!”

sentences.text: If not for the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom rules, a High-Order God could not directly invade a Low-rank Deity.
At this moment, Ma Huainan even suspected that a mid-tier Mechanical God might be hiding their identity to attack his Divine Kingdom.
“Something is wrong... very wrong!”
“Who exactly is the opponent?”
Cold sweat had already appeared on Ma Huainan’s forehead.
Clearly, the number of zombies the opponent had committed to the battlefield was only in the hundreds of millions.
Yet, at this moment, he felt an inexplicable fear.
On the other side, Yang Eleven quickly received the message sent by Yang Da.
The next moment, he immediately gave an order.
“Stop using the energy cannons and reduce the frequency of using Smart Weapons.”
As the order was passed down, the zombie legion, which had been outputting crazily, instantly stopped their large-scale attacks.
The White Zombie standing to the side was stunned for a moment, “Marshal, why is this?”
Yang Eleven glanced at him, then said in a deep voice:
“In a moment, you will personally head to the frontline.”
“I am allocating 50 million ordinary zombies to you.”
“Next, you will preside over the Zombie Tide Dance Formation.”
“I want you to fight an evenly matched war against the opponent’s army.”
Upon hearing this, that White Zombie was clearly stunned.
“Ah?”
“But Marshal, these Smart Weapons can automatically recover energy.”
“With this level of consumption, they can recover in just a few months at most.”
“There is no need to restrict their use, is there?”
Yang Eleven shook his head.
“You only need to remember one thing.”
“Our God’s gaze is far further than what we can see.”
“The believers before us are not scary.
With our strength, we could annihilate them at any time.”
“What truly needs to be guarded against are those reinforcements that have not yet appeared.”
Yang Eleven looked into the distance, his voice low.
“This is not an ordinary Divine Kingdom War.”
“The longer time is dragged out, the more severe the damage suffered by the opponent’s Divine Kingdom, and the greater our advantage will be.”
Hearing this, the doubt in the White Zombie believer’s eyes instantly vanished, replaced by absolute firmness.
“This subordinate understands, I will definitely perform this play well.”
After saying this, he immediately exited the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers and rushed toward the frontline battlefield.
Ma Huainan, who was commanding the battle, suddenly noticed that the energy cannons falling from the sky had actually stopped.
He was slightly stunned, then a look of wild joy appeared on his face.
“All believers, listen to my order: the opponent’s Smart Weapon energy has been exhausted, immediately form up and counterattack!”
Following the transmission of the Divine Decree, the believers who had been suppressed instantly erupted with powerful Qi and blood energy.
“And they call themselves third-grade Smart Weapons; their endurance is actually so short.
I’m afraid they’re just discarded goods scavenged from somewhere.”
Ma Huainan sneered.
However, the next moment, the voice of the intelligent lifeform rang out in his mind.
“Master, beware of a trap!”
Ma Huainan frowned slightly.
“What trap could there be?”
“If their energy hadn’t been exhausted, these Smart Weapons alone would have been enough to slowly grind my believers to death.”
“In the face of absolute power, is there any need to play tricks?”
Ma Huainan’s eyes were filled with confidence.
“Powerful might, but insufficient endurance—that is the biggest flaw of these Smart Weapons.”
Hearing his own God’s analysis, the intelligent lifeform fell silent.
It still felt that something was wrong.
According to the data in its database, third-grade Smart Weapons should not have exhausted their energy in such a short time, even in a high-intensity combat state.
But what Ma Huainan said also made sense.
This is a Divine Kingdom War; apart from the two Gods, only these believers exist on the battlefield.
If the opponent is acting, then who is it for?
Could it be that there is really a God who would do such a meaningless thing?
This does not fit logic.
Thinking of this, the intelligent lifeform could only temporarily suppress the doubt in its heart.
The next moment, Ma Huainan’s army of believers began a full-scale counterattack.
Under Yang Eleven’s order, all zombie believers on the frontline voluntarily turned off the automatic mode of their Smart Weapons.
Subsequently, one Zombie King after another led their armies to begin setting up the Zombie Tide Dance Formation.
Boom!
Thick corpse Qi and blood energy instantly surged into the sky.
The two armies collided once again.
Only this time, the situation on the battlefield was completely different.
Zombie believers rely on numbers and infection capabilities to fight; in terms of individual combat power, they are far unable to compare with those believers who possess the Martial God Body.
The moment they engaged in close-quarters combat, the Zombie General at the very front was sent flying by a punch.
The terrifying force directly smashed their bodies hundreds of meters away, causing bones to break and bodies to twist.
If it weren’t for the third-grade Smart Weapons they were wearing, these Zombie Generals would likely have been completely destroyed after just one collision.
The battle damage ratio instantly widened: 1:10.
Not long after, the battle damage reached 1:100.
Yang Fan’s zombie army was being consumed at an astonishing rate.
However, facing this scene, Yang Fan, who was in the Divine Kingdom Core, felt no heartache at all.
In his Divine Kingdom, there were nearly a hundred billion troops ready to be committed to the battlefield at any time.
This little loss before him meant nothing to him.
“This SS-rank Talent is indeed powerful.”
Yang Fan looked at the battlefield and said slowly, “If it were the same Realm, I’m afraid those Martial Arts believers in my Divine Kingdom would really not be a match for these believers.”
“Master, zombie believers are not good at individual combat to begin with.”
Yang Da explained.
“As a large number of zombies die, the concentration of corpse poison in the battlefield will continuously increase.”
“According to data analysis, we can let the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers release corrosive acid.”
“Once these dark blue biochemical defensive suits are destroyed, the opponent’s believers will be affected by the corpse poison, and their combat power will gradually decline.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Synchronize the data with Yang Eleven and let him control the progress of the war.”
“However, those one billion believers must be completely consumed.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Da immediately responded.
Yang Fan looked at the battlefield and couldn’t help but shake his head, “They are really weak.
Even with an SS-rank Divine Kingdom Talent, they are actually so much weaker than that Angel Race God from before.”
“Master, this is normal.”
Yang Da explained.
“Ma Huainan has been a God for less than a year.”
“His Divine Kingdom’s Evolution time is probably not even one-hundredth of that Angel Race God’s.”
“Although he has an SS-rank Talent, it also requires time to accumulate.”

chapters.title: Chapter 448: What right do you have to fight a war of attrition against me?
paragraphs: Just as Ma Huainan was loudly berating, the nearly ten thousand Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers in the distance suddenly began to move slowly.
The heavy sound of metal grinding echoed across the battlefield.
The next moment.
Sss—
Fine cracks opened up on the surface of the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
Immediately after, countless ghostly green liquids sprayed out from within them.
An acid rain filling the sky descended in an instant!
The dense curtain of rain obscured the sky, covering almost the entire battlefield, leaving nowhere to hide.
“Defend!”
Ma Huainan’s expression changed abruptly, and he immediately issued a Divine Decree.
However, the next moment, his expression froze completely.

Those acid rains landed on the protective suits of the believers, and the moment they made contact, a sizzling corrosive sound was emitted, and the transparent gelatinous protective layer melted rapidly.
Small holes began to appear in the protective materials.
Even the transparent protective shields above the believers’ heads began to crack and show signs of melting.
“Damn it!”
Ma Huainan’s expression was ugly to the extreme.
“All believers, retreat immediately and leave this area!”
He hurriedly issued the order.
However, at this moment, what he was worried about was not those believers of his.
As long as there is enough time, the believers will eventually reproduce and achieve a breakthrough again.
What really pained him was this equipment.
This protective equipment was all rented by him spending Divinity Points.
Every damaged piece meant needing to pay double the price according to the contract.
This is all money! Real, solid Divinity Points!
“Damn it, how many more tricks does that guy on the opposite side have?” Ma Huainan’s expression was gloomy.
Originally, according to his judgment, facing a Divine Kingdom army on the Corpse Cultivator path, renting this protective equipment was already the safest and most cost-effective choice.
After all, from the information he understood, the vast majority of gods who followed the Corpse Cultivator path might be troublesome, but they did not possess strong direct combat capabilities.
As long as one prepares protection in advance, cleaning them up slowly is fine.
But now... the development of this war had completely exceeded his expectations.
If the fighting continues, his losses will likely become greater and greater.
“My God...”
“The air here is so uncomfortable...”
“I feel... like something is crawling inside my skin!”
On the battlefield, voices of pain rang out one after another.
Those believers whose protective suits were destroyed began to exhibit abnormalities in their bodies, and their auras grew weaker and weaker.

If it weren’t for the fact that these believers were at least in the Martial Disciple Realm and had a Physique far exceeding ordinary life forms, they would likely have already begun to turn into zombies.
And what was permeating the battlefield now was not just the corpse poison emitted by ordinary zombies.
There were also a large number of corpse pills condensed by White Zombie believers.
The highly toxic poison within these corpse pills was something that even a Martial King level existence would not dare to touch lightly.
Ma Huainan’s consciousness instantly perceived the surroundings, only to discover that at some unknown point, those Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers had moved.
They had formed a huge encirclement among themselves.
The retreat route was being blocked bit by bit.
Seeing this scene, Ma Huainan’s eyes were gloomy.
But soon, he made a decision.
“Shut up, all of you!”
“You are my believers!”
“Now is the time for you to sacrifice yourselves for the Divine Kingdom!”
His voice echoed across the entire battlefield.
“All troops, charge! Kill them all!”
“Let these invaders know who the master of this Divine Kingdom is!”
As the Divine Decree fell, the originally chaotic army of believers began to assemble once again.
They did not choose to retreat, but instead launched a final charge towards the zombie army.
One billion believers were infected and killed.
To say that Ma Huainan didn’t feel pained at all would be impossible.
But retreating at this moment was also not a good choice.
Once he chose to retreat, the opponent’s zombie army would inevitably take advantage of the situation to pursue.
By then, the losses would only be even heavier.
More importantly, a large number of believers had already been infected with corpse poison.
Even if they succeeded in retreating, it would require consuming a large amount of Divinity Points to purchase detoxifying Resources.
This would be another huge expense.
In a short instant, Ma Huainan had already finished weighing the options.
His loss of believers was indeed great, but the opponent’s zombie army was also constantly being consumed.
This was essentially a war of attrition.
And this place... was his Divine Kingdom!
“I’d like to see.”
“On my home turf, what right do you have to fight a war of attrition against me!”
Ma Huainan’s eyes were filled with madness.
On the battlefield, as the protective suits continued to be damaged, more and more believers began to be infected with the zombie virus.
The thick corpse Qi entered their bodies along the wounds and damaged areas, even seeping through their skin into their blood.
At first, these believers could still suppress the corpse poison by relying on their strong Physique.
But as time passed, the corpse poison continued to accumulate, their Qi and blood began to weaken, and their consciousness gradually blurred.
Under the arrangement of Yang Eleven, a large number of ordinary zombies were released from the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers.
These zombies were not responsible for direct kills, but rather acted like walls made of flesh and blood, blocking the advance of Ma Huainan’s believer army.
The longer the time dragged on, the worse the state of Ma Huainan’s believers became.
Some began to lose their ability to fight.
Some people’s bodies began to show signs of zombification.
Some believers even turned directly into new zombies on the battlefield.
Divine Kingdom time passed quickly.
One month later, the army of one billion believers sent by Ma Huainan was completely wiped out.
Across the entire battlefield, corpses were piled up like mountains.
The dense corpse Qi even changed the surrounding environment, turning this area into a completely dead zone.
Looking at the zombie corpses all over the ground, a smile appeared on Ma Huainan’s face.
“This time, I was the one who got played.”
“But you didn’t get any benefit either.”
“Wait until next time, when I am prepared, I will definitely kill all your believers and find your Divine Kingdom coordinates!”
Ma Huainan’s voice echoed throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
However, facing the opponent’s bold words, Yang Fan, who was in his own Divine Kingdom, just rolled his eyes.
“His resistance will only get stronger in the future.”
“Arrange ten billion zombie believers to go over and support.”
“Let Yang Eleven continue to advance according to the original plan and slowly destroy his Divine Kingdom environment.”
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da responded respectfully.
With the destruction of Ma Huainan’s first army of believers, Yang Fan did not continue to pay attention to the battlefield.
The rest of the matters could be left to Yang Da and the others.
In the Real World, Yang Fan opened his eyes.
At this moment, he was still lying in the spa room, enjoying the massage from a smart robot.
Not long after, the door was gently pushed open.
Lu Wan walked in carrying a plate of crystal-clear Spirit Fruit.
“Husband.”
She placed the Spirit Fruit on the table and then spoke.
“Sima Yurao wants to invite us to dinner.”
“She said... she wants to chat in person.”
“She’s probably looking to apologize.”
Yang Fan didn’t even think about it and directly refused, “No need.”
Lu Wan didn’t say anything more and just nodded obediently.
Yang Fan had absolutely no interest in being friends with Sima Yurao.
You have to know that his Divine Kingdom was still constantly deducing the opponent’s Divine Kingdom coordinates.
Perhaps one day, his army would invade the opponent’s Divine Kingdom.
Since that was the case, why waste time establishing a so-called friendship?
