chapters.title: Chapter 449: Like Farming?
paragraphs: On the other side.
Inside the villa where Ma Huainan lived.
At this moment, he was having a video call via Feixun.
His entire face was flushed with anger, and he was almost roaring.
“You profiteer!”
“Look at this war record yourself!”
“Someone drops an acid rain, and the protective suits get corroded directly!”
“With this kind of trash equipment, you still want me to pay double compensation?”
“In your dreams!”
On the other end of the video, a slightly plump middle-aged man was sitting there, his expression very calm.
“Young Master Ma, you rented such a large scale of Smart Weapon, yet you only paid one thousand Divinity Points.”
“As the saying goes, you get what you pay for.”
A meaningful smile appeared on the middle-aged man’s face.
“Doesn’t Young Master Ma know?”
“The cheaper something is, the more expensive it often turns out to be.”
Veins throbbed on Ma Huainan’s forehead, “Then how dare you ask me to pay one hundred thousand?”
“The contract stipulates it.”
The other party’s expression remained unchanged.
“No matter how ordinary the quality of these equipment is, they still belong to Smart Weapon.”
“A full one billion sets of Smart Weapon, with a total price of fifty thousand Divinity Points, is already very cheap to begin with.”
“Now, proceeding with double compensation according to the contract is perfectly fine.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s face turned livid.
Of course, he knew why the other party dared to be so tough.
These contract terms had already been audited by intelligent lifeform, written clearly in black and white.
If he refused to pay, the other party could completely submit an application to the Federal Court to freeze his assets in the Real World.
They could even restrict his high-end consumption.
By that time, even purchasing some advanced Resources and buildings would be affected.
As a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius, Ma Huainan could never allow his reputation to be tarnished over this small amount of money.
“Get lost! I’ll give you the money!”
“Don’t even think about me doing business with you again!”
After saying that.
Snap!
Ma Huainan hung up the Feixun directly, his face looking terrible to the extreme.
However, at this moment, the voice of the Divine Kingdom’s intelligent lifeform sounded again.
“Master, the enemy’s army is continuing to penetrate deeper.”
“corpse poison has been deployed in all areas along the way.”
“Currently, a large number of Divine Kingdom investment zones have been destroyed.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan only felt a wave of a headache.
He closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
A moment later, his gaze became firm again.
“Immediately arrange for robots to go to the shops on the frontline to purchase equipment that can prevent corpse poison.”
“I borrowed quite a lot from Qin Xue, and currently, I still have five hundred billion Divinity Points on hand.”
“Suspend all Divine Kingdom investments.”
“Now, prioritize resolving this war.”
“Antidotes, equipment to defend against corpse poison, and one-time war Resources capable of resisting the opponent’s Smart Weapon.”
“Compile a procurement plan.”
“The faster, the better!”
After this battle, Ma Huainan understood completely.
The opponent was definitely not just some ordinary Rogue Cultivator god.
That zombie army was also far from as simple as he had imagined.
Originally, he was still carrying huge loans and was desperate to quickly recoup funds through Divine Kingdom investments.
But now, he had to temporarily abandon this plan.
One day in the outside world is one year in the Divine Kingdom.
If he continued to let these zombie armies wreak havoc, in less than a month in the Real World, his Divine Kingdom’s environment would inevitably suffer irreversible damage.
By that time, it wouldn’t just be a matter of losing Divinity Points, but the future development potential of the entire Divine Kingdom.
Although Ma Huainan was greedy, he was not a fool.
“Yes, Master.”
The intelligent lifeform paused for a moment, then asked cautiously.
“Um... after selecting the shops, does Master need to go over and haggle in person like before?”
“Haggle your head!”
Ma Huainan slammed the table violently.
“Hurry up and buy it back for me!”
“What time is it now? Is there still time to bargain with them?”
The intelligent lifeform immediately shut up.
“Understood, Master.”
At this moment, Ma Huainan sat in his chair, his face gloomy and full of worry.
This battle had completely disrupted his plans.
“A-Rank War Structure... third-class Smart Weapon...”
“And even believers like White Zombies that are comparable to Martial King-level combat power.”
Ma Huainan muttered in a low voice.
“Gods who follow the Corpse Cultivator path are already extremely rare among the Human race.”
“To possess such Divine Kingdom foundations, the opponent cannot possibly be a nobody in the Real World.”
His brows were tightly locked, his brain constantly analyzing various possibilities.
Suddenly, Ma Huainan seemed to think of something and stood up abruptly.
“Could it be... related to Yang Fan?”
His gaze gradually became grave.
“Yang Fan is also a Peerless Prodigy, and now he has married the daughters of the Lu Family and the Gu Family.”
“Given his status and Resources, if he were to mobilize a large amount of Resources behind the scenes to support a Corpse Cultivator god, it would make perfect sense.”
But the next moment, Ma Huainan shook his head again.
“No! The time is too short!”
“From the time they started investigating my Divine Kingdom’s information until now, only one month has passed.”
“In such a short time, how could he possibly deduce my Divine Kingdom’s coordinates?”
“The success probability of continuous deduction will become lower and lower.”
The more Ma Huainan thought about it, the deeper his brows furrowed.
“Could it be... everything is really just a coincidence?”
“In such a short time, how could a Corpse Cultivator god with such foundations just happen to appear?”
The more he pondered, the more his doubts grew.
He felt that he had been too unlucky during this period, as if an invisible hand was targeting him.
On the other side.
Yang Fan’s life, however, remained very calm.
On the third day in the Real World, Ma Huainan’s believers in the Divine Kingdom began to use the terrain to their advantage, continuously dispatching small groups of troops to harass them.
They did not initiate a decisive battle, but instead kept attacking, slowing down the advance of the zombie army.
On the fifth day, Ma Huainan organized an army of one billion believers again.
But this time, he did not choose to fight to the death head-on.
Instead, he fought while retreating.
Although he could not change the outcome of the war, he successfully consumed quite a few of Yang Fan’s corpse pills and other Resources.
On the seventh day, Yang Fan’s zombie army had advanced to the central region of Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom.
Among this, the Tomb of Ten Thousand Corpse-Soldiers played a huge role.
After all, these were A-Rank War Structures.
In terms of movement speed, they were far from what ordinary zombies could compare to relying on their legs to travel.
After entering the central region, Yang Fan discovered that Ma Huainan’s Divine Kingdom assets in this area had increased significantly.
A large number of Spirit Plants fields appeared in his line of sight.
Among them, there was even quite a lot of high-quality spirit soil.
At a glance, large quantities of advanced fertilizers and Spirit Plant seeds produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom were piled up beside the fields.
Besides that, automatic irrigation Systems, constant-temperature cultivation greenhouses, Spiritual Qi regulation equipment... all kinds of agricultural facilities were fully equipped.
Seeing this scene, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but be a little surprised.
“Didn’t expect that this guy actually likes farming?”
A dignified SS-rank Martial God Body talent owner, yet within his Divine Kingdom, there was such a scale of agricultural industry.
It had to be said that Ma Huainan’s planning for the development of his Divine Kingdom indeed greatly exceeded Yang Fan’s expectations.
However... he had no interest in these assets at all.
“Destroy everything.”
Yang Fan issued the order directly.

Inside the villa where Ma Huainan lived.
At this moment, he was having a video call via Feixun.
His entire face was flushed with anger, and he was almost roaring.
“You profiteer!”
“Look at this war record yourself!”
“Someone drops an acid rain, and the protective suits get corroded directly!”
“With this kind of trash equipment, you still want me to pay double compensation?”
“In your dreams!”
On the other end of the video, a slightly plump middle-aged man was sitting there, his expression very calm.
“Young Master Ma, you rented such a large scale of Smart Weapon, yet you only paid one thousand Divinity Points.”
“As the saying goes, you get what you pay for.”
A meaningful smile appeared on the middle-aged man’s face.
“Doesn’t Young Master Ma know?”
“The cheaper something is, the more expensive it often turns out to be.”
Veins throbbed on Ma Huainan’s forehead, “Then how dare you ask me to pay one hundred thousand?”
“The contract stipulates it.”
The other party’s expression remained unchanged.
“No matter how ordinary the quality of these equipment is, they still belong to Smart Weapon.”
“A full one billion sets of Smart Weapon, with a total price of fifty thousand Divinity Points, is already very cheap to begin with.”
“Now, proceeding with double compensation according to the contract is perfectly fine.”
Hearing this, Ma Huainan’s face turned livid.
Of course, he knew why the other party dared to be so tough.
These contract terms had already been audited by intelligent lifeform, written clearly in black and white.
If he refused to pay, the other party could completely submit an application to the Federal Court to freeze his assets in the Real World.
They could even restrict his high-end consumption.
By that time, even purchasing some advanced Resources and buildings would be affected.
As a Peerless Prodigy-level Genius, Ma Huainan could never allow his reputation to be tarnished over this small amount of money.
“Get lost!
I’ll give you the money!”
“Don’t even think about me doing business with you again!”
After saying that.
Snap!
Ma Huainan hung up the Feixun directly, his face looking terrible to the extreme.
However, at this moment, the voice of the Divine Kingdom’s intelligent lifeform sounded again.
“Master, the enemy’s army is continuing to penetrate deeper.”
“corpse poison has been deployed in all areas along the way.”

Hearing this, Ma Huainan only felt a wave of a headache.
He closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
A moment later, his gaze became firm again.
“Immediately arrange for robots to go to the shops on the frontline to purchase equipment that can prevent corpse poison.”
“I borrowed quite a lot from Qin Xue, and currently, I still have five hundred billion Divinity Points on hand.”
“Suspend all Divine Kingdom investments.”
“Now, prioritize resolving this war.”
“Antidotes, equipment to defend against corpse poison, and one-time war Resources capable of resisting the opponent’s Smart Weapon.”
“Compile a procurement plan.”
“The faster, the better!”

The opponent was definitely not just some ordinary Rogue Cultivator god.
That zombie army was also far from as simple as he had imagined.
Originally, he was still carrying huge loans and was desperate to quickly recoup funds through Divine Kingdom investments.
But now, he had to temporarily abandon this plan.
One day in the outside world is one year in the Divine Kingdom.
If he continued to let these zombie armies wreak havoc, in less than a month in the Real World, his Divine Kingdom’s environment would inevitably suffer irreversible damage.
By that time, it wouldn’t just be a matter of losing Divinity Points, but the future development potential of the entire Divine Kingdom.
Although Ma Huainan was greedy, he was not a fool.
“Yes, Master.”
The intelligent lifeform paused for a moment, then asked cautiously.
“Um... after selecting the shops, does Master need to go over and haggle in person like before?”
“Haggle your head!”
Ma Huainan slammed the table violently.
“Hurry up and buy it back for me!”
“What time is it now?
Is there still time to bargain with them?”
The intelligent lifeform immediately shut up.
“Understood, Master.”
At this moment, Ma Huainan sat in his chair, his face gloomy and full of worry.
This battle had completely disrupted his plans.
“A-Rank War Structure... third-class Smart Weapon...”
“And even believers like White Zombies that are comparable to Martial King-level combat power.”
Ma Huainan muttered in a low voice.

“To possess such Divine Kingdom foundations, the opponent cannot possibly be a nobody in the Real World.”
His brows were tightly locked, his brain constantly analyzing various possibilities.
Suddenly, Ma Huainan seemed to think of something and stood up abruptly.
“Could it be... related to Yang Fan?”
His gaze gradually became grave.
“Yang Fan is also a Peerless Prodigy, and now he has married the daughters of the Lu Family and the Gu Family.”
“Given his status and Resources, if he were to mobilize a large amount of Resources behind the scenes to support a Corpse Cultivator god, it would make perfect sense.”

chapters.title: Chapter 450: The 50 Billion Human race Army
paragraphs: Yang Fan had absolutely no interest in moving these Resources back to his own Divine Kingdom.
Nowadays, the Resource output of his Divine Kingdom had already reached a terrifying level.
These items were incomparably precious to ordinary gods.
But for Yang Fan, their value was limited.
Furthermore, his goal this time was not to plunder assets, but to weaken the value of Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom.
Soon, a large number of corpse pills were buried into the spiritual fields, especially the highest-value spiritual soil, which received special attention.
As the corpse poison spread, these precious lands began to gradually lose their vitality and were completely ruined.
Subsequently, Yang Fan directly mobilized ten billion zombie believers to support the frontline.
However, these reinforcements were not for the sake of war, but to accelerate the speed of destruction.
As he explored deeper, Yang Fan discovered that the investments in Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom were even more chaotic than he had imagined.
In addition to spiritual fields, orchards, and farms, there were even investments in mineral veins, the Fountain of Life, and low-level resource buildings.
There were even investment projects like the C-Rank building, the Moon Well.
Moreover, these assets had absolutely no centralized planning. A piece here, a piece there, spread throughout the entire Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan was somewhat speechless just looking at it.
“Is this guy... doing diversified investing?”
“This is just too scattered.”
On the ninth day of the Real World, Yang Fans zombie army finally advanced to the periphery of the Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom core.
This time, they finally encountered decent resistance.
A large number of defensive buildings began to appear.
B-Rank defensive building—Black Iron City Wall, C-Rank defensive building—Flame Turret, C-Rank defensive building—Ice Barrier... F-Rank defensive building—Thousand Poison Swamp.
These buildings formed an area, blocking the zombie army from continuing its advance.
However, when Yang Fan finished looking, he instantly lost interest.
“Just this?”
He shook his head.
“It seems he is very confident in the combat power of his believers!”
The defensive buildings of Ma Huainans Divine Kingdom were not systematic at all and posed no threat to his zombie army.
On the tenth day of the Real World, ten years had passed in the Divine Kingdom since the last great battle.
On this day, Ma Huainan finally led the army himself and launched a counterattack.
And this time, the number of believers thrown into the battlefield reached as high as 50 billion!
Among them, besides Martial Apprentices and Martial Masters, there were actually thousands of Martial King-level believers.
Clearly, Ma Huainan had already thrown all the power he could mobilize into this war.
At this moment, the battlefield was no longer a chaotic wilderness.
Massive Formations spanned across heaven and earth, like insurmountable chasms blocking the path that Yang Fans army had to take.
Formation patterns swirled, and terrifying energy continuously gathered.
In the sky, that blood-colored phantom had solidified to the extreme; faintly, it seemed as if a Flood Dragon from the ancient era was coiled within it, emitting a heart-palpitating pressure.
Besides this, those believers under Ma Huainan who had reached the Martial Master Realm or above had all changed into brand-new protective gear.
Compared to the ordinary protective suits used in the last war, the equipment this time was obviously more advanced, with special energy luster flowing across the surface.
Clearly, for this final battle, Ma Huainan had made sufficient preparations.
Yang Fans consciousness was also in his own Divine Kingdom at this moment.
Watching the enemy troops waiting in full battle array in the opponents Divine Kingdom, he instead revealed a smile of interest.
“It seems this Ma Huainan really intends to make a desperate stand here.”
Yang Da stood to the side and immediately analyzed:
“Master, Ma Huainan choosing this place as the final battlefield must have been carefully considered.”
“The terrain here is extremely open, allowing the 50 billion-strong army to deploy for battle to the maximum extent without being restricted by the geography.”
“Besides that, nearly half of the defensive buildings here have not yet been destroyed by us, and now they have all become his defensive force.”
If Ma Huainan continued to turtle up in the Divine Kingdom Core, facing the zombie army led by Yang Eleven, he would only be eaten away bit by bit.
But now, actively choosing an open area for a decisive battle, relying on his numerical advantage and the remaining defensive facilities, from the perspective of war, is indeed a correct choice.
“Master, according to analysis, the opponent is using [Sky Guardian Type III Biological Protective Armor].”
Yang Da continued.
“This is a high-end product launched by the Mechanical technology company under the Seventh-Order Mechanical god Mo Xuanming.”
“This type of equipment can not only withstand ordinary energy attacks, but also possesses extremely strong resistance to special attacks such as corrosion, toxins, and spiritual pollution.”
“Therefore, corrosive attacks like acid rain will have significantly reduced effects on this equipment.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan did not pay much attention to it.
“It doesn’t matter. His Divine Kingdom has already been more than 60% destroyed by me.”
“It has been less than a year since he reached the god Realm, so this 50 billion-strong army should be his final trump card.”
Yang Fans eyes were calm.
“Pass the order to Yang Eleven.”
“In this battle, operate at your own discretion.”
“No matter what the cost, you must devour this entire army.”
Yang Fan said indifferently.
“Yes, Master.”
Yang Da nodded, then immediately relayed the order.
Afterward, Yang Fans expression gradually became serious.
“Yang Da, after this battle ends, in order to survive, Ma Huainan will most likely publish his Divine Kingdom coordinates to the Sima Family.”
“What comes next will be the real battle.”
Yang Fans eyes were cold.
“Mobilize the entire zombie army from the Eternal Corpse Mine to the frontline for support.”
“Yes, Master.”
Meanwhile, on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Regarding the 50 billion Human race army, in terms of numbers alone, the force under Ma Huainans command was more than twice the size of the zombie army currently led by Yang Eleven.
And with the addition of thousands of Martial King-level believers, the combat power of this army underwent a qualitative change.
One B-Rank Formation after another was activated.
In an instant, the heavens and earth changed color.
The originally cold and dead silent zombie army, in the face of this terrifying power, had its aura forcefully suppressed.
Ma Huainans consciousness phantom floated directly above the army.
He looked at the densely packed zombie legions in the distance, his eyes filled with resentment.
“You thief!”
“You destroyed my Divine Kingdom assets and ruined my Divine Kingdom Foundation!”
“What deep hatred do I have with you that you must take things to such an extent?”
The voice, like thunder, spread throughout the entire battlefield.
He knew that the god hiding behind the zombie army would certainly be able to hear his words.
And the reason he did not launch an attack immediately was because he wanted to use this opportunity to see the other party and ask clearly about the doubts in his heart.
For this period of time, Ma Huainan had been preparing for this war with all his might.
Whether in the Divine Kingdom or in the Real World, he had not stopped for a single moment.
Even if he was busy, as a god, he was naturally extremely clear about everything happening in his Divine Kingdom.
From the peripheral areas of the Divine Kingdom to the current core area.
In order to develop the Divine Kingdom, he had once invested a full four trillion Divinity Points in fixed assets.
These Resources were all huge sums of wealth he obtained through loans.

According to the normal flow of a Divine Kingdom War, after the opponent occupies an area, they can completely develop it slowly and transfer all these buildings and Resources back to their own Divine Kingdom.
But the opponent did not do this at all.
Instead, they chose the simplest and also the most insane method—destruction.
